instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
about 21 cups water
3 tbsp salt
18 oz (6 ¾ cups) gluten-free rotini pasta

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic. Peel and small dice the onions.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 cloves garlic
1 ½ yellow onions

instructions.primary_message: Heat a sauté pan over medium-low heat.
Coat bottom of pan with oil. Add garlic, onion, sage, and thyme. Cook until soft, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp sage
1 ½ tsp thyme

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash kale leaves, then fold in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces. Add to the pan with the onions; cook, stirring often, until kale begins to wilt, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ bunches kale

instructions.primary_message: Add broth, pumpkin, ricotta, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine. Simmer, stirring occasionally, while pasta is cooking.
instructions.secondary_message:
18 fl oz (2 ¼ cups) chicken or vegetable broth
1 ½ (15 oz) can pure pumpkin purée
1 ½ (15 oz) pkg ricotta cheese
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to broil and position rack 4 inches under the broiler.
Wash and chop chives into small pieces.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ small pkg chives

instructions.primary_message: Grate ¾ cup of Parmesan.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 oz Parmesan cheese

instructions.primary_message: Add ½ of the chives and Parmesan (save the rest for garnishing) to pan and stir to combine.
Drain pasta, add to pan with sauce, and stir to combine.
Place pan in the oven and broil until slightly browned, 3-4 minutes.
To serve, place pasta on a plate and garnish with remaining chives and Parmesan. Enjoy!
Peel and mince the onion.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ medium yellow onions

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Peel and mince the garlic.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Once the saucepan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Add the onion and garlic to the saucepan; cook, stirring frequently, until slightly softened, 5-6 minutes.
Drain and rinse the beans in a colander; add to the saucepan with the onion. Stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (15 oz) cans black beans

instructions.primary_message: Add the ketchup, vinegar, soy sauce, Dijon, brown sugar, and spices to the saucepan. Reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, while you make the slaw.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup ketchup
¼ cup apple cider vinegar
1 ½ tbsp tamari soy sauce
1 ½ tsp Dijon mustard
3 tbsp brown sugar
¾ tsp paprika
¾ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: In a large bowl, whisk together the mayonnaise, vinegar, Dijon, maple syrup, and onion powder. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup vegan mayonnaise
3 tbsp apple cider vinegar
1 ½ tbsp Dijon mustard
1 ½ tbsp pure maple syrup
1 ½ tsp onion powder

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium heads napa cabbage
3 medium carrots
1 ½ small bunches green onions (scallions)

instructions.primary_message: Trim off and discard the root end of the cabbage; halve the cabbage lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and peel the carrots, then julienne or coarsely grate them. Add to the bowl with the cabbage.
Trim off and discard the ends of the green onions; cut the onions into ¼-inch pieces and add to the bowl with the cabbage. Stir to combine the veggies with the dressing and set aside.
Toast the buns if desired.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 gluten-free buns or rolls

instructions.primary_message: To serve, place the bottom half of a bun on each plate. Top with bean mixture and some of the slaw; close with top half of the bun. Serve with remaining slaw on the side. Enjoy!
Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place flour and bread crumbs onto two separate plates. Season each plate with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup gluten-free flour
1 ½ cup gluten-free bread crumbs
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: In a medium bowl, whisk the eggs.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 eggs

instructions.primary_message: Dredge chicken fillets in flour, shake off excess, then dip into the bowl with the egg. Let the egg drip off, then dredge the chicken fillets in the bread crumbs, pressing to adhere. Set aside on a plate.
Preheat a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Add chicken to the skillet; cook until it is cooked through and golden brown, 3-4 minutes per side (working in batches if necessary). Once chicken is done, remove from skillet and place on a paper-towel lined plate.
Meanwhile, in a large bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together mayonnaise, vinegar, oil, and oregano.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup mayonnaise
⅓ cup red wine vinegar
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp oregano

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 heads romaine lettuce
3 red bell peppers
1 ½ English cucumbers

instructions.primary_message: Chop or tear the lettuce into bite-sized pieces and transfer to the bowl with the dressing.
Small dice the bell peppers and add to the salad bowl.
Trim the ends of the cucumbers; halve lengthwise, then thinly slice into half-moons. Add cucumbers to the salad bowl.
Halve the olives lengthwise and add to the salad bowl. Toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message: ½ cup Kalamata olives, pitted

instructions.primary_message: Finely grate Parmesan.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ oz Parmesan cheese

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide the chicken and salad between plates. Top with grated Parmesan and enjoy!
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and salt; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups jasmine rice
24 fl oz (3 cups) water
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Peel and mince the garlic and ginger. In a large bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together the minced garlic and ginger, peanut butter, soy sauce, water, vinegar, curry, and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
9 tbsp natural peanut butter
6 tbsp gluten-free soy sauce
6 tbsp warm water
1 ½ tbsp rice vinegar
1 ½ tsp curry powder
⅜ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Drain and rinse chickpeas. Place on paper towels and pat dry. Add to bowl with dressing.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (15 oz) cans garbanzo beans (chickpeas)

instructions.primary_message: Add broccoli slaw to bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (12 oz) pkg broccoli slaw mix

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry bell peppers and green onions. Seed, julienne (cut into thin sticks), and add peppers to bowl. Trim and discard root ends, chop onions, and add to bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 red bell peppers
1 ½ small bunches green onions

instructions.primary_message: Toss salad until coated with dressing.
To serve, divide rice and salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
Preheat oven to broil on high; position rack under the broiler.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 crowns broccoli
3 limes
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
1 ½ small bunches cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Separate broccoli crowns into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces; place in a large bowl. Add oil, salt, and pepper, and toss to combine; transfer to one large or two medium baking sheets and spread out in a single, even layer. Reserve bowl for later use.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp toasted sesame oil
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Cooking in batches if necessary, Place broccoli (one baking sheet at a time) in the oven and broil, turning halfway through, until broccoli is crisp-tender and lightly charred around the edges, 12-15 minutes.
Meanwhile, zest the limes into the large bowl, then juice half of the limes into the same bowl. Cut remaining limes into wedges and set aside.
Peel and mince shallots and garlic. Peel and grate or mince the ginger; transfer everything to the bowl with the lime juice.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ shallots
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Add fish sauce, soy sauce, chili-garlic sauce, and sugar to the bowl and whisk to combine the sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp fish sauce
1 ½ tbsp tamari soy sauce
1 ½ tsp chili-garlic sauce
1 tbsp brown sugar

instructions.primary_message: When the broccoli is done cooking, remove from the oven and transfer to the bowl with the sauce; stir to combine.
Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces and place in another large bowl. Add cornstarch, salt, and pepper to the bowl and gently toss to coat the chicken.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 lb chicken thighs, boneless skinless
3 tbsp cornstarch
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.  Working in batches if necessary, add the chicken in a single layer, and cook, stirring often, until golden and cooked through, 8-9 minutes. Transfer to the bowl with the broccoli.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp toasted sesame oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the broccoli.

When the chicken is done cooking, add edamame to the skillet and cook, stirring often, until cooked through, about 2 minutes. Transfer to the bowl with the broccoli, making sure to scrape all of the cooking juices into the bowl; toss to combine.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cups edamame

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide the broccoli mixture between bowls or plates; top with almonds and garnish with lime wedges. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ cup almonds, sliced

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to broil on high; position rack under the broiler. Line a large baking sheet pan with aluminum foil (optional).

Working in batches if necessary, place bread slices on the baking sheet in a single layer. Place in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through, 2-3 minutes, or until toasted. Remove toast from the oven and set aside. (Keep the broiler on.)
instructions.secondary_message: 12 slices gluten-free bread

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, roughly chop walnuts and transfer to a medium bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 cup walnuts

instructions.primary_message: Add blue cheese to the bowl with the walnuts.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (4 oz) pkgs crumbled blue cheese

instructions.primary_message: Wash, core, and medium dice the pears; transfer to the bowl with the walnuts and stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 pears

instructions.primary_message: Top each piece of toast with equal portions of walnut mixture.
Cooking in batches if necessary, place baking sheet in the oven and broil until walnuts are toasted and the cheese becomes bubbly, 1-2 minutes. Remove from the oven.
To serve, divide toasts between dishes, drizzle with honey, and enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp honey

instructions.primary_message: Peel and thinly slice the shallots into rings.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 shallots

instructions.primary_message: Wash and slice mushrooms.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ lb white mushrooms

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the mushrooms and shallot; cook, stirring occasionally, until mushrooms begin to soften, about 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: ⅓ cup butter, unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to broil on high; position rack under the broiler.
Wash and dry thyme. Slide leaves off the stems; discard the stems.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ small pkg fresh thyme

instructions.primary_message: Add garlic, vinegar, salt, and pepper to the skillet and cook, stirring often, until fragrant, 1-2 minutes. Remove from the heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp balsamic vinegar
¾ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Working in batches if necessary, place bread slices on top of a large baking sheet pan. Place in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through, 2-3 minutes, or until toasted. Remove from the oven.
instructions.secondary_message: 12 slices gluten-free bread

instructions.primary_message: Spread goat cheese over toast and top with warm mushrooms.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (4 oz) logs goat cheese

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide toasts between dishes and garnish with thyme. Enjoy!
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups basmati rice
24 fl oz (3 cups) water

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15 to 18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Peel and mince garlic. Peel and small dice onion. Wash and dry carrots and green onions. Peel and small dice the carrots. Trim root ends and chop the onions. Measure out peas.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
1 ½ medium yellow onion
6 medium carrots
1 ½ small bunch green onions (scallions)
3 cups frozen peas

instructions.primary_message: Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces. Season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add chicken and, stirring occasionally, cook until cooked through, 2-3 minutes. Transfer to a plate.
instructions.secondary_message: about 3 tbsp toasted sesame oil

instructions.primary_message: Return skillet to stove, increase heat to medium-high, and add more oil. Add garlic, yellow onion, carrots, and peas to skillet. Stir fry until tender, 2-3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: about 3 tbsp toasted sesame oil

instructions.primary_message: In a medium bowl, whisk eggs.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 eggs

instructions.primary_message: Move vegetables to one side of the skillet and pour eggs on the other side. Scramble eggs until cooked and mix with vegetables. Cook in batches if necessary.
Uncover the rice and fluff with a fork.
Add rice, chicken, and soy sauce to vegetables. Stir until well combined and heated through, 1-2 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 tbsp gluten-free soy sauce

instructions.primary_message: Remove from heat and sprinkle with green onions.
To serve, place fried rice in a bowl. Enjoy!
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 small pkgs fresh basil
3 lemons
1 ½ (5 oz) pkgs baby arugula

instructions.primary_message: Thinly slice the mozzarella.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (8 oz) blocks mozzarella cheese

instructions.primary_message: Pick basil leaves off the stems.
Preheat a grill pan or nonstick skillet over medium heat.
Place the bread slices on a flat surface. Evenly top half of the slices with the prosciutto, basil leaves, and sliced mozzarella. Cover the sandwiches with the remaining bread slices.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 slices gluten-free bread
18 slices prosciutto

instructions.primary_message: Coat the grill pan or skillet with butter.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tbsp butter, unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Cooking in batches if necessary, place the sandwiches in the pan and cook until the bottom is golden brown, 2-4 minutes.

Remove the sandwiches to a plate and add more butter to the pan; return the sandwiches to the pan, browned-side-up, and cook until golden brown on the other side and the cheese is melted, 2-4 minutes. Once done, transfer to a cutting board.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tbsp butter, unsalted

instructions.primary_message: While the sandwiches toast, juice the lemons into a large bowl. Whisk in the vinegar, oil, salt, and honey.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup white wine vinegar
⅓ cup extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
1 tbsp honey

instructions.primary_message: Use a vegetable peeler to shave the Parmesan into strips.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ oz Parmesan cheese

instructions.primary_message: Add the arugula and shaved Parmesan to the bowl with the dressing and toss to combine.
Cut the sandwiches in half on the diagonal.
To serve, divide the salad and sandwiches between plates. Enjoy!
Preheat oven to 450°F.
Drain and rinse chickpeas. Place on paper towels and pat dry, then transfer to a medium bowl. Add oil and spices to the bowl with the chickpeas and stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (15 oz) cans garbanzo beans (chickpeas)
1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp paprika
¼ tsp salt
3 pinch cayenne pepper

instructions.primary_message: Transfer chickpeas to a large baking sheet and spread out in an even layer. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, stirring halfway through, until slightly crispy, about 20 minutes. Reserve bowl for next step.
Meanwhile, wash and juice lemons into the medium bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ lemons

instructions.primary_message: Wash, halve, and pit the avocados; slice crosswise while still in the skin and scoop out with a spoon.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 avocados

instructions.primary_message: Add avocado, salt, and garlic powder to the bowl with the lemon juice and mash with a potato masher or fork.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ tsp salt
½ tsp garlic powder

instructions.primary_message: Toast bread if desired.
instructions.secondary_message: 12 slices gluten-free bread

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide toasts between dishes. Top with a layer of mashed avocado and a pile of warm roasted chickpeas. Enjoy!

If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 ¼ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with water and bring to a boil. Remove from heat and add rice noodles. Soak for 10 minutes or according to package directions. Then drain in a colander and rinse.
instructions.secondary_message: 15 oz flat rice (pad thai) noodles

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 medium carrots
3 red bell peppers
3 sticks celery
1 ½ small bunches green onions (scallions)
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
1 ½ medium heads napa cabbage
3 limes
3 oranges

instructions.primary_message: Peel the carrots; then using the peeler, run it along the carrot to make long, noodle-like strips. Seed and slice bell peppers into thin strips. Trim ends of celery and slice into small pieces. Transfer all to a large bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the green onions; cut the onions crosswise into small pieces. Add half of the onions to the bowl with the sliced vegetables (reserving the rest for garnish).
Peel and mince or grate the ginger. Peel and mince the garlic.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Heat a large pot over medium heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Add the sliced vegetables, ginger, garlic, and black pepper to the pot. Sauté until soft, 6-7 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: ⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim off and discard the root end of the cabbage; halve the cabbage lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise.
Add the cabbage to the pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until cabbage softens, 3-4 minutes.
Add the shrimp to the pot and cook, stirring occasionally, until lightly browned and cooked through, 2 to 4 minutes.
Juice the limes into a small bowl. Add the cornstarch and whisk together.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp cornstarch

instructions.primary_message: Juice the oranges into the pot; add broth, sugar, soy sauce, and fish sauce. Bring to a boil over high heat, then stir in the cornstarch mixture. Reduce heat to low, add rice noodles, and simmer, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth
⅓ cup brown sugar
⅓ cup tamari soy sauce
3 tbsp fish sauce

instructions.primary_message: Divide between bowls, garnish with remaining green onion, and enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups basmati rice
24 fl oz (3 cups) water

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15 to 18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Wash carrots and green onions. Peel and small dice carrots. Trim and discard root ends and chop onions. Transfer both to a plate. Measure out peas.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 carrots
1 ½ small bunches green onions
3 cups frozen peas

instructions.primary_message: Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Drain and medium dice tofu. Transfer to paper towels and pat dry.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (12 oz) pkg extra firm tofu

instructions.primary_message: Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add tofu and season with salt. Stirring occasionally, cook until lightly browned, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp toasted sesame oil
⅜ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onion
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Transfer tofu to a plate and return skillet to stove. Add more oil to skillet, followed by garlic, yellow onion, ½ of the green onions (save the rest for garnishing), carrots, and peas. Stirring often, cook until carrots are tender, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp toasted sesame oil

instructions.primary_message: In a medium bowl, whisk eggs.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 eggs

instructions.primary_message: Move vegetables to one side of skillet and pour eggs on the other side. Scramble eggs until cooked and mix with vegetables. Cook in batches if necessary.
Uncover the rice and fluff with a fork.
Add rice, tofu, and soy sauce to vegetables. Stir until well combined and heated through, 1-2 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 tbsp gluten-free soy sauce

instructions.primary_message: To serve, place fried rice in a bowl and garnish with remaining green onions. Enjoy!
Boil water in a kettle. (If you do not have a kettle, boil water in a saucepan, starting with hot tap water.)
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ cup water

instructions.primary_message: In a small bowl, pour boiling water over cashews and set aside to soak.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ cup cashews, roasted unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
21 oz gluten-free penne pasta
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ pints grape tomatoes
3 small pkgs fresh basil
1 ½ lemons
1 ½ (5 oz) pkgs baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Halve the tomatoes and set aside in a medium bowl.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and slice into ribbons. Add to the bowl with the tomatoes, setting some aside to use as garnish.
Thinly slice the sun-dried tomatoes and add to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 36 sun-dried tomatoes, oil-packed

instructions.primary_message: Juice the lemons into a blender. Peel and mince garlic; add to the blender.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Add additional sun-dried tomatoes, oil, salt, and pepper to the blender.
instructions.secondary_message:
18 sun-dried tomatoes, oil-packed
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add cashews, and the water you soaked them in, to the blender. Blend on high speed for several minutes until smooth.

Place spinach in a large colander in the sink. When the pasta is cooked, carefully empty into the colander over the spinach to drain and to wilt the spinach. Return the pasta and spinach to the pot and stir in the cashew-cream sauce, dried and fresh tomatoes, and basil.
To serve, divide pasta between plates, garnish with reserved basil, and enjoy!
Preheat oven to 425°F.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups basmati rice
3 cup water

instructions.primary_message: In a large bowl, combine the ground turkey, bread crumbs, eggs, and spices; mix with your hands until well combined.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb ground turkey
¾ cup gluten-free bread crumbs
3 eggs
¾ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp onion powder
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.

Coat the bottom of a large baking dish with oil. Using a tablespoon measure, form the turkey mixture into rounded meatballs and place in the dish. (Divide between two baking dishes if necessary.) Place in the oven and bake until golden and cooked through 15-18 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel and mince the garlic; wash, peel, and mince or grate the ginger. Place in a small saucepan.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 cloves garlic
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root

instructions.primary_message: Add soy sauce, vinegar, oil, chili-garlic sauce, and honey to the saucepan with the ginger and garlic; whisk to combine the sauce for the meatballs.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp tamari soy sauce
3 tbsp rice vinegar
3 tbsp toasted sesame oil
2 tbsp chili-garlic sauce
2 tbsp honey

instructions.primary_message: Bring the sauce to boil over medium-high heat, stirring frequently; reduce heat to low and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, 2 minutes more. Remove from heat.
Peel and mince garlic; add to a large bowl along with water, peanut butter, vinegar, and soy sauce. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
3 tbsp natural peanut butter
⅓ cup water
1 tbsp rice vinegar
1 tbsp tamari soy sauce

instructions.primary_message: Add broccoli slaw to bowl with dressing and toss to combine.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (12 oz) pkg broccoli slaw

instructions.primary_message: Remove meatballs from oven, drizzle with sauce, and toss to coat.
To serve, divide rice and peanut slaw between plates. Top rice with meatballs and sauce. Sprinkle with sesame seeds and enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp sesame seeds

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 425°F. Coat a large baking sheet pan with a thin layer of olive oil; set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Finely grate the cheese into a medium bowl; add bread crumbs and salt. Toss together with your hands until well combined, breaking up any cheese lumps. Transfer to the baking sheet pan and spread out in an even layer. Reserve bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ (8 oz) block cheddar cheese
1 ½ cup gluten-free bread crumbs
⅜ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Place pan in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, stirring halfway through, until golden, 8-9 minutes. Watch carefully so the crumbs don't burn. Remove from the oven and let cool. Leave the oven on.

If using halibut with skin, place the fillet, skin-side down, on a cutting board. Holding the tail end firmly, use a knife to cut between the flesh and skin; continue to cut through the length of the fillet (take care not to cut through the skin); discard the skin.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 ¼ lb halibut fillet

instructions.primary_message: Pat the fish dry with paper towel, then cut crosswise into 1-inch strips; transfer to a plate.
Combine flour, salt, and pepper in a small bowl; stir together. In another small bowl, whisk the eggs.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup gluten-free flour
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
3 eggs

instructions.primary_message: Scrape the cheese mixture back into the reserved bowl, then break it up into fine crumbs with a fork or by hand. Reserve the baking sheet pan for the next step.

Dredge fish strips in flour, shake off excess, then dip into the bowl with the egg. Let the egg drip off, then dredge fish strips in the cheese crumbs, pressing to adhere. Place on the baking sheet pan, spacing them 1-inch apart.
Place fish sticks in the oven and bake until cooked through, 5-7 minutes. Remove from the oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 ½ lemons
1 ½ bunches kale
1 ½ medium heads napa cabbage
1 ½ small bunches fresh dill

instructions.primary_message: Juice 3 lemons into a large bowl. Cut remaining lemons into wedges and set aside.
Add mayonnaise, oil, Dijon, maple syrup, and spices to the bowl with the lemon juice; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup mayonnaise
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 tbsp pure maple syrup
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp onion powder
½ tsp black pepper
½ tsp garlic powder

instructions.primary_message: Fold the kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Finely chop leaves and transfer to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim off and discard the root end of the cabbages; halve cabbages lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise and add to the bowl with the dressing.

Using a knife, shave the dill leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the dressing. Using your hands, massage the shredded greens with the dressing until wilted, 1-2 minutes.
To serve, divide fish sticks and coleslaw between plates. Garnish with lemon wedges and enjoy!
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add bacon and cook until crispy, 4-5 minutes per side. Cook in batches if necessary.
instructions.secondary_message: 9 slices bacon

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, toast bread if desired, cut in half, and spread with mayonnaise.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 slices gluten-free bread
2 tbsp mayonnaise

instructions.primary_message: Remove bacon from pan and set aside on a plate lined with paper towel.
Pour off all but 2 tbsp of bacon fat and reduce heat to medium. Gently crack eggs into the skillet; cook, flipping once, until medium-firm, 3-4 minutes. Cook in batches if necessary.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 eggs

instructions.primary_message: Slice cheddar.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ (8 oz) block cheddar cheese

instructions.primary_message: To serve, top half of the bread slices with bacon, cheddar, and egg; season with salt and pepper. Close sandwiches and divide between plates. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message:
3 pinch salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ cups basmati rice
4 ½ cup water

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
1 ½ crowns broccoli
1 ½ small bunches green onions (scallions)

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Peel and mince or grate the ginger. Peel and mince the garlic. Chop the broccoli into small pieces. Transfer all to a medium bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Trim off the ends of the green onions; cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle. Transfer half the onions to the bowl with the other veggies; set the other half aside to use as garnish.
Preheat a nonstick skillet over high heat. Add oil and swirl to coat bottom.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tsp toasted sesame oil

instructions.primary_message: Crack the eggs into a medium bowl and beat with a whisk or fork.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 eggs

instructions.primary_message: Add ⅓ of the egg mixture to the skillet and gently swirl the pan so that the egg forms a thin layer coating the bottom of the pan. Cook until the egg is just set and the edges begin to turn golden, about 1 minute. Carefully slide the egg onto a cutting board and allow to cool for a few minutes.
Add more oil to the pan and repeat the egg cooking instruction twice more to make three omelets.
instructions.secondary_message: 4 tsp toasted sesame oil

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium heat. Add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp toasted sesame oil

instructions.primary_message: Add the bowl of veggies to the pot. Cook, stirring occasionally until broccoli turns bright green, about 3 minutes.
Add peas and edamame to the pot and continue cooking for another 2 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ cups frozen peas
2 ¼ cups edamame

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, roll the egg omelets tightly and cut on a diagonal into ½-inch slices.
Add rice and soy sauce to the pot and cook, stirring often, until well combined and heated through, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: ½ cup tamari soy sauce

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide fried rice between plates and top with egg slices and remaining green onion. Enjoy!
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 leeks
6 medium zucchini squash
6 jalapeño peppers

instructions.primary_message: Trim off the root end and the dark green top of the leeks, leaving only the white and pale green parts. Cut leeks in half lengthwise and rinse under running water, separating the layers to remove any dirt and grit. Slice crosswise into ½-inch half-moons.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add leeks and cook, stirring occasionally, until soft, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp butter, unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, halve zucchinis lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise into half rounds. Add to the pot with the leeks.
Add flour to the pot; cook, stirring constantly, until combined, about 1 minute.
instructions.secondary_message: ¼ cup gluten-free flour

instructions.primary_message: Gradually stir milk into the pot, then add the broth, salt, and pepper. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 10 minutes, or until zucchini is tender.
instructions.secondary_message:
36 fl oz (4 ½ cups) whole milk
24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, quarter the jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs of the jalapeños with a spoon. Slice lengthwise into thin strips. (Be careful, with jalapeños, do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing).
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Coarsely grate cheddar.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (8 oz) blocks cheddar cheese

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the jalapeño strips and cook, stirring often, until soft and golden, 3-4 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tsp butter, unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Top half of the bread slices with half of the cheddar. Add jalapeño strips and cover with remaining cheese. Close sandwiches and gently press to secure ingredients.
instructions.secondary_message: 12 slices gluten-free bread

instructions.primary_message: Return skillet to the stove over medium-low heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, place sandwiches in the skillet and cook, flipping once, until bread is golden brown and cheese is melted, 3-4 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a cutting board; slice sandwiches in half.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp butter, unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Using an immersion (hand) blender (or regular blender), purée the soup until smooth.
To serve, divide soup between bowls. Serve with sandwiches and enjoy!
Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash, dry, and snap or cut off the woody ends of the asparagus. Divide between two baking sheet pans, drizzle with oil, and season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 small bunches asparagus
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the bottom half of the oven and bake until tender-crisp, 10-15 minutes.

Meanwhile, pat the chicken dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin cutlets. Season the cutlets with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat broiler on high, leaving the asparagus in the bottom of the oven until it is finished cooking.
Wash and juice the lemons into a small bowl. Add broth and Dijon; whisk until smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lemons
12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth
2 tbsp Dijon mustard

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Add butter to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp butter, unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Cooking in batches if necessary, add cutlets to the skillet and cook until lightly golden, about 2 minutes per side. Remove to a plate.
Meanwhile, slice the cheese.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ (8 oz) block mozzarella cheese

instructions.primary_message: Add garlic to the skillet and cook until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Add broth mixture and whisk, scraping up the browned bits, until mixture thickens slightly, 1-2 minutes.

Transfer the sauce into a large baking dish and lay cutlets on top. Place two slices of prosciutto on each cutlet and top with cheese. Place dish in the oven and broil until cheese is melted and golden and chicken is cooked through, 3-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 24 slices prosciutto

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide chicken cutlets, sauce, and asparagus between plates. Enjoy!
Place eggs in a large pot, cover with water and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 4 minutes. Drain hot water and add ice or run under cold water to cool.
instructions.secondary_message: 12 eggs

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to broil on high.
Place mayo, Dijon, and honey in a small bowl; whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp mayonnaise
3 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 tbsp honey

instructions.primary_message: Wash and pick leaves from basil; discard the stems and thinly slice the leaves into ribbons.
instructions.secondary_message: ½ small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Wash and slice tomatoes.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Slice cheese.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ (8 oz) block cheddar cheese

instructions.primary_message: Divide bread between two baking sheet pans and spread with Dijon-mayo; add a layer of cheese. Place one of the pans in the oven and broil until cheese is melted and bread is toasted, 2-4 minutes. Repeat with the second pan.
instructions.secondary_message: 12 slices gluten-free bread

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel and slice the eggs.
To serve, layer tomato and egg slices on toast; garnish with basil, salt, and pepper. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message:
3 pinch salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
1 ½ lb sweet potatoes
1 ½ medium heads cauliflower
1 ½ (5 oz) pkgs baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Peel and small dice the onions. Peel and mince the garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
Peel and mince or grate the ginger.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Add onion and garlic to the pot; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, rinse the lentils in a colander or strainer.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ cup red lentils

instructions.primary_message: Add ginger and spices to the pot; cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 1 minute.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp curry powder
1 tbsp coriander
1 ½ tsp cumin

instructions.primary_message: Add the lentils, broth, water, salt and pepper to the pot; bring the mixture to a boil.
instructions.secondary_message:
48 fl oz (6 cups) chicken or vegetable broth
3 cup water
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel and small dice the sweet potatoes; add to the pot.
Trim and discard the leaves and thick stem of the cauliflower heads and cut into small, bite-sized pieces; add to the pot.
Stir to combine the soup, then cover and reduce the heat to a simmer. Cook, stirring occasionally, until lentils and vegetables are tender, about 15 minutes.
Toast bread if desired and cut in half on an angle.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 slices gluten-free bread

instructions.primary_message: Uncover the soup and stir in the spinach. Cook until spinach is wilted and soup is heated through, about 4 more minutes.
To serve, divide soup between bowls and serve with bread on the side. Enjoy!
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ yellow bell peppers
1 ½ small bunches cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Seed and small dice the bell peppers.
Peel and small dice onions. Peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Heat a large pot over medium heat.

Once the pot is hot, add the oil, bell pepper, onion, garlic, and ground turkey. Break apart the turkey with a spoon until crumbly. Stirring occasionally, cook until turkey is cooked through and vegetables are tender, 7-9 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ lb ground turkey

instructions.primary_message: Add the pasta, tomatoes, water, and spices to the pot. Stir and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to medium-low and cook, stirring occasionally until pasta is cooked and most of the water is absorbed, 15 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
18 oz gluten-free rotini pasta
1 ½ (14.5 oz) cans diced tomatoes
6 ¾ cup water
3 tbsp chili powder
1 ½ tsp cumin, ground
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
1 ½ tsp onion powder
11 ¼ ml salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, coarsely grate the cheddar.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ (8 oz) block cheddar cheese

instructions.primary_message: Shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Once the pasta is done, remove from heat. If more than ¾ cup of liquid is remaining in the pot, carefully strain off excess liquid using a colander.
Add cheese, yogurt, and half of the cilantro to the pot with the pasta and stir until cheese is melted and creamy.
instructions.secondary_message: ⅜ cup plain Greek yogurt

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide pasta between bowls. Garnish with remaining cilantro. Enjoy!

If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Peel and small dice onions. Peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 medium yellow onions
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat. Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Add onion and garlic to the pot; cook, stirring occasionally, until soft, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and chop the potatoes into quarters.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ lb new potatoes

instructions.primary_message: Add flour and spices to the pot; cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 1 minute.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp gluten-free flour
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
½ tsp cayenne pepper

instructions.primary_message: Gradually add broth, whisking constantly to avoid lumps.
instructions.secondary_message: 48 fl oz (6 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Add potatoes and bring the soup to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, cut the cod into 1-inch pieces. Add cod to the pot, cover, and simmer 5 more minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ lb cod fillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and small dice tomatoes; place in a medium bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Add shrimp to the pot, cover, and cook until cod is opaque and shrimp is pink, 5-6 minutes.

Meanwhile, wash and shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves; add to the bowl with the tomatoes. Wash and juice lemons into the bowl, add oil and stir to combine. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ small bunches Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
1 ½ lemons
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Add milk to the pot, stir to combine, and cook until heated through, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) whole milk

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide soup between bowls and top with tomato-parsley mixture. Enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash, peel, and slice potatoes into ¼-inch thick strips. Place in a large bowl and add oil and salt; toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 medium yellow potatoes
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Spread potatoes out in a single layer on a large baking sheet and place in the lower third of the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated). Tossing once halfway through, roast until golden brown, 15-20 minutes. Reserve bowl for next step.
Wash, dry, and zest lemons into the reserved bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 lemons

instructions.primary_message: Add bread crumbs, oil, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the lemon zest; stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cup gluten-free bread crumbs
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: If using salmon with skin, place the fillet, skin-side down, on a cutting board. Holding the tail end firmly, use a knife to cut between the flesh and skin; continue to cut through the length of the fillet (take care not to cut through the skin); discard the skin. If you don’t have a tail end, start at one corner of the fillet and work your way in until the knife is between the skin and flesh.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 ¼ lb salmon fillet

instructions.primary_message: Slice the crosswise into 1-inch wide fingers.
Line a large baking sheet pan with aluminum foil.
Roll the salmon in the bread crumb mixture, pressing to adhere; place on the prepared baking sheet.
Place salmon in the upper third of the oven and bake until golden, crispy, and cooked through, 6-8 minutes. Watch carefully because the bread crumbs can burn quickly.
Meanwhile, juice half of the lemons into a medium bowl. Cut the remaining lemon into wedges.
Wash and dry parsley. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the lemon juice.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Add yogurt, Dijon, salt, and pepper to the bowl; stir to combine the yogurt sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup plain Greek yogurt
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Divide salmon and fries between plates; serve with lemon wedges and yogurt sauce on the side. Enjoy!
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ small bunches Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 ½ pints grape tomatoes
1 ½ yellow bell peppers

instructions.primary_message: Shave leaves off the stems of the parsley; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Place in a medium bowl.
Finely chop the olives and sun-dried tomatoes; add to the bowl with the parsley.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup Kalamata olives, pitted
18 sun-dried tomatoes, oil-packed

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl with the olives along with oil and spices. Stir to combine the tapenade.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp Italian seasoning
3 pinch black pepper
3 pinch crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add vinegar, oil, maple syrup, salt, and pepper to a large bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp red wine vinegar
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp pure maple syrup
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim off the ends of the cucumbers; slice crosswise into thin rounds. Add to the salad bowl with the dressing.
Halve the tomatoes and add to the salad bowl; stir to combine.
Trim and thinly slice the bell peppers into rounds.
Thinly slice cheese.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ (8 oz) block mozzarella cheese

instructions.primary_message: In a small bowl combine mayonnaise and vinegar; stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup mayonnaise
1 tbsp red wine vinegar

instructions.primary_message: Spread mayo over the bread and layer with cheese, prosciutto, bell pepper, and tapenade.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 slices gluten-free bread
24 slices prosciutto

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide salad and sandwiches between plates. Enjoy!
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 leeks
9 caps portobello mushrooms
1 ½ lemons
1 ½ (5 oz) pkgs baby arugula

instructions.primary_message: Trim off the root end and the dark green top of the leeks, leaving only the white and pale green parts. Cut leeks in half lengthwise and rinse under running water, separating the layers to remove any dirt and grit. Slice crosswise into ½-inch half-moons.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the leeks and cook, stirring occasionally, until soft, about 4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: ⅓ cup butter, unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Halve mushrooms then cut crosswise into thin strips. Add to the pot with the leeks.
Add flour to the pot; cook, stirring constantly, until combined, about 1 minute.
instructions.secondary_message: ⅓ cup gluten-free flour

instructions.primary_message: Gradually stir milk into the pot, then add the broth, salt, and pepper. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 10 minutes, or until mushrooms are tender.
instructions.secondary_message:
36 fl oz (4 ½ cups) whole milk
24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, zest and juice lemons into a large bowl. Add oil, maple syrup, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing. Add arugula and toss to combine; set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp pure maple syrup
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler.
Peel and mince garlic; transfer to a medium bowl. Add butter and mash with the back of a spoon until soft.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
⅓ cup butter, unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Finely grate Parmesan. Add to the bowl with the butter along with spices; mash with the back of a spoon to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ oz Parmesan cheese
1 ½ tsp Italian seasoning
¼ tsp garlic powder
¼ tsp onion powder
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Slice rolls in half and place on a large baking sheet pan, cut-side up. Spread with garlic butter and sprinkle with parsley. Place in the oven and cook until golden around the edges, 2-3 minutes. Remove from the oven and cut in half.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 gluten-free buns or rolls
¾ tsp parsley flakes

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, using an immersion (hand) or regular blender, purée the soup until almost smooth, leaving some flecks for texture.
Divide soup between bowls; serve with lemony arugula and garlic bread on the side. Enjoy!
Preheat oven to 220°C (425°F).
If using frozen shrimp, place in a bowl and cover with cold water to thaw. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 ¼ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Heat a sauté pan over medium heat.
Peel and mince onion and garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onion
6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Coat bottom of sauté pan with oil. Add onion, and stirring frequently, cook until softened, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: about 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Add garlic, oregano, and pepper; cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tsp oregano
⅜ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add tomatoes and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer until tomato juices thicken, 5-7 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (14.5 oz) cans diced tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Drain shrimp and rinse under cold water until there are no more ice chunks. Place on paper towels and pat dry.
Wash and dry parsley. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Remove sauté pan from heat. Stir in ¾ of the minced parsley (save the rest for garnishing), shrimp, salt, and pepper. Sprinkle feta over top.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper
1 ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.primary_message: Place in the oven and bake until shrimp are opaque and cheese melts, 8-12 minutes.
Drizzle the bread slices with olive oil, then place in the oven, directly on a rack, until crispy, 1-2 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 slices gluten-free bread
3 tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: To serve, place shrimp on a plate and garnish with remaining parsley. Serve with crusty bread. Enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
5 limes
3 crowns broccoli
3 red bell peppers
1 small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince the garlic. Place in a large bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Juice three limes into the bowl with the garlic. Add oil, peanut butter, soy sauce, honey, and Worcestershire; whisk to combine. Pour half of the marinade into a small bowl and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup extra virgin olive oil
⅓ cup natural peanut butter
⅓ cup tamari soy sauce
1 tbsp honey
1 ½ tsp Worcestershire sauce

instructions.primary_message: Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Add the chicken to the large bowl with the marinade. Toss to coat and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 ¼ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.primary_message: Separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces.
Seed and slice the bell peppers into strips.
Preheat a grill pan or skillet over medium heat.
Coat the grill pan with oil.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Working in batches if necessary add the broccoli and bell peppers to the grill pan and cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are crisp-tender, 6-7 minutes. Remove and set aside on a plate; cover with foil.
Meanwhile, peel and slice the onions into thick rings.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ medium yellow onions

instructions.primary_message: Add the onions to the grill pan. Cook, flipping once, until the onions start to soften and grill marks appear, 6-7 minutes. Remove and add to the plate with the veggies. Cover with the foil.
Coat the grill pan with additional oil.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Working in batches if necessary, add the chicken to the grill pan; cook, flipping once, until cooked through and golden, 5-6 minutes per side.
Meanwhile, shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Slice the remaining limes into wedges.
Divide the chicken and veggies between plates; garnish with cilantro and lime wedges and serve with the reserved marinade for dipping. Enjoy!
Preheat oven to 400°F.
Wash and dry parsley. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Place half in a large bowl, reserving the rest for garnish.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ small bunches Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince onion and garlic. Transfer both to the bowl with the parsley.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 medium red onion
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Add turkey, eggs, bread crumbs, and spices to the bowl with the parsley and mix with your hands until well combined.

Divide shrimp and salad between plates. Serve with cocktail sauce on the side and enjoy!

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, cut bread into ¾-inch cubes.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 slices gluten-free bread

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Add bread cubes to the skillet and season with spices. Toast the bread, tossing occasionally, until croutons are golden brown, 7-8 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ tsp salt
½ tsp Italian seasoning
½ tsp garlic powder

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 lemons
1 ½ pints grape tomatoes
3 (5 oz) pkgs baby arugula

instructions.primary_message: Juice lemons into a large bowl. Add oil, Dijon, honey, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 tbsp honey
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Drain and rinse beans, then add to the bowl with the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (15 oz) cans cannellini (white kidney) beans

instructions.primary_message: Halve tomatoes and add to the bowl.
Chop or tear prosciutto into bite-sized pieces and add to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 30 slices prosciutto

instructions.primary_message: Add arugula to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
Use a vegetable peeler to shave the Parmesan.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 oz Parmesan cheese

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide salad between plates. Top with croutons and Parmesan. Enjoy!
If using frozen shrimp, place in a medium bowl and cover with cold water to thaw. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 ¼ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic. Wash and medium dice tomatoes.
instructions.secondary_message:
9 cloves garlic
9 tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Heat a sauté pan over medium-high heat.
Drain shrimp and rinse under cold water until there are no more ice chunks; place on paper towels and pat dry.
Coat bottom of pan with oil. Add ½ of the garlic (save the rest for later), shrimp, and paprika. Cook until shrimp are opaque, 1-2 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
about 3 tbsp virgin coconut oil
¾ tsp paprika

instructions.primary_message: Return pan to stove and reduce heat to medium. Add more oil, remaining garlic, and pepper. Cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds.
instructions.secondary_message:
about 1 ½ tbsp virgin coconut oil
1 ½ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add tomatoes. Cook until liquid is reduced, 2-3 minutes.
Drain and rinse beans.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (15 oz) cans cannellini (white kidney) beans

instructions.primary_message: Add beans and broth to pan. Cook until stew thickens, about 10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 fl oz (1 ½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Toast bread.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 gluten-free buns or rolls

instructions.primary_message: Stir in shrimp and cook until heated through.
To serve, add stew to a bowl and have with crusty bread on the side. Enjoy!

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 jalapeño peppers
1 small bunch cilantro
6 peaches
3 limes
1 ½ avocados
1 ½ heads butter (Boston) lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Combine spices in a small bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp chili powder
¾ tsp cumin
¾ tsp salt
3 pinch garlic powder
3 pinch onion powder
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Heat a large grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
While the grill pan heats up, pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and season with spice mixture on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 pork chops, boneless

instructions.primary_message: Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil. Cooking in batches if necessary, add pork and cook, flipping occasionally, until cooked through, about 8 minutes. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel and small dice onions. Peel and mince garlic. Place both in a large bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium red onions
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Halve jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Finely dice and add to the bowl. (Be careful, with jalapeños, do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.

Halve and pit peaches. Working in batches if necessary, add peach halves to the grill pan, cut-side down, and cook until the flesh is soft and charred, about 4 minutes. Once done, transfer to a cutting board, medium dice, and add to the bowl with the cilantro.
Juice limes into the bowl, season with salt, and stir to combine the salsa.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, thinly slice the pork chops crosswise into strips.
Halve and pit avocados; slice thinly while still in the skin and scoop out with a spoon.
Separate the lettuce into leaves. Pile leaves, in stacks of two per wrap, onto plates. Top with pork slices, peach salsa, and avocado. Enjoy!
Fill a large pot halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp salt
15 oz gluten-free rotini pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lemons
3 English cucumbers
3 small pkgs fresh basil
3 small pkgs chives

instructions.primary_message: Juice lemons into a large bowl.
Add mayo, feta, salt, and pepper to the bowl; stir to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup mayonnaise
1 ½ (4 oz) pkgs crumbled feta cheese
1 ½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim and small dice cucumbers; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons; add to the bowl.
Chop chives into small pieces; add to the bowl.
Add corn to the pot with the pasta during the last 3 minutes of cooking.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 cups frozen corn

instructions.primary_message: When the pasta and corn are done, drain and rinse under cold water; add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide pasta salad between bowls and enjoy!

In a medium saucepan, combine quinoa, water, and salt; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15-18 minutes. Transfer cooked quinoa to a large baking sheet pan and spread out in a thin layer to cool.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups quinoa
3 cup water
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 limes
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
1 small pkg fresh mint
1 small bunch cilantro
1 ½ small heads red cabbage
1 ½ (5 oz) pkgs baby spinach
1 ½ avocados

instructions.primary_message: Place edamame in a colander and rinse under hot, running water (from the tap) to defrost; set aside to drain.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cups edamame

instructions.primary_message: Zest and juice limes into a large salad bowl.
Peel and mince garlic and ginger; transfer both to the salad bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Trim and mince green onions; add to the bowl.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop peanuts and add half to the bowl (reserve the rest for garnish).
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ cup peanuts, roasted unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Add soy sauce, oils, and crushed red pepper to the bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup tamari soy sauce
¼ cup extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp toasted sesame oil
3 pinch crushed red pepper

Add spinach, edamame, and quinoa to the bowl; toss once more to combine the salad.
Halve and pit avocados; slice crosswise while still in the skin and scoop out with a spoon.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls. Top with avocado and reserved peanuts. Enjoy!
Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler. Line two baking sheet pans with aluminum foil.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
6 caps portobello mushrooms
3 red bell peppers
2 yellow bell peppers
1 small pkg fresh basil
1 ½ (5 oz) pkgs spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Remove mushroom stems and carefully scrape out the gills, place mushroom caps on one of the baking sheets. Drizzle with oil and season with salt and pepper. Place in the oven and broil, until soft and lightly charred around the edges, 4-5 minutes. Remove from oven.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, seed and slice bell peppers into thin strips; place on the other baking sheet. Drizzle with oil and season with salt and pepper. Once the mushrooms are done cooking, place peppers in the oven and broil, until soft and lightly charred around the edges, 4-5 minutes. Remove from oven.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, coarsely grate cheese and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (8 oz) blocks cheddar cheese

instructions.primary_message: Combine vinegar, oil, honey, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.

⅓ cup red wine vinegar
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

3 pinch salt
3 pinch black pepper

3 tbsp gluten-free flour

instructions.primary_message: Thinly slice mushrooms. Fill buns with mushrooms and drizzle with cheese sauce.

Preheat oven to broil and position rack under the broiler.

instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups quinoa
24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

2 ¼ lb salmon fillets
3 pinches salt
3 pinches black pepper

instructions.primary_message: In a small bowl, combine soy sauce, maple syrup, Dijon, and pepper.

3 tbsp gluten-free soy sauce
3 tbsp pure maple syrup
3 tsp Dijon mustard
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
4 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tbsp red wine vinegar
3 pinches salt
3 pinches black pepper

3 (8 oz) pkg sugar snap peas
3 medium carrots

instructions.primary_message: Uncover quinoa and fluff with a fork. Add to bowl and toss salad.

instructions.secondary_message: 6 eggs

Place peas in colander and run under cold water to thaw. Transfer to a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry; set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ cups frozen peas

instructions.primary_message: Place oil, vinegar, mayo, capers, and Dijon in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp red wine vinegar
3 tbsp mayonnaise
1 ½ tbsp capers
1 tbsp Dijon mustard

instructions.primary_message: Drain tuna and add to the bowl with the dressing. Add peas, stir to combine, and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (6 oz) cans chunk light tuna in water

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and slice tomatoes into rounds; place in a large bowl.

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems. Add to the bowl with the tomatoes.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Drain and thinly slice artichokes. Halve olives and add both to the bowl.

1 ½ (6 oz) jars artichoke hearts, marinated
1 ½ cups Kalamata olives, pitted

instructions.primary_message: Peel and thinly slice shallots into rings. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the sandwich topping; set aside.

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Cut rolls in half and place, cut-side up, on a large baking sheet pan. Drizzle with oil, then sprinkle with minced garlic and Italian seasoning. Place in the oven and toast, until golden and slightly crisp, 4-5 minutes.

6 gluten-free buns or rolls
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp Italian seasoning

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel and slice eggs into rounds.
Spoon tuna mixture over the toasted rolls; layer with sandwich topping and sliced eggs.
To serve, divide sandwiches between plates and enjoy!
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ oranges
3 limes
6 caps portobello mushrooms
3 jalapeño peppers
1 ½ avocados
1 small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Juice oranges into a large bowl. Juice half the limes into the same bowl; cut remaining limes into wedges and set aside.
Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl with the citrus juice, along with soy sauce, maple syrup, and spices. Whisk to combine the marinade.

3 cloves garlic

Drain and rinse the beans. Add to the skillet with the mushrooms and continue to cook, stirring often, until beans are warmed through, 3-4 minutes.

1 tbsp salt
12 oz gluten-free linguine pasta

2 ¼ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Working in batches if necessary, add chicken to the pot and cook until golden brown, about 2 minutes per side. If working in batches, transfer chicken to a plate and cover with foil (the chicken will not be cooked all the way through).
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Reduce heat to low and return chicken to the pot (if necessary). Add garlic, lemon zest and juice, and water to the pot; stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message: ⅓ cup water

instructions.primary_message: Cover the pot and cook, turning chicken once and basting occasionally, until it's cooked through, about 15 minutes. Remove chicken to a plate and cover with foil.
Return pot (with leftover cooking juices) to medium heat. Add ricotta and reserved pasta cooking water. Whisk until smooth.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (15 oz) pkg ricotta cheese

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the spinach (skip if it came pre-washed). While stirring, add spinach to the pot in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.

instructions.primary_message: Add pasta to the pot with spinach-ricotta sauce; toss to combine and cook until heated through, 3-4 minutes.
Slice chicken into strips.

Heat a large saucepan over medium heat.
Peel and mince onion and garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onion
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Coat bottom of saucepan with oil. Add onion and, stirring frequently, cook until softened, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp virgin coconut oil

instructions.primary_message: Add garlic and cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds. Add pumpkin, broth, curry powder, turmeric, and salt. Stir until well combined and cook for 2-3 minutes.

1 ½ (15 oz) can pure pumpkin purée
24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth
1 ½ tsp curry powder
1 ½ tsp turmeric
⅜ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Add coconut milk and stir to combine. Simmer until rest of the meal is ready.

Slice chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season with salt and pepper.

1 ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add chicken and cook until cooked through, 2-3 minutes per side.

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry parsley. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Toast bread.

instructions.primary_message: Shred chicken with your hands or cut into bite-sized pieces.

Preheat oven to 425°F. Line two baking sheet pans with aluminum foil.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lb green beans
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
1 ½ oranges

instructions.primary_message: Place coconut and almond flour in a large bowl; whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups shredded unsweetened coconut
¾ cup almond meal/flour

instructions.primary_message: Whisk the eggs in a second large bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 eggs

instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
1 ½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Toss chicken in the egg to coat. Working in batches, transfer chicken to the coconut mixture and turn to coat, pressing gently to adhere. Place chicken on the other the baking sheet, in a single layer.
Drizzle oil over the beans and chicken. Place both baking sheets in the oven and bake until chicken is golden brown and cooked through, and beans are fork-tender, 18-20 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, juice oranges into a medium saucepan. Add ketchup, oil, soy sauce, vinegar, and sugar; whisk to combine. Bring to a simmer over medium heat.

3 tbsp ketchup
1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tbsp tamari soy sauce
1 ½ tbsp rice vinegar
1 ½ tbsp brown sugar
