instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp water
1 tbsp cornstarch

instructions.primary_message: Add cornstarch slurry to the saucepan in a steady stream while whisking quickly. Cook, whisking often, until sweet and sour sauce thickens, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat.
Drizzle sweet and sour sauce over the baked chicken and gently toss to coat.
To serve, divide chicken and beans between plates. Sprinkle chicken with sesame seeds and enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ tsp sesame seeds

instructions.primary_message: Place eggs in a medium saucepan, cover with water and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 4 minutes. Drain hot water and add ice or run under cold water to cool.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 eggs

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince the garlic and ginger.

½ cup tahini

3 tbsp tamari soy sauce

Snap or cut off woody ends of the asparagus and cut into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the mushrooms.
Once the broth in the pot is simmering, add the noodles, mushrooms, and asparagus. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the noodles and vegetables are tender, 6-8 minutes.

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces. Stir half of the onions into the soup (reserve the rest for garnish).

1 ½ medium heads cauliflower

3 medium carrots
1 ½ (5 oz) pkgs baby spinach
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)

instructions.secondary_message: 2 ¼ lb lean ground beef

Meanwhile, peel and mince the garlic and ginger.

instructions.primary_message: Trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces.
Place garlic, ginger, onions, tomato paste, vinegar, oil, maple syrup, soy sauce, sesame seeds, and crushed red pepper in the bowl used for the veggies. Whisk to combine the sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 tbsp tomato paste

1 ½ medium heads cauliflower
3 yellow bell peppers

Peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Melt butter in pan. Add garlic and cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds. Add flour and whisk until smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp butter, unsalted
3 tbsp gluten-free flour

instructions.primary_message: Add milk, Dijon, salt, and pepper. Whisk until well combined. Cook until thickened, about 8 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
24 fl oz (3 cups) whole milk
3 tsp Dijon mustard
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to broil.
Grate 3 cups of cheddar and ⅓ cup Parmesan.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (8 oz) block cheddar cheese
1 ½ oz Parmesan cheese

instructions.primary_message: Add ¾ of the cheddar to pan and stir until sauce is smooth.
Add pasta and broccoli to sauce and stir to combine. Sprinkle with remaining cheddar and Parmesan.
Place under the broiler until cheese is melted and golden brown, 2-3 minutes.
To serve, place in a bowl. Enjoy!
Fill a large pot halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp salt
15 oz gluten-free linguine pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place cashews in a medium bowl. Using a measuring cup, carefully remove 3 cups of boiling water from the pot and pour over the cashews; let sit for 15 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ cups cashews, roasted unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Peel and slice garlic.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Once cashews are done soaking, drain and return to the bowl.
Add garlic, cashews, pumpkin, broth, nutritional yeast, flour, and spices to a blender and purée until smooth. (If necessary, work in batches to best fit your blender.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (15 oz) cans pure pumpkin purée
18 fl oz (2 ¼ cups) chicken or vegetable broth
½ cup nutritional yeast flakes
2 tbsp gluten-free flour
1 ½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper
3 pinch nutmeg, ground

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the spinach. (Skip this step if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (5 oz) pkgs baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Drain pasta and set aside to drain further.
Return pot to medium heat. Add the sauce from the blender and bring to a simmer.
Once simmering, add spinach to the pot in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
Add pasta, stir to combine, and cook, stirring occasionally, until warmed through, 4-5 minutes.
Divide pasta between bowls and enjoy!
Heat a large saucepan over medium heat.
Peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic. Wash, seed, and mince jalapeños.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium red onion
6 cloves garlic
3 jalapeño peppers

instructions.primary_message: Coat bottom of saucepan with oil. Add onion and jalapeños. Stirring frequently, cook until softened, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tbsp virgin coconut oil

instructions.primary_message: Drain and rinse beans.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (15 oz) cans kidney beans

instructions.primary_message: Add garlic, chili powder, and cumin to saucepan. Stir and cook for 30 seconds.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp chili powder
3 tsp cumin

instructions.primary_message: Add beef and, breaking apart with a spoon, cook until crumbly and browned, 2-3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 ¼ lb lean ground beef

instructions.primary_message: Add beans, tomatoes, salt, and pepper. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook until chili thickens, about 10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (14.5 oz) cans diced tomatoes
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Halve and pit avocado; scoop out and medium dice the flesh.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ avocados

instructions.primary_message: Toast bread if desired.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 gluten-free buns or rolls

instructions.primary_message: To serve, place chili in a bowl and garnish with avocado. Enjoy with bread!

Using a strainer or colander, rinse lentils under cold water; drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add broth and salt, then bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook until tender, 15-20 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups brown lentils
36 fl oz (4 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lb cremini mushrooms
3 green bell peppers
1 ½ avocados
1 ½ (5 oz) pkgs baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince onions and garlic; transfer both to a large bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Roughly chop mushrooms. Trim, seed, and roughly chop peppers. Add both to the bowl.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Add vegetables, sugar, and spices to the skillet; stir to combine. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables are tender-crisp, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp brown sugar
1 ½ tsp cumin
1 ½ tsp paprika
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp chili powder

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, Dijon, sugar, and salt in the bowl used for the veggies. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp apple cider vinegar
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 tbsp brown sugar
3 pinch salt

instructions.primary_message: Add tomato sauce to the skillet, stir to combine, and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium-low, and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables are tender, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (8 oz) cans tomato sauce

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, halve and pit avocados. Slice thinly while still in skin, then scoop out into the bowl with the dressing. Add spinach and toss to combine the salad.
Toast buns if desired.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 gluten-free buns or rolls

instructions.primary_message: When the lentils are tender, drain, and add to the skillet with the vegetables; stir to combine the sloppy joe mix.
To serve, place the bottom half of a bun on each plate. Top with sloppy joe mix and close with top half of the bun. Divide salad between plates and enjoy!
Place a medium bowl (preferably metal) in the freezer to chill. (If space is limited, place in the refrigerator.)
Preheat oven to 400°F. Line a large baking sheet pan with parchment paper.
Wash, dry, zest, and juice limes into a large skillet.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 limes

instructions.primary_message: Add sugar and water to the skillet; place over medium-low heat and cook, stirring occasionally, until sugar dissolves. Bring to a boil, then remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup granulated sugar
3 fl oz (⅜ cup) water

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry blackberries. Add to the skillet with the sugar syrup, stir to coat, and set aside to cool.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (6 oz) pkgs blackberries

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt in another medium bowl; whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cup gluten-free flour
1 ½ tbsp granulated sugar
2 ½ tsp baking powder
3 pinch salt

instructions.primary_message: Using a box grater, coarsely grate cold butter into the bowl with the flour. Using two hands, combine the flour and butter by rubbing the mixture between your thumbs and fingers until it looks crumbly. Add cream and stir until the dough comes together.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup butter, unsalted
6 fl oz (¾ cup) heavy cream

instructions.primary_message: Divide the dough into 6 equal-sized pieces and pat each into a disk, 3-inches in diameter by ¾-inch tall; place on the baking sheet, spacing 2-inches apart.
Remove bowl from the freezer. Measure cold cream into the bowl. Brush tops of the shortcakes with a small amount of the cream (reserving the rest for the whipped cream) and sprinkle with sugar.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) heavy cream
1 ½ tsp granulated sugar

instructions.primary_message: Place shortcakes in the oven and bake until lightly golden around the edges, about 18 minutes. Remove from oven and let cool.

Meanwhile, add sugar and vanilla to the bowl with the cream; use a whisk (or hand blender) to beat the cream vigorously, until medium-soft peaks form, about 4 minutes if whisking. (When you pull the whisk out of the bowl, the cream should hold its shape, with a peak that curls over slightly.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp granulated sugar
¾ tsp vanilla extract

instructions.primary_message: Place whipped cream in the refrigerator while the shortcakes finish baking.
To serve, divide blackberries with lime syrup, shortcakes, and whipped cream between bowls. Enjoy!
Place a medium bowl (preferably metal) in the freezer to chill. (If space is limited, place in the refrigerator.)
Preheat oven to 400°F and position racks in the upper and lower thirds of the oven. Line a large baking sheet pan with parchment paper.
Wash, dry, and quarter peaches lengthwise (around the pit). Twist the quarters to separate, then remove and discard pits. Transfer quarters, cut-side facing up, to a large baking dish.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 peaches

instructions.primary_message: Drizzle maple syrup over the peaches, dot with small pieces of butter, and sprinkle with cinnamon. Place baking dish on the top rack of the oven and bake until peaches begin to swell and juices bubble, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp pure maple syrup
2 tbsp butter, unsalted
½ tsp cinnamon
3 pinch cardamom, ground

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, combine flour, almonds, sugar, baking powder, and salt in another medium bowl; whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cup gluten-free flour
⅓ cup almonds, sliced
1 ½ tbsp granulated sugar
2 ½ tsp baking powder
3 pinch salt

instructions.primary_message: Using a box grater, coarsely grate cold butter into the bowl with the flour. Using two hands, combine the flour, almonds, and butter by rubbing the mixture between your thumbs and fingers until it looks crumbly. Add cream and stir until the dough comes together.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup butter, unsalted
6 fl oz (¾ cup) heavy cream

instructions.primary_message: Divide the dough into 6 equal-sized pieces and pat each into a disk, 3-inches in diameter by ¾-inch tall; place on the baking sheet, spacing 2-inches apart.
Remove bowl from the freezer. Measure cold cream into the bowl. Brush tops of the shortcakes with a small amount of the cream (reserving the rest for the whipped cream) and sprinkle with sugar.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) heavy cream
1 ½ tsp granulated sugar

instructions.primary_message: Place shortcakes on the bottom rack of the oven and bake until lightly golden around the edges, about 18 minutes. Remove from oven and let cool.

Meanwhile, add sugar and vanilla to the bowl with the cream; use a whisk (or hand blender) to beat the cream vigorously, until medium-soft peaks form, about 4 minutes if whisking. (When you pull the whisk out of the bowl, the cream should hold its shape, with a peak that curls over slightly.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp granulated sugar
¾ tsp vanilla extract

instructions.primary_message: Place whipped cream in the refrigerator while the shortcakes finish baking.
To serve, divide peaches, shortcakes, and whipped cream between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
Fill a large pot halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
about 21 cups water
3 tbsp salt
18 oz (1 quarter coin = 2 oz) gluten-free spaghetti pasta

instructions.primary_message: If using frozen shrimp, place in a large bowl, cover with cold water, and set aside to thaw. If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 ¼ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry bell peppers and parsley.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 red bell peppers
1 ½ small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Seed and cut bell peppers into small strips. Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message: 9 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Drain shrimp in a colander and rinse under cold water until there are no more ice chunks. Spread out on a clean towel and pat dry.
Add butter to skillet and let it melt. Add shrimp and cook, stirring frequently, until opaque and pink, 2-3 minutes. Transfer to a plate.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp butter, unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Reduce heat to medium and add more butter to skillet. Then add garlic, bell peppers, and crushed red pepper. Cook, stirring frequently, until peppers are tender-crisp, 2-3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp butter, unsalted
⅜ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add broth to skillet and cook until it reduces, 1-2 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 fl oz (¾ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Finely grate ⅓ cup of Parmesan.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ oz Parmesan cheese

instructions.primary_message: Drain pasta in a colander.
Add pasta, shrimp, parsley, and Parmesan to skillet. Pour in remaining broth and drizzle with lemon juice. Season with salt and pepper and toss until well combined.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 fl oz (¾ cup) chicken or vegetable broth
juice of 1 ½ lemon
⅜ tsp salt
3 pinches black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Serve pasta on a plate or in a bowl and enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 425°F. Line two baking sheet pans with parchment paper.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 medium yellow potatoes
1 ½ eggplants
6 tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Slice potatoes into thin wedges and transfer to a large bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the potatoes, along with oil, rosemary, and salt; toss to combine and spread out in a single layer on the baking sheet.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 cloves garlic
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp rosemary
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Place potatoes in the oven and bake, tossing once, until tender and golden, about 30 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim, halve, and cut eggplants into ¼-inch-thick slices. Transfer to the bowl used for the potatoes.
Add oil, vinegar, and salt to the bowl; toss to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp balsamic vinegar
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the grill pan is hot, add eggplant and grill until tender, flipping once, 3-4 minutes per side. Work in batches if necessary.
Meanwhile, place goat cheese, oil, and Italian seasoning in a medium bowl. Stir to combine and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (4 oz) logs goat cheese
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp Italian seasoning

instructions.primary_message: Thinly slice tomatoes.
If desired, place buns, cut-side down, on the grill pan to toast, 1-2 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 gluten-free buns or rolls

instructions.primary_message: Spread buns evenly with goat cheese. Top the bottom halves with eggplant and tomato, closing with the top half of the bun.
To serve, divide sandwiches and potato wedges between plates. Enjoy!
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
3 limes
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
1 small pkg fresh mint
1 ½ small pineapples
2 red bell peppers

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince ginger, garlic, and shallots. Place in a large bowl along with soy sauce, oil, and spices; stir to combine the rub.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 cloves garlic
3 shallots
3 tbsp tamari soy sauce
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp thyme, dried
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp cinnamon, ground
3 pinch crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pat chicken dry with paper towels and add to the bowl with the rub; turn to coat.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 ¾ lb chicken drumsticks

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil. Working in batches if necessary, add chicken and grill, turning occasionally, until cooked through, about 20 minutes. Remove to a large plate and cover with foil.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, preheat oven to 400°F.
Juice limes into another large bowl.
Trim green onions; cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle. Add to the bowl with the lime juice.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Cut off skin from pineapples, core, and cut into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
Seed and small dice bell peppers; add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
Spread coconut on a baking sheet pan, place in the oven, and toast until golden, 2-3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ cup shredded unsweetened coconut

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide chicken and salad between plates. Sprinkle salad with toasted coconut and enjoy!
Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash, dry, and mince tomatoes; place in a medium bowl. Season with salt and pepper, stir to combine, and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tomatoes
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Divide bread slices between two baking sheet pans and drizzle oil over both sides; sprinkle tops with garlic. Place in the oven and bake, flipping halfway through, until toasted, 3-5 minutes. Remove from oven (keep oven on).
instructions.secondary_message:
12 slices gluten-free bread
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, honey, and Dijon in a large bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp red wine vinegar
1 tbsp honey
1 tbsp Dijon mustard

instructions.primary_message: Wash spinach (skip if it came pre-washed) and add to the bowl with the dressing; toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (5 oz) pkgs baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Spread tomato mixture over toasts and return to the oven. Bake until tomato topping is heated through, 2-3 minutes; remove from oven.
Halve olives. Cut or tear prosciutto into bite sized pieces.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup Kalamata olives, pitted
18 slices prosciutto

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide toasts and salad between plates. Top salad with olives, prosciutto, and almonds. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ cup almonds, sliced

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, peel and mince ginger; peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a small saucepan over medium heat.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add ginger and garlic to the pan and cook, stirring occasionally, about 1 minute.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Add soy sauce, sugar, and crushed red pepper to the pan and cook, stirring frequently, until thickened and reduced by half, 5-6 minutes. Remove glaze from the heat and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup tamari soy sauce
¼ cup brown sugar
¾ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place vinegar, chili-garlic sauce, and salt in a large bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup rice vinegar
1 tbsp chili-garlic sauce
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, peel, and grate carrots. Add to the bowl with the dressing, along with the broccoli slaw; toss to combine and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 medium carrots
1 ½ (12 oz) pkg broccoli slaw

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the grill pan heats up, pat steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb striploin (New York strip) steak
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Working in batches if necessary, add steak to the pan and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate along with half the glaze, and turn to coat. Loosely cover with foil.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, roughly chop peanuts.
instructions.secondary_message: ⅓ cup peanuts, roasted unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Warm tortillas in the grill pan, oven, or microwave (optional), 15-30 seconds.
instructions.secondary_message: 18 small corn tortillas

instructions.primary_message: Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide tortillas between plates; top with steak, remaining glaze, slaw, and peanuts. Enjoy!
Fill a large pot halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain.
instructions.secondary_message:
about 21 cups water
3 tbsp salt
18 oz (6 ¾ cups) gluten-free penne pasta

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to broil and position rack under the broiler.
Peel and small dice onion. Wash and slice mushrooms.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onion
1 ½ lb white mushrooms

instructions.primary_message: Heat a sauté pan over medium heat.
Melt butter in pan. Add onion and mushrooms. Stirring frequently, cook until softened, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 tbsp butter, unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Grate ¾ cup of Parmesan.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 oz Parmesan cheese

instructions.primary_message: Sprinkle onion and mushrooms with flour; stir to coat.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp gluten-free flour

instructions.primary_message: Add milk, and stirring constantly, cook until slightly thickened, about 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 24 fl oz (3 cups) whole milk

instructions.primary_message: Add tuna, peas, Parmesan, paprika, salt, and pepper. Stir until well combined. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (6 oz) cans chunk light tuna in water
3 cups frozen peas
3 tsp paprika
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add pasta and toss to coat. Place in the oven and broil until golden, 3-4 minutes.
To serve, place pasta in a bowl. Enjoy!
Fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
1 ½ English cucumbers
3 red chili peppers
3 avocados
1 ½ heads romaine lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Once the water in the pot is boiling, add edamame and cook until tender, 7-8 minutes. Drain and rinse under cold water. Set aside to drain further.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 cups edamame

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel and mince or grate ginger; transfer to a large bowl.
Add peanut butter, water, soy sauce, vinegar, and chili-garlic sauce to the bowl with the ginger; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup natural peanut butter
3 tbsp water
3 tbsp tamari soy sauce
3 tbsp rice vinegar
1 tbsp chili-garlic sauce

instructions.primary_message: Trim and slice cucumbers into thin rounds; add to the bowl with the dressing.

Quarter chili peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Thinly slice and add to the bowl. (Be careful, with chili peppers, do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Halve and pit the avocados; slice crosswise while still in the skin and scoop out with a spoon. Add to the bowl.
Cut romaine crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips; add to the bowl.
Add edamame to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
Roughly chop peanuts.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ cup peanuts, roasted unsalted

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls, top with peanuts, and enjoy!
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 tomatoes
1 small bunch cilantro
3 jalapeño peppers
1 ½ limes
3 avocados

instructions.primary_message: Small dice tomatoes and transfer to a large bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the tomatoes.

Quarter jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Finely dice and add to the bowl. (Be careful, with jalapeños, do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Juice limes into the bowl.
Halve and pit the avocados; scoop out with a spoon and small dice. Add to the bowl along with spices and gently stir to combine the salsa. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ tsp chili powder
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp cumin, ground

instructions.primary_message: Place corn in a colander and rinse under hot water (from the tap) to thaw. Set aside to drain.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ cups frozen corn

instructions.primary_message: Place corn meal, flour, nutritional yeast, almond meal, baking powder, and salt in another large bowl; whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ cups polenta (cornmeal)
1 ½ cup gluten-free flour
½ cup nutritional yeast flakes
⅓ cup almond meal/flour
1 ½ tbsp baking powder
3 pinch salt

instructions.primary_message: Whisk milk and maple syrup in a medium bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
24 fl oz (3 cups) whole milk
2 tbsp pure maple syrup

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, create a well in the center of the flour mixture. Add the milk mixture and corn; whisk until just combined.

instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp butter, unsalted

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide pancakes and salsa between plates. Enjoy!

Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
6 caps portobello mushrooms
1 ½ avocados
3 tomatoes
3 medium carrots
1 ½ (5 oz) pkgs baby arugula

instructions.primary_message: Place oil, soy sauce, vinegar, maple syrup, paprika, and pepper in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the marinade.

⅓ cup extra virgin olive oil

1 tbsp pure maple syrup
¾ tsp paprika
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Remove mushroom stems and carefully scrape out the gills. Transfer to a large baking sheet pan, drizzle with marinade, and turn to coat. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Place mushrooms in the oven and roast until tender, 10-12 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside.
Meanwhile, halve and pit the avocados. Slice thinly while still in skin, then scoop out into the reserved bowl.
Add nutritional yeast, mayo, and spices to the bowl with the avocado; mash with a potato masher or fork until smooth. Set avocado mayo aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup nutritional yeast flakes
½ cup mayonnaise
¾ tsp garlic powder
3 pinch salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Slice tomatoes. Peel, trim, and coarsely grate the carrots. Transfer both to a large plate and set aside.
Toast bread if desired.
instructions.secondary_message: 12 slices gluten-free bread

instructions.primary_message: Slice mushrooms into strips.
Place bread slices on a flat surface and spread evenly with a avocado mayo. Top half the slices with mushrooms, tomato, carrot, and arugula. Cover sandwiches with remaining bread slices.
To serve, divide sandwiches between plates and enjoy!
Preheat oven to 425°F. Coat a large baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 tbsp toasted sesame oil

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.

1 small bunch cilantro
3 limes
6 medium zucchini squash
1 ½ English cucumbers
3 tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic and ginger. Place both in a large bowl.

6 cloves garlic
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root

instructions.primary_message: Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the bowl (reserving the rest for garnish).
Juice limes into the bowl. Add peanut butter, soy sauce, vinegar, and chili-garlic sauce; whisk to combine the sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup natural peanut butter
⅓ cup tamari soy sauce

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and small dice carrots. Trim and small dice celery; transfer both to a medium bowl.
Peel and small dice onions. Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl with the veggies.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
Meanwhile, place lentils in the colander, rinse, and set aside to drain.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ cup red lentils, dried

instructions.primary_message: Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and spices to the pot; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are softened, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp Italian seasoning
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the veggies cook, trim off and discard the root end of each cabbage; halve lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise.

Add cabbage, lentils, and broth to the pot; stir to combine, cover, and bring to a simmer. Reduce heat to medium-low and continue to simmer, stirring occasionally, until lentils and vegetables are tender, 15-20 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 72 fl oz (9 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler.
Peel and mince additional garlic.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Slice buns in half and divide between two baking sheet pans, cut-side up. Drizzle with oil and sprinkle with garlic and spices.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 gluten-free buns or rolls
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp Italian seasoning
3 pinch salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Working in batches, place buns in the oven and toast until golden, 1-2 minutes. Remove from oven.
Halve and pit the avocados; slice thinly while still in skin, then scoop out with a spoon. Arrange avocado slices on top of the garlic toast.
Divide soup between bowls and serve with avocado-garlic toast on the side. Enjoy!
Preheat oven to 375°F. Line a large baking sheet pan with parchment paper.
Wash and dry grapes; separate into small bunches and place on the baking sheet.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ lb red grapes

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and slide thyme leaves off the stems; discard stems. Sprinkle thyme over the grapes, then drizzle with oil.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small pkg fresh thyme
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until grapes begin to swell, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside.
Meanwhile, finely chop pecans and place on a plate.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 cup pecans, dry roasted

instructions.primary_message: Slice goat cheese into ½-inch thick medallions and transfer to the plate with the pecans. Turn to coat, gently pressing pecans into both sides of the medallions. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (4 oz) logs goat cheese

instructions.primary_message: Arrange bread on another large baking sheet and place in the oven to toast, about 5 minutes. (Alternatively, you can use a toaster.) Slice toast in half.
instructions.secondary_message: 9 slices gluten-free bread

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide roasted grapes, goat cheese medallions, and toast between plates. Drizzle honey over the goat cheese and enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: ⅓ cup honey

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash, dry, peel, and medium dice parsnips; transfer to a large baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with spices. Toss to combine, then spread out in a single layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 medium parsnips
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place parsnips in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until fork-tender, 15-20 minutes.
While the parsnips are baking, peel and mince garlic; transfer to a large bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Add oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the garlic; whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp white wine vinegar
1 ½ tsp Dijon mustard
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the grill pan heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb ribeye steak
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil. Working in batches if necessary, add steak and grill until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the mixed greens (skip if they came pre-washed).
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (5 oz) pkgs spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Add mixed greens to the bowl with the dressing and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide steak, parsnips, and salad between plates. Enjoy!
Preheat oven to 450°F. Coat a large baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
2 ¼ lb sweet potatoes
3 medium carrots
3 Granny Smith apples

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic and ginger; transfer both to a large bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Trim and mince green onions; transfer half to the bowl with the garlic (set remaining green onions aside for the slaw).
Add ground turkey, soy sauce, chili-garlic sauce, sugar, salt, and pepper to the bowl. Mix with your hands until well combined.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb ground turkey
1 tbsp tamari soy sauce
1 tbsp chili-garlic sauce
1 tbsp brown sugar
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Using a scant ¼-cup measure, form the turkey mixture into meatballs and place on the baking sheet. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until meatballs are cooked through, about 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and medium dice the sweet potatoes. Transfer to a large pot, cover with hot water (from the tap), and bring to a simmer over medium-high heat.
Once the liquid in the pot is simmering, reduce heat to medium, cover, and cook until the potatoes are tender, about 10 minutes.
While the potatoes are cooking, place oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper in a clean large bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp apple cider vinegar
1 ½ tsp Dijon mustard
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim, peel, and grate carrots; transfer to the bowl with the dressing.
Quarter, core, and coarsely grate apples; add to the bowl.
Add reserved green onions to the bowl and toss to combine the slaw.
When the potatoes are done, remove from heat, and drain in a colander. Return to the pot and add butter, maple syrup, salt, and pepper; mash with a potato masher until smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp butter, unsalted
1 tbsp pure maple syrup
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide sweet potato mash, meatballs, and slaw between plates. Enjoy!
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 medium zucchini squash
1 ½ lemons
3 English cucumbers

instructions.primary_message: Trim and coarsely grate zucchini; transfer to a large bowl.
Add turkey, half the feta, and spices to the bowl with the zucchini. Mix with your hands until well combined. (Set remaining feta aside.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb ground turkey
3 (4 oz) pkgs crumbled feta cheese
1 ½ tsp parsley flakes
1 ½ tsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Using a ⅓-cup measure, form turkey mixture into ½-inch thick fritters. Place on a plate.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add fritters to the skillet and cook, flipping once, until golden and cooked through, 10-12 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic. Transfer to a small bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Zest lemons into the bowl with the garlic; add yogurt, mayo, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the garlic-yogurt sauce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup plain Greek yogurt
3 tbsp mayonnaise
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Juice lemons into a clean large bowl. Add oil, salt, pepper, and remaining feta; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim and thinly slice cucumbers. Transfer to the bowl with the dressing and stir to combine.
Divide salad and fritters between plates; serve with garlic-yogurt sauce on the side. Enjoy!
Set butter on the counter to soften.
instructions.secondary_message: ⅓ cup butter, unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash, dry, trim, and halve strawberries; transfer to a large baking dish. Drizzle with vanilla and sprinkle with sugar.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (16 oz) pkg strawberries
1 tbsp vanilla extract
¼ cup brown sugar

instructions.primary_message: Place dish in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until strawberries are soft and starting to release their juices, 10-15 minutes.
Meanwhile, combine sugar and cinnamon in a small bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup brown sugar
1 tbsp cinnamon, ground

instructions.primary_message: Divide bread slices between two baking sheet pans; spread with softened butter and sprinkle with half of the cinnamon-sugar. Set remaining cinnamon-sugar aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 12 slices gluten-free bread

instructions.primary_message: Place bread in the oven and bake until toasted and bubbling, about 5 minutes; remove from oven.
Remove strawberries from the oven and gently crush with a potato masher or fork. Set aside to cool slightly, about 5 minutes.
To serve, divide toast between plates and top with strawberries. Sprinkle with remaining cinnamon-sugar and enjoy!
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
1 ½ limes
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
2 avocados

instructions.primary_message: Drain tuna and transfer to a large bowl; flake with a fork.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (6 oz) cans chunk light tuna in water

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Add both to the bowl with the tuna.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Add eggs and broth to the bowl with the tuna; whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 eggs
12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Place flour, baking powder, and salt in another large bowl; whisk to combine. Gradually add the egg mixture to the bowl with the flour, whisking to create a smooth batter.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cup gluten-free flour
1 tbsp baking powder
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, add broccoli slaw to the bowl with the batter and stir until thoroughly combined.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (12 oz) pkg broccoli slaw

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add one-sixth of the pancake batter (1¼-cups per pancake) to the skillet and smooth out into a large, ½-inch thick pancake. Cook, flipping once, until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove to a plate and cover with aluminum foil.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 tsp toasted sesame oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, juice limes into a small bowl.
Peel and mince additional garlic. Add to the bowl with the lime, along with mayo and chili-garlic sauce; whisk to combine the spicy mayo and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
⅓ cup mayonnaise
1 ½ tbsp chili-garlic sauce

instructions.primary_message: Trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces; transfer to a plate.
Halve and pit the avocados; slice crosswise while still in the skin and scoop out with a spoon. Add to the plate with the green onions.
Once the first pancake is done cooking, add more oil (about 1 teaspoon per pancake) to the skillet and repeat with remaining batter.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp toasted sesame oil

instructions.primary_message: To serve, place a pancake on each plate. Top with green onions and avocado; drizzle with spicy mayo and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp sesame seeds

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 350°F. Line two baking sheet pans with parchment paper.
Peel bananas, break into chunks, and place in a large bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ bananas

instructions.primary_message: Add sugar, oil, and vanilla to the bowl with the banana. Crush with a fork or potato masher until smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup brown sugar
3 tbsp virgin coconut oil
1 ½ tsp vanilla extract

instructions.primary_message: Roughly chop walnuts. Add to the bowl along with the coconut; stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup walnuts
1 cup shredded unsweetened coconut

instructions.primary_message: Place flour, cocoa powder, cornstarch, baking powder, baking soda, and salt in a small bowl; stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup gluten-free flour
3 tbsp cocoa powder
¾ tsp cornstarch
½ tsp baking powder
½ tsp baking soda
3 pinch salt

instructions.primary_message: Add flour mixture to the bowl with the banana and stir to combine the cookie batter.
Using a scant ¼-cup measure, divide batter into 12 portions and place on the baking sheets. Using a rubber spatula or the back of a spoon, spread each cookie into a 2-inch circle.
Place baking sheets in the oven and bake until cookies are slightly firm around the edges, 15-17 minutes. Remove from oven and let cool to room temperature.

Once cool, arrange half the cookies on a flat surface, bottom-side facing up. Place a scoop of ice cream on top of each, then cover with remaining cookies. Gently press cookies into the ice cream to secure the sandwiches.
instructions.secondary_message: 18 fl oz (2 ¼ cups) vanilla ice cream

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide ice cream sandwiches between plates and enjoy!
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
3 medium carrots
3 medium yellow potatoes
1 ½ red bell peppers
1 small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince the ginger and garlic; transfer both to a large bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Peel and medium dice the carrots and potatoes; add both to the bowl.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, peel and small dice the onion; add to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 medium red onion

instructions.primary_message: Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, salt, and pepper to the pot; cook, stirring often, until they begin to soften, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp virgin coconut oil
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the veggies cook, seed and slice bell peppers into thin, bite-sized strips.
Add the bell pepper, broth, coconut milk, soy sauce, and sugar to the pot; stir to combine and bring to a boil.
instructions.secondary_message:
48 fl oz (6 cups) chicken or vegetable broth
1 ½ (13.5 fl oz) cans coconut milk
2 tbsp tamari soy sauce
1 ½ tsp brown sugar

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, drain and rinse the water chestnuts in a colander.
instructions.secondary_message: 15 oz water chestnuts

instructions.primary_message: Once the soup comes to a boil, add water chestnuts, edamame, and corn. Return to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer until edamame is heated through and veggies are tender, 5-7 minutes more.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ cups edamame
1 ½ cups frozen corn

instructions.primary_message: Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems. Add cilantro to the pot, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
To serve, divide soup between bowls and enjoy!
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ small bunches asparagus
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
6 medium carrots
1 small bunch cilantro
1 lime
1 ½ heads butter (Boston) lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Snap or cut off the woody ends of the asparagus and cut into 1-inch pieces.
In a medium saucepan, bring 1-inch of water to a boil over high heat. Add asparagus and cook, uncovered, until crisp-tender, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince or grate ginger; transfer to a large bowl.
Add coconut aminos, oil, and vinegar to the bowl with the ginger; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup coconut aminos
¼ cup toasted sesame oil
2 tbsp rice vinegar

instructions.primary_message: When the asparagus is done, drain and add to the bowl with the dressing; set aside.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the grill pan heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb striploin (New York strip) steak
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil. Working in batches if necessary, add steak and grill until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate, cover loosely with aluminum foil, and set aside to rest for about 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 tbsp toasted sesame oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel and trim carrots. Using a julienne (or regular) peeler, peel carrots into thin noodle-like sticks; add to bowl with the asparagus.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
Slice lime into wedges.
Thinly slice steak against the grain and add to the bowl with the vegetables. Toss to combine.

Separate the lettuce into leaves. Pile leaves, in stacks of two per wrap, onto plates. Fill with steak, vegetables, and cilantro; sprinkle with sesame seeds. Serve with lime wedges on the side and enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp sesame seeds

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spring mix if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 Gala apples
1 ½ (5 oz) pkgs spring mix (mixed greens)
1 small pkg chives

instructions.primary_message: Place eggs, tomato sauce, cornstarch, and spices in a large baking dish; whisk until smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 eggs
1 ½ (8 oz) cans tomato sauce
1 ½ tbsp cornstarch
1 ½ tsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp paprika
¾ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp onion powder
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, working in batches, place bread slices in the dish with the egg batter; turn the slices, making sure both sides are soaked through.
instructions.secondary_message: 12 slices gluten-free bread

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches, transfer soaked bread to the skillet and cook until golden brown, 2-3 minutes per side. Remove to a plate and cover with aluminum foil.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp butter, unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, honey, Dijon, salt, and pepper in a large bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp red wine vinegar
1 ½ tsp honey
1 ½ tsp Dijon mustard
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Quarter and core the apples, then thinly slice each quarter; transfer to the bowl with the dressing.
Add spring mix, feta, and pumpkin seeds to the bowl and toss to combine the salad. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (4 oz) pkgs crumbled feta cheese
⅓ cup pumpkin seeds

instructions.primary_message: Chop chives into small pieces.
Divide French toast between plates; top with butter and chives. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp butter, unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a large baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (12 oz) pkg extra firm tofu

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 caps portobello mushrooms
1 ½ lb white mushrooms
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, transfer tofu planks to a plate; season with salt and coat with cornstarch on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ tsp salt
⅓ cup cornstarch

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add tofu to the skillet and pan-fry, flipping once, until crispy and golden brown, 5-6 minutes per side. Remove to a clean plate and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp toasted sesame oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel and mince or grate the ginger. Transfer to a large pot along with broth, vinegar, soy sauce, oil, chili-garlic sauce, and salt.
instructions.secondary_message:
96 fl oz (12 cups) chicken or vegetable broth
⅓ cup rice vinegar
¼ cup tamari soy sauce
3 tbsp toasted sesame oil
1 ½ tbsp chili-garlic sauce
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Remove portobello mushroom stems and scrape out the gills. Cut mushroom caps in half and then crosswise into thin strips. Add to the pot with the broth.
Thinly slice white mushrooms and add to the pot; stir to combine and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, in a small bowl, make a slurry by whisking water with cornstarch until smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup water
⅓ cup cornstarch

instructions.primary_message: Once the broth comes to a boil, add the cornstarch slurry in a steady stream while stirring quickly. Return soup to a boil, then cover and reduce heat to medium-low; let simmer until soup thickens slightly and mushrooms begin to soften, about 3 minutes.
Slice tofu into thin strips.
Whisk eggs and salt together in a medium bowl. Slowly pour the egg mixture into the soup, while gently stirring, to separate into strands.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 eggs
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Add tofu to the soup and stir to combine; cover and remove from heat.
Trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces; stir half of the green onions into the soup (reserving the rest for garnish).
To serve, divide soup between bowls and sprinkle with reserved green onions. Enjoy!
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ oranges
6 medium carrots
3 (8 oz) pkg sugar snap peas
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, pat the chicken thighs dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 lb chicken thighs, boneless skinless
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add chicken to the pot; cook, turning once, until golden brown on each side, 6-7 minutes (chicken will not be cooked through all the way).
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile zest and juice oranges into a medium bowl.
Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl with the orange juice.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Add water, sugar, soy sauce, ketchup, vinegar, and spices to the bowl; whisk to combine the sauce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup water
3 tbsp brown sugar
3 tbsp tamari soy sauce
3 tbsp ketchup
2 tbsp rice vinegar
½ tsp cayenne pepper
½ tsp cinnamon, ground
½ tsp cloves, ground

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and thinly slice carrots. Add carrots and snap peas to the pot, along with any chicken thighs that may have been removed if cooked in batches.

Add sauce to the pot and bring to a boil over high heat (reserve bowl for later use). Reduce heat and simmer, turning thighs occasionally, until chicken is cooked through and veggies are tender, 12-15 minutes.
Meanwhile, roughly chop peanuts.
instructions.secondary_message: ½ cup peanuts, roasted unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Trim green onions and cut into ¼-inch pieces.

In the reserved bowl, make a slurry by whisking water with cornstarch until smooth. Add to the pot in a steady stream, while stirring constantly; continue to simmer, until sauce thickens, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp water
2 tbsp cornstarch

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide chicken-vegetable sauté between plates or bowls. Top with peanuts and green onion. Enjoy!
Fill a large pot halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain once cooked.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp salt
18 oz (1 quarter coin = 2 oz) gluten-free spaghetti pasta

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry spinach. Wash tomatoes and mushrooms. Halve the tomatoes. Quarter the mushrooms. Peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (5 oz) pkg baby spinach
3 pints grape tomatoes
¾ lb white mushrooms
6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces. Season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
3 pinches salt
3 pinches black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add chicken and cook until browned and cooked through, 1-2 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: about 3 tbsp virgin coconut oil

instructions.primary_message: Return skillet to stove, reduce heat to medium, and add more oil (if needed). Add garlic and cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds. Add mushrooms and season with salt and pepper. Cook until tender, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
about 3 tbsp virgin coconut oil
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Grate or shave ⅓ cup of Parmesan.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ oz Parmesan cheese

instructions.primary_message: Add broth and cook until reduced by about ½. Remove pan from heat.
instructions.secondary_message: 12 fl oz (1 ½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Return chicken to skillet and add tomatoes, spinach, and pasta. Toss until ingredients are mixed and spinach is wilted.
To serve, place pasta on a plate or in a bowl and sprinkle with Parmesan. Enjoy!
Preheat oven to 450°F.
Fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium heads cauliflower
3 (5 oz) pkgs baby spinach
1 small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Cut each cauliflower head into quarters, then trim off and discard the leaves and thick stem. Cut into small, bite-sized florets.
Once the water in the pot is boiling, add cauliflower and salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, until fork-tender, about 5 minutes. Drain in a colander and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, roughly chop the spinach and transfer to a large bowl.
Peel and mince garlic and onion.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 cloves garlic
1 medium yellow onion

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic and onion to the skillet; cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 1-2 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Remove from heat and set aside. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Place tomato sauce, Italian seasoning, and salt in a medium bowl; whisk to combine and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (8 oz) cans tomato sauce
1 tbsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
Place ricotta, eggs, and spices in the reserved bowl; whisk until smooth. Add the cooked spinach and half the basil (reserving the rest for garnish), and stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (15 oz) pkg ricotta cheese
3 eggs
¾ tsp Italian seasoning
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Coarsely grate mozzarella.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (8 oz) blocks mozzarella cheese

instructions.primary_message: Wipe skillet clean with paper towels and coat the bottom with oil. Transfer half the cauliflower to the skillet and spread it out in an even layer. Spoon half the ricotta mixture over the cauliflower, followed by half the tomato sauce and mozzarella. Repeat process once more, creating two layers.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
