Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
15 oz gluten-free linguine pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a large baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (12 oz) pkg extra firm tofu

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 pints grape tomatoes
6 medium zucchini squash
1 small pkg fresh basil
1 lemon

instructions.primary_message: Preheat another large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, cut the tofu into ¾-inch cubes.

Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add tofu to the pot and sprinkle with spices; cook, turning often, until golden on all sides, about 6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp onion powder
¾ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, halve tomatoes and transfer to a large bowl.
Trim and halve zucchini lengthwise; cut crosswise into ¼-inch thick half-moons. Add to the bowl with the tomatoes and set aside.
Peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: When the tofu is done, remove to a platter, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside.
Return the pot to medium-high heat and add more oil, swirling to coat the bottom. Add garlic and crushed red pepper; cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add tomatoes, zucchini, broth, Italian seasoning, and salt to the pot. Stir to combine and bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer until zucchini is soft and sauce has thickened, 8-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth
1 ½ tsp Italian seasoning
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Cut lemon into wedges; set both aside.
Finely grate Parmesan.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 oz Parmesan cheese

instructions.primary_message: When the pasta is done, drain in a colander and return to the pot. Add zucchini-tomato sauce and tofu to the pot; gently toss to combine.
To serve, divide pasta between plates; top with Parmesan, basil, and a squeeze of lemon. Enjoy!
Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ small butternut squash
1 ½ lb Brussels sprouts
1 ½ Gala apples

instructions.primary_message: Trim ends and peel each squash; halve lengthwise, scrape out seeds, and cut the flesh into 1-inch cubes. Divide between two baking sheet pans.
Trim Brussels sprouts and halve lengthwise; add to the baking sheets with the squash.
Quarter and core apples, then slice each quarter into wedges; add to the baking sheets.
Peel, trim, and quarter shallots lengthwise. Add to the baking sheets, keeping the quarters intact.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 shallots

instructions.primary_message: Drizzle oil and maple syrup over the apple and veggies. Season with salt and pepper, toss to combine, then spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tbsp pure maple syrup
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To hasselback the sausages, thinly slice each sausage crosswise, stopping ½-inch before the bottom (be careful not to slice all the way through).
instructions.secondary_message: 9 pork sausages

instructions.primary_message: Place sausages, cut-side up, on the baking sheets, nestling them into the apple and veggies.
Place baking sheets in the oven and bake until apple and veggies are tender and sausages are cooked through, about 25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Transfer sausages to a clean cutting board and cut in half crosswise.
To serve, divide apples, veggies, and sausages between plates. Enjoy!

Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. (Reserve 1 cup of pasta cooking water before draining.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp salt
15 oz gluten-free penne pasta

instructions.primary_message: Trim off the root ends and the dark green top of the leeks, leaving only the white and pale green parts. Cut leeks in half lengthwise and rinse under running water, separating the layers to remove any dirt and grit. Slice crosswise into ¼-inch thick half-moons.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 leeks

instructions.primary_message: Preheat another large pot over medium heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add leeks, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash, dry, and finely chop broccoli. Add to the pot with the leeks and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, about 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 crowns broccoli

instructions.primary_message: While the veggies are cooking, peel and mince garlic. Mince anchovy fillets.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 cloves garlic
12 anchovy fillets, packed in oil

instructions.primary_message: Add garlic and anchovy to the pot. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until fragrant and lightly caramelized, 6 minutes more.
Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 oz Parmesan cheese

instructions.primary_message: Add Parmesan (reserving a small handful for garnish) and cream to the pot. Cook, stirring until the mixture is well combined, 2-3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) heavy whipping cream

instructions.primary_message: Add drained pasta to the pot and stir to combine; add reserved pasta water, a few tablespoons at a time, if necessary, to reach a saucy consistency.
To serve, divide pasta between bowls and top with reserved Parmesan. Enjoy!
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and salt; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups jasmine rice
3 cup water
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 English cucumbers
3 medium carrots
1 ½ avocados

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic. Place in a large bowl along with mayo, vinegar, sugar, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
⅓ cup mayonnaise
1 ½ tbsp rice vinegar
1 tbsp brown sugar
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim and slice cucumbers crosswise into thin rounds; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots; add to the bowl.
Peel, halve, and thinly slice shallot. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the salad; set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 shallot

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add sesame seeds; cook, stirring constantly, until seeds are toasted and golden brown, about 2 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message: ⅓ cup sesame seeds

instructions.primary_message: Uncover the rice and fluff with a fork. Add toasted sesame seeds, vinegar, and sugar; stir to combine, then spread the rice out on a large baking sheet pan to cool, about 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp rice vinegar
1 ½ tsp brown sugar

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, and crushed red pepper in a small bowl; whisk to combine the dipping sauce. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp tamari soy sauce
1 ½ tbsp rice vinegar
1 ½ tsp brown sugar
½ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Chop or tear salmon into bite-sized pieces. Halve and pit avocados; slice thinly while still in skin, then scoop out with a spoon.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (4 oz) pkgs smoked salmon

instructions.primary_message: Portion out the rice using a scant ¼-cup measure. Using lightly oiled hands, form each portion of rice into a ping pong-sized ball and return to the baking sheet. Layer salmon and avocado pieces over each rice ball.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 tbsp toasted sesame oil

instructions.primary_message: Divide rice balls (onigiri) and salad between plates. Serve with dipping sauce on the side and enjoy!
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (5 oz) pkgs baby spinach
3 medium carrots
3 sticks celery
6 medium zucchini squash
1 small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Finely chop half of the spinach and place in a large bowl. (Reserve remaining spinach for the sauce.)
Finely grate Parmesan and add to the bowl with the chopped spinach.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 oz Parmesan cheese

instructions.primary_message: Add turkey and spices to the bowl; mix with your hands until well combined. Using a ¼-cup measure, form turkey mixture into rounded meatballs and place on a plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb ground turkey
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
¾ tsp Italian seasoning

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium heat.

Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add meatballs to the pot and cook, turning occasionally, until browned on all sides and cooked through, 6-8 minutes. Once done, transfer to a clean plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: While the meatballs are cooking, peel and mince onions and garlic. Place both in a medium bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and small dice carrots. Trim and small dice celery; add both to the bowl with the onion and garlic.
Return the pot to medium heat. Add more oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add the veggies and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Add tomato sauce, water, and spices to the pot with the veggies and stir to combine. Cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce is slightly thickened, about 7 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (8 oz) cans tomato sauce
¾ cup water
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper
½ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the sauce cooks, trim zucchini ends and use a julienne (or regular) peeler to make noodles.
Preheat another large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add zucchini and water; cook, stirring constantly, until just tender, 3-4 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
⅓ cup water

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add half of the basil to the sauce and stir to combine (set remaining basil aside for garnish).
When the sauce is ready, add reserved spinach in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
Return meatballs to the pot with the sauce, stir gently to combine, and simmer until warmed though, 2-3 minutes.
To serve, divide zucchini noodles, sauce, and meatballs between bowls. Top with remaining basil and pine nuts. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: ⅓ cup pine nuts

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Season the rice with salt and add water; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups basmati rice
⅜ tsp salt
24 fl oz (3 cups) water

instructions.primary_message: If using frozen shrimp, place in a large bowl, cover with cold water, and set aside to thaw. If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 ¼ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15 to 18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Wash bell peppers and mushrooms. Seed and slice peppers into strips. Slice mushrooms. Transfer to a bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 red bell peppers
3 yellow bell peppers
¾ lb white mushrooms

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic. Peel and mince or grate ginger.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 cloves garlic
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root

instructions.primary_message: Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Drain shrimp in a colander and rinse under cold water until there are no more ice chunks. Spread out on a clean towel and pat dry.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add shrimp and cook, stirring frequently, until opaque and pink, 2-3 minutes. Transfer to a plate.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp virgin coconut oil

instructions.primary_message: Once shrimp have been transferred, add more oil to skillet. Add garlic, ginger, bell peppers, and mushrooms. Stir fry until peppers are tender-crisp, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp virgin coconut oil

instructions.primary_message: In a medium bowl, prepare sauce by whisking together soy sauce, vinegar, sesame oil, honey, and cornstarch.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 tbsp gluten-free soy sauce
1 ½ tbsp rice vinegar
3 tsp toasted sesame oil
1 ½ tsp honey
3 tsp cornstarch

instructions.primary_message: Return shrimp to skillet and pour in the sauce. Stir fry until sauce thickens, 1-2 minutes.
Uncover the rice and fluff with a fork.
Serve by placing rice in a bowl or on a plate and adding stir fry over top. Enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 400°F. Coat a large baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch fresh dill
1 ½ green bell peppers
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 ½ pints grape tomatoes
1 ½ heads butter (Boston) lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Using a knife, shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a large bowl.

Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the dill along with turkey, eggs, half the feta (reserving the rest for the yogurt sauce), bread crumbs, Dijon, and spices; mix with your hands until well combined.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
2 ¼ lb ground turkey
3 eggs
1 ½ (4 oz) pkgs crumbled feta cheese
½ cup gluten-free bread crumbs
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 tbsp oregano, dried
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Using a rounded tablespoon measure, form the meat mixture into meatballs and place on the baking sheet. Place meatballs in the oven and bake until cooked through, about 18 minutes. Remove from oven.
While the meatballs are baking, peel and mince additional garlic. Place in a small bowl along with remaining feta, yogurt, water, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the feta sauce. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
1 cup plain Greek yogurt
3 tbsp water
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place oil, vinegar, and spices in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp red wine vinegar
½ tsp oregano, dried
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and thinly slice onion into half-moons. Add to the bowl with the dressing and toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message: ½ medium red onion

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and thinly slice bell peppers. Add to the bowl.
Trim and thinly slice cucumbers crosswise into rounds. Add to the bowl.
Halve tomatoes and olives. Add both to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ cup Kalamata olives, pitted

instructions.primary_message: To serve, separate the lettuce into leaves. Pile leaves, in stacks of two per wrap, onto plates; fill with salad, meatballs, and feta sauce. Enjoy!
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 medium carrots
1 ½ bunches radish
3 limes
1 ½ mangoes
1 ½ English cucumbers
3 jalapeño peppers
1 small bunch cilantro
1 ½ heads romaine lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Place vinegar, water, sugar, and salt in a medium saucepan; stir to combine. Bring the pickling liquid to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup rice vinegar
¾ cup water
2 tbsp brown sugar
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel, trim, and cut carrots into thin matchsticks. Trim and thinly slice radishes.
Once the pickling liquid has come to a boil, add carrots and radishes; stir to combine, remove from heat, and set aside to cool.
Peel and mince garlic. Place half the garlic in a small bowl (reserving the rest for the next step); add mayo and stir to combine the garlic aioli. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 cloves garlic
½ cup mayonnaise

instructions.primary_message: Juice limes into a large bowl; add remaining garlic, oil, sugar, fish sauce, and pepper. Whisk to combine the salad dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp brown sugar
1 ½ tbsp fish sauce
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel mangoes and slice flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides. Roughly chop and add to the bowl with the dressing; set aside.
Trim and slice cucumbers crosswise into thin rounds. Transfer to a plate.

Thinly slice the jalapeño peppers into rounds; add to the plate with the cucumber. (Be careful, with jalapeños, do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing).
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the bowl with the mango; place the other half on the plate with the veggies. Set aside.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches, gently crack eggs into the skillet and cook until the tops of the whites are set but the yolks are still runny, about 4 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
12 eggs

instructions.primary_message: While the eggs are cooking, chop or tear romaine into bite-sized pieces and add to the bowl with the mango and cilantro. Toss to combine the salad.
Split rolls in half; working in batches if necessary, toast, cut-side down, in another skillet over medium-high heat or in a toaster (optional).
instructions.secondary_message: 6 gluten-free buns or rolls

instructions.primary_message: Divide toasted rolls between plates; spread each half with a layer of garlic aioli, then top with cucumber, pickled carrots and radish, eggs, jalapeños, and cilantro. Drizzle with fish sauce and season with pepper. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp fish sauce
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp salt
15 oz gluten-free rotini pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 yellow bell peppers
1 ½ pints grape tomatoes
1 ½ (8 oz) pkg sugar snap peas
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
1 ½ (5 oz) pkgs baby arugula

instructions.primary_message: Place edamame and peas in the colander and rinse under hot, running water (from the tap) to defrost; set aside to drain.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ cups edamame
2 ¼ cups frozen peas

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic; place in a large bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Add oil, vinegar, honey, Dijon, salt, and pepper to the bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup extra virgin olive oil
⅓ cup red wine vinegar
2 tbsp honey
2 tbsp Dijon mustard
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and halve bell peppers crosswise; slice into thin strips and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve tomatoes and add to the bowl.
Trim and halve snap peas crosswise; add to the bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Add drained edamame and peas to the bowl.
When the pasta is done, drain and rinse under cold water to cool; add to the bowl.
Add arugula and feta to the bowl; toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (4 oz) pkgs crumbled feta cheese

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a large baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (12 oz) pkg extra firm tofu

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 limes
3 medium carrots
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 small bunch cilantro
1 small pkg fresh mint
1 ½ heads butter (Boston) lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Zest and juice limes into a small bowl, stir to combine, and set aside.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and thinly slice onion.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 medium red onion

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the onion and cook, stirring often, until soft and golden, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: ⅓ cup toasted sesame oil

instructions.primary_message: Crumble the tofu with your fingers into the skillet. Add half the lime mixture (reserving the rest for the sauce), sugar, chili-garlic sauce, and salt to the skillet; stir to combine. Cook, stirring often, until tofu turns golden brown, 10-12 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp brown sugar
1 tbsp chili-garlic sauce
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: While the tofu is cooking, add soy sauce, sugar, and chili-garlic sauce to the bowl with the reserved lime mixture. Whisk to combine the sauce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp tamari soy sauce
2 tbsp brown sugar
1 ½ tsp chili-garlic sauce

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and thinly slice carrots; place in a large bowl.
Trim and small dice cucumbers; add to the bowl with the carrots.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; pick mint leaves off the stems. Discard stems, roughly chop the leaves, and add to the bowl with the veggies. Stir to combine the salad.
Peel and mince garlic. Roughly chop peanuts.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
1 ½ cups peanuts, roasted unsalted

instructions.primary_message: When the tofu is golden brown, add garlic and peanuts to the skillet, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
Separate the lettuce into leaves. Pile leaves, in stacks of two per wrap, onto plates. Fill each wrap with salad and tofu-peanut mixture; drizzle with sauce and enjoy!
Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
12 oz gluten-free macaroni (elbow) pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 sticks celery
2 green bell peppers
3 medium carrots
3 (5 oz) pkgs spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Place yogurt, mayo, vinegar, Dijon, honey, and spices in a large bowl. Whisk to combine the creamy dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup plain Greek yogurt
½ cup mayonnaise
1 ½ tbsp red wine vinegar
1 ½ tbsp Dijon mustard
1 tbsp honey
¾ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Drain tuna and add to the bowl with the creamy dressing; flake with a fork.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (6 oz) cans chunk light tuna in water

instructions.primary_message: Mince olives and add to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: ½ cup Kalamata olives, pitted

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince onion; add to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: ½ medium red onion

instructions.primary_message: Trim and small dice celery; add to the bowl.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers; add to the bowl.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots; add to the bowl.
When the pasta is done, drain and rinse under cold water to cool; add to the bowl. Stir to combine the macaroni salad and set aside.
Place oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper in a small bowl. Whisk to combine the vinaigrette.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp red wine vinegar
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide mixed greens between plates and drizzle with vinaigrette. Top with macaroni salad and enjoy!
Preheat oven to 400°F.
In a small saucepan, combine quinoa and broth; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups quinoa
24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: In a small bowl, mix together lemon juice, bread crumbs, dill, salt, and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lemon
9 tbsp gluten-free bread crumbs
1 ½ tsp dill
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place halibut in a small baking dish. Drizzle with a little olive oil and top with bread crumb mixture, patting lightly to help it adhere.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lb halibut fillet
about 3 tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Place dish in the oven and bake until fish is white and flaky, 10-12 minutes. Change setting to broil and continue baking until bread crumb mixture turns golden brown, 1-2 minutes.
Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Peel and mince garlic. Wash, dry, and thinly slice mushrooms.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 cloves garlic
1 ½ lb white mushrooms

instructions.primary_message: Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add garlic and cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds. Add mushrooms and season with salt and pepper. Stirring occasionally, cook until softened, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
about 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry spinach. Add to mushrooms and toss until just wilted, 1-2 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (5 oz) pkg baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Uncover quinoa and fluff with a fork.
To serve, place quinoa on a plate, add spinach-mushroom sauté, and top with halibut fillet. Enjoy!
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 jalapeño peppers
3 medium carrots
1 ½ (5 oz) pkgs baby spinach
1 ½ avocados

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and slice onions lengthwise into ½-inch wide strips. Place in a medium bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ medium red onions

instructions.primary_message: Quarter jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Cut lengthwise into ½-inch wide strips and add to the bowl with the onion. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Peel, trim, and slice carrots crosswise into ¼-inch thick rounds; add to the bowl.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, peel and thinly slice garlic. Transfer to a medium saucepan and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, jalapeño, carrot, and spices to the pot; cook, stirring often, until veggies are crisp-tender, 3-5 minutes. Return veggies to the bowl, reserving the pot for later use.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp oregano, dried
¾ tsp paprika
¾ tsp cumin, ground

instructions.primary_message: While the veggies are cooking, add vinegar, water, sugar, and salt to the saucepan with the garlic; stir to combine. Bring the pickling liquid to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup red wine vinegar
¾ cup water
1 tbsp brown sugar
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Pour the pickling liquid into the bowl over the cooked veggies. Stir to combine and set aside to cool.

instructions.primary_message: To serve, place in a bowl and garnish with remaining cilantro. Enjoy!
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ small bunches cilantro
1 ½ small pkgs fresh mint
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 ½ bunches radish
6 tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Drain and rinse the beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (15 oz) cans garbanzo beans (chickpeas)

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince garlic and onion.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
1 medium red onion

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic, onion, cumin, and salt to the skillet; cook, stirring constantly, until soft and golden, 2-3 minutes. Once done, transfer to a large bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp cumin, ground
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Add yogurt, broth, sugar, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the garlic and shallot. Whisk to combine the soup base.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 cups plain Greek yogurt
24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth
1 ½ tsp brown sugar
1 ½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the soup base.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Peel and small dice cucumbers; trim and small dice radishes. Add both to the bowl along with the chickpeas and stir to combine the soup. Cover and place in the refrigerator until ready to serve.
Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler.
Peel and mince additional garlic. Place in a small bowl along with oil and salt; stir to combine the garlic oil.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 pinch salt

instructions.primary_message: Slice rolls in half and divide between two baking sheet pans, cut-side up; drizzle with the garlic oil. Working in batches, place rolls in the oven and broil until golden, 1-2 minutes. Remove from the oven.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 gluten-free buns or rolls

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, slice tomatoes into thin rounds. Arrange tomato slices over the toasted rolls and season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 pinch salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Divide soup between bowls and serve with tomato toasts on the side. Enjoy!
Preheat oven to 450°F.

Using a strainer or colander, rinse lentils under cold water; drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and salt, then bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook until tender, 20-25 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups brown lentils, dried
4 ½ cup water
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ pints grape tomatoes
3 sticks celery
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
1 ½ (5 oz) pkgs baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic; halve grape tomatoes. Transfer both to a large baking dish, drizzle with oil, and season with spices. Toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp oregano, dried
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking dish in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until tomatoes have softened and released their juices, about 12 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, peel, halve, and slice shallots into thin half-moons. Peel and mince additional garlic. Place both in a medium bowl along with vinegar and spices; stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 shallots
3 cloves garlic
3 tbsp red wine vinegar
¾ tsp cumin, ground
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim and slice celery crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl with the shallot and garlic.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Slice sun-dried tomatoes into thin strips and add to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 12 sun-dried tomatoes, oil-packed

instructions.primary_message: Crumble goat cheese into the bowl and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (4 oz) logs goat cheese

instructions.primary_message: When the roasted tomatoes are done, add cream to the baking dish, and stir to combine the warm tomato dressing. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 fl oz (⅜ cup) heavy whipping cream

instructions.primary_message: When the lentils are done, drain in a colander. Add to the bowl with the goat cheese mixture and stir until creamy and combined.
Toast bread in the oven or toaster (if desired). Divide lentil mixture between bread slices, spreading it out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message: 12 slices gluten-free bread

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide lentil tartines and spinach between plates. Spoon the warm tomato dressing over the spinach and enjoy!
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
6 medium carrots
3 pints grape tomatoes
3 red chili peppers
3 avocados
1 small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Place oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper in a large bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp balsamic vinegar
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim and mince green onions; add half to the bowl with the dressing. (Place remaining green onions in a medium bowl and set aside for the sauce.)
Peel, trim, and julienne or coarsely grate the carrots; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve tomatoes and add to the bowl.

Halve chili peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Thinly slice crosswise and add to the bowl. (Be careful with chili peppers; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Halve and pit the avocados; slice crosswise while still in the skin and scoop out with a spoon. Add to the bowl along with the pumpkin seeds. Gently stir to combine the salad and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: ⅓ cup pumpkin seeds

instructions.primary_message: Drain tuna, place in another large bowl, and flake with a fork.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 (6 oz) cans chunk light tuna in water

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl with the tuna.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Add eggs, bread crumbs, yogurt, and spices to the bowl; stir well to combine the tuna mixture.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 eggs
1 cup gluten-free bread crumbs
¾ cup plain Greek yogurt
1 ½ tsp oregano, dried
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Using a ⅓-cup measure, form the tuna mixture into ½-inch thick fritters; place on a platter.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add fritters and cook until golden and warmed through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: While the fritters are cooking, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add basil, yogurt, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the remaining green onions. Stir to combine the sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups plain Greek yogurt
3 pinch salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide fritters, salad, and sauce between plates. Enjoy!
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 ½ yellow bell peppers
6 tomatoes
1 ½ lemons
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 ¼ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Medium dice bread and transfer to a large bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 slices gluten-free bread

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and large dice cucumbers; add to the bowl with the bread.
Trim, seed, and large dice bell peppers. Large dice tomatoes; add both to the bowl.
Peel and roughly chop garlic; add to the bowl along with broth, oil, vinegar, and spices; stir to combine the soup mixture.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth
¼ cup extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp red wine vinegar
1 ½ tsp onion powder
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Working in batches, transfer the soup mixture to a blender; blend on high until semi-smooth. Once blended, transfer gazpacho to a container with a lid and refrigerate until ready to serve. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack about 6-inches from the top. Line two baking sheet pans with aluminum foil.

Divide shrimp between the baking sheets, drizzle with oil, and season with salt and pepper. Working in batches, place each baking sheet in the oven and broil, flipping once, until shrimp are opaque and cooked through, 3-4 minutes. Remove from oven.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the shrimp are cooking, mince capers. Place in the reserved bowl along with mayo and crushed red pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tbsp capers
½ cup mayonnaise
½ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Juice lemons into the bowl with the capers and stir to combine.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl (reserving a small handful for serving).

Carefully remove cooked shrimp from the baking sheets by lifting the corners of the foil and transferring each foil sheet to a flat surface. Divide additional bread slices between the baking sheets; working in batches, place in the oven, and broil until toasted, 1-2 minutes. Remove from oven.
instructions.secondary_message: 12 slices gluten-free bread

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, roughly chop the cooked shrimp; add to the bowl with the lemon-mayo mixture and stir to combine. Divide shrimp salad between toast slices and spread out in an even layer.
Divide gazpacho between bowls; drizzle with additional oil and sprinkle with reserved parsley. Serve with shrimp salad toasts on the side and enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

line_items.ingredient_name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 medium carrots
3 sticks celery
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic; peel and small dice onions. Place both in a medium bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 cloves garlic
1 ½ medium yellow onions

instructions.primary_message: Peel and coarsely grate carrots. Add to the bowl with the garlic and onion.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.

Once the pot is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic, onion, carrot, and spices to the pot; cook, stirring often, until veggies begin to soften, 4-5 minutes. (Reserve bowl for next step.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp butter, unsalted
1 ½ tsp Italian seasoning
1 ½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, mince capers. Place in the reserved bowl along with mayo, vinegar, cumin, and pepper; stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tbsp capers
⅓ cup mayonnaise
¾ tsp red wine vinegar
¾ tsp cumin, ground
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add tomatoes, broth, and sugar to the pot; stir to combine and bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and let simmer until veggies are completely soft, about 8 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (14.5 oz) cans diced tomatoes
36 fl oz (4 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth
1 ½ tsp brown sugar

instructions.primary_message: While the soup is cooking, drain tuna; flake into bite-sized pieces and add to the bowl with the mayo mixture (do not mash).
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (6 oz) cans chunk light tuna in water

instructions.primary_message: Trim, and small dice celery. Add to the bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the bowl (reserving the rest for the soup).
Grate cheese and add to the bowl; gently stir to combine the tuna filling.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ (8 oz) block mozzarella cheese

instructions.primary_message: Place tortillas on a flat surface and divide the tuna filling between them. Move the filling onto one half of each tortilla; fold in half to close.
instructions.secondary_message: 12 small corn tortillas

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches, add quesadillas and cook, flipping once, until cheese is melted and tortillas are golden, 1½-2 minutes per side. Remove to a plate.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp butter, unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, using a hand (or regular) blender, purée the soup until smooth. Alternatively, use a potato masher to crush the tomatoes (the soup will be chunkier).
Divide soup between bowls and sprinkle with reserved parsley. Serve with quesadillas on the side and enjoy!
Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lemons
3 small bunches asparagus
6 caps portobello mushrooms
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root

instructions.primary_message: Zest and juice lemons into a large bowl.
Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl with the lemon juice, along with coconut aminos, oil, and spices. Whisk to combine the marinade.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
3 tbsp coconut aminos
3 tbsp toasted sesame oil
1 ½ tsp oregano, dried
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add steak to the bowl with the marinade, turn to coat, and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 ¼ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.primary_message: Snap or cut off the woody ends of the asparagus; divide between two baking sheet pans.
Slice mushrooms into ¼-inch thick pieces and add to the baking sheets with the asparagus.
Peel and mince ginger and additional garlic; sprinkle over the veggies.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Drizzle veggies with oil and coconut aminos; sprinkle with sesame seeds, salt, and pepper. Toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp toasted sesame oil
2 tbsp coconut aminos
3 tbsp sesame seeds
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven and roast, tossing once, until veggies are fork-tender, 15-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add the steak and marinade; pan-fry until steak reaches desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and let rest 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 tbsp toasted sesame oil

instructions.primary_message: Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide veggies and steak between plates. Enjoy!
Preheat the oven to 450°F. Line a large baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional).
Place chicken in a large bowl, drizzle with oil, season with spices, and toss to coat. Transfer to the baking sheet and arrange in a single layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 ¾ lb chicken drumsticks
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp paprika
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, turning once, until the chicken is cooked through and golden, about 35 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium heads cauliflower
1 ½ lb white mushrooms
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)

instructions.primary_message: Place maple syrup, oil, soy sauce, chili-garlic sauce, and paprika in a clean large bowl; whisk to combine the sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp pure maple syrup
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp tamari soy sauce
1 tbsp chili-garlic sauce
¾ tsp paprika

instructions.primary_message: Cut leaves off each cauliflower head, separate into small florets, and cut the thick stems into smaller pieces; add to the bowl with the sauce.
Quarter mushrooms, add to the bowl, and toss to combine. Transfer veggies to another large baking sheet and spread out in an even layer.
Add baking sheet to the oven and roast, tossing halfway through, until the veggies are fork-tender, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.
While the veggies are roasting, trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces.
To serve, divide chicken and veggies between plates; top with green onions and enjoy!
Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 12 oz gluten-free macaroni (elbow) pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 orange bell peppers
3 pints grape tomatoes
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
1 ½ lemons

instructions.primary_message: Place corn in a colander and rinse under hot water (from the tap) to thaw; transfer to a large bowl and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ cups frozen corn

instructions.primary_message: Preheat another large pot over medium-high heat.

Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add sausages and cook, turning occasionally until golden brown and almost cooked through, 5-6 minutes. Remove to a plate, leaving the cooking juices in the pot.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
6 pork sausages

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel, halve, and thinly slice onions into half-moons; add to the bowl with the corn.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ medium red onions

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers; add to the bowl.
Halve tomatoes and add to the bowl.

Return pot (with cooking juices) to medium heat; add veggies and Italian seasoning. Stir to combine, then nestle sausages into the veggies; cover and cook until the veggies are charred and sausages are cooked through, 8-10 minutes. Remove from the heat.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 tbsp Italian seasoning

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
When the pasta is done, drain in the colander and return to the pot.
Zest and juice lemons into the pot with the pasta. Add the parsley (reserving a small handful for serving), oil, salt, and pepper; stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Cut sausages crosswise into rounds; add to the pot with the pasta along with charred veggies and any cooking juices. Stir to combine the pasta salad.
To serve, divide pasta salad between plates or bowls and sprinkle with reserved parsley. Enjoy!
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and salt; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups basmati rice
3 cup water
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Wash, dry, and pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place half in a large bowl. (Reserve remaining mint for the rice.)
instructions.secondary_message: 1 small pkg fresh mint

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl with the mint along with turkey, eggs, bread crumbs, and spices. Using your hands, mix well to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
2 ¼ lb ground turkey
3 eggs
1 cup gluten-free bread crumbs
1 tbsp parsley flakes
1 ½ tsp sage, dried
1 ½ tsp cinnamon, ground
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Using a tablespoon measure, form the turkey mixture into rounded meatballs and place on a large plate.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add meatballs and cook, turning occasionally, until browned on all sides and cooked through, 6-8 minutes. Once done, transfer to a clean plate (leaving cooking juices in the skillet) and cover with foil.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place cherries in a colander and rinse under hot water (from the tap) to thaw; transfer to a cutting board and roughly chop.
instructions.secondary_message: 4 ½ cup frozen cherries

instructions.primary_message: Return skillet (with cooking juices) to medium-high heat; add cherries, water, honey, and spices. Stir to combine and bring to a simmer; reduce heat to medium-low and cook, stirring occasionally, until the sauce has thickened slightly, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup water
1 ½ tbsp honey
¾ tsp rosemary, dried
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Return meatballs to the skillet and continue to cook, turning occasionally, until warmed through, 3-4 minutes. Remove from heat.
Place peas in the colander and rinse under hot water (from the tap) to thaw; set aside to drain.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cups frozen peas

instructions.primary_message: Once the rice is done, add peas and reserved mint; gently stir to combine the rice pilaf.
To serve, divide rice pilaf, meatballs, and cherry sauce between plates. Enjoy!

Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Season the rice with salt and add water; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups basmati rice
⅜ tsp salt
24 fl oz (3 cups) water

instructions.primary_message: Wash oranges and grate 1 ½ tbsp of zest into a medium bowl, then juice oranges into the same bowl. Add water, soy sauce, rice vinegar, honey, chili-garlic sauce, and cornstarch to bowl and whisk together.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 oranges
1 ½ tbsp warm water
6 tbsp gluten-free soy sauce
3 tbsp rice vinegar
3 tbsp honey
¾ tsp chili-garlic sauce
1 ½ tbsp cornstarch

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15 to 18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Drain tofu and pat dry with paper towels. Medium dice.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (12 oz) pkg extra firm tofu

instructions.primary_message: Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add tofu and cook, stirring occasionally, until golden brown, 7-9 minutes. Transfer to a plate.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp virgin coconut oil

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Wash broccoli. Separate into bite-sized florets and cut stem into smaller pieces.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 medium crowns broccoli

instructions.primary_message: Once tofu has been transferred, coat skillet with more oil. Add garlic and broccoli. Cook, stirring occasionally, until tender-crisp and bright green, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tbsp virgin coconut oil

instructions.primary_message: Return tofu to skillet and pour in sauce. Stir to coat until sauce thickens, 1-2 minutes.
Uncover the rice and fluff with a fork.
Serve broccoli and tofu over top rice and enjoy!
Preheat oven to 400°F. Coat a large baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
3 oranges
1 ½ (8 oz) pkg sugar snap peas
1 ½ (5 oz) pkgs baby arugula

instructions.primary_message: Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Transfer half to a small bowl and half to a large bowl; set the large bowl aside.
Zest oranges into the small bowl with the parsley (set oranges aside for later use), then add Dijon, oil, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine the herb paste.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pat salmon dry with paper towels and place on the baking sheet; spread herb paste evenly over top.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 ¼ lb salmon fillet

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until the salmon is opaque and flakes easily with a fork, 12-15 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool slightly.
Meanwhile, fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
15 oz gluten-free penne pasta

instructions.primary_message: While the pasta is cooking, peel and mince garlic; add to the large bowl with the remaining parsley.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Juice reserved oranges into the bowl, then add oil, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 tbsp honey
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and thinly slice shallots into half-moons; add to the bowl with the dressing and stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 shallots

instructions.primary_message: Thinly slice snap peas crosswise and add to the bowl.
When the pasta is done, drain in a colander and rinse under cold water to cool. Add to the bowl with the dressing along with the arugula; toss to combine the salad.
When the salmon is cool enough to handle, break into large chunks with your fingers.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls and top with salmon. Enjoy!
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 eggplants
3 medium zucchini squash
1 ½ lb cremini mushrooms
3 tomatoes
1 small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Trim and medium dice eggplants and zucchini; place both in a large bowl.
Thinly slice mushrooms. Roughly chop tomatoes; add both to the bowl with the eggplant and zucchini.
Peel, halve, and thinly slice onions lengthwise into strips. Peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium red onions
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Preheat two large skillets over medium-high heat.
Once the skillets are hot, divide oil between them and swirl to coat the bottoms. Divide onion and garlic between the skillets; cook, stirring often, until softened, 2-3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: ¼ cup extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Divide veggies and spices between the skillets; reduce heat to medium and cover. Cook, stirring halfway through, until softened, about 10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp Italian seasoning
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons; set aside.
Peel and mince additional garlic.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Split rolls in half and divide between two baking sheet pans, cut-side up. Drizzle with oil and sprinkle with garlic and spices. Working in batches, place in the oven and broil until toasted, 1-2 minutes; remove from oven.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 gluten-free buns or rolls
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp Italian seasoning
3 pinch salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the veggies are ready, divide basil between the skillets and stir to combine the ratatouille (reserving a small handful for garnish).

Using a stirring spoon, make a well for each egg in the ratatouille skillets; crack an egg into each well. Cook until the egg whites are almost cooked through, 2-3 minutes. Cover each skillet with a lid and cook for 1 minute more.
instructions.secondary_message: 12 eggs

instructions.primary_message: Divide ratatouille and eggs between plates or bowls; top with feta and reserved basil. Serve with garlic toast on the side and enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (4 oz) pkgs crumbled feta cheese

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 425°F.

Wash zucchini, tomatoes, and lemons. Trim ends and halve the zucchini crosswise; cut each ½ into 6-8 wedges. Cut the tomatoes and 1½ lemons (save the other for the topping) into wedges. Transfer to a sheet pan.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 zucchini
6 tomatoes
3 lemons

instructions.primary_message: Peel, mince, and add garlic to the vegetables. Drizzle with oil and season with parsley flakes, salt, and pepper. Toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
6 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp parsley flakes
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper
