instructions.primary_message: Thinly slice sun-dried tomatoes.
instructions.secondary_message: 12 sun-dried tomatoes, oil-packed

instructions.primary_message: When the veggies are done, add sun-dried tomatoes, cream, and spices to the pot; stir to combine and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to low and cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) heavy whipping cream
1 tbsp oregano, dried
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
½ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the sauce simmers, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
Add cooked pasta, Parmesan, basil, and peas to the pot with the veggies; stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring frequently, until cheese is melted and peas are tender, 2-3 minutes more.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ cups frozen peas

instructions.primary_message: Add reserved pasta water to the pot, a few tablespoons at a time, while stirring, to reach a saucy consistency (you may not need all of the reserved water). Remove from heat.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls and enjoy!
Preheat oven to 450°F. Position racks in the upper and lower thirds of the oven.
Drain and rinse beans in a colander, then transfer to a large baking dish.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (15 oz) cans cannellini (white kidney) beans

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and mince shallots; add to the baking dish along with tomato sauce, maple syrup, Dijon, Worcestershire, and spices. Stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 shallots
3 (8 oz) cans tomato sauce
2 tbsp pure maple syrup
2 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
¾ tsp paprika
3 pinch cumin, ground

instructions.primary_message: Place baking dish on lower rack of the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, stirring halfway through, until beans are soft and sauce has thickened, 15-20 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 sticks celery
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 ½ (5 oz) pkgs spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Place yogurt, mayo, water, vinegar, salt, and pepper in a large bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup plain Greek yogurt
3 tbsp mayonnaise
2 tbsp water
2 tbsp apple cider vinegar
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim and slice celery crosswise into thin pieces; trim and medium dice cucumbers. Add both to the bowl with the dressing and set aside.
Coarsely grate cheddar.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ (8 oz) block cheddar cheese

instructions.primary_message: Divide bread slices between two large baking sheet pans; working in batches, place on upper rack of the oven and toast, flipping once, until golden, 4-5 minutes. Remove from oven.
instructions.secondary_message: 12 slices gluten-free bread

instructions.primary_message: When the baked beans are done, remove from oven and stir well. Divide beans between toast slices and top each with an even layer of cheese.
Working in batches, return baking sheets to upper rack of the oven and bake until cheese is melted, 3-4 minutes. Remove from oven.
Just before serving, add mixed greens to the bowl with the dressing and toss to combine the salad.
Divide "baked beans on toast" between plates and serve with salad on the side. Enjoy!
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and salt, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups jasmine rice
3 cup water
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
6 medium carrots
1 ½ English cucumbers
3 avocados

instructions.primary_message: Trim green onions and cut crosswise into thin pieces; place in a small bowl.
Peel and mince ginger; add to the bowl with the green onion along with oil, vinegar, soy sauce, and chili-garlic sauce. Stir to combine the sauce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup extra virgin olive oil
¼ cup rice vinegar
3 tbsp tamari soy sauce
1 tbsp chili-garlic sauce

instructions.primary_message: Place additional vinegar, water, sugar, and salt in a medium bowl; stir to combine the pickling liquid.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp rice vinegar
3 tbsp water
1 ½ tsp brown sugar
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots; add to the bowl with the pickling liquid, stir to combine, and set aside.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches, gently crack eggs into the skillet and cook until the tops of the whites are set but the yolks are still runny, about 4 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
12 eggs

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, trim and thinly slice cucumbers crosswise into rounds.
Halve and pit avocados; scoop out with a spoon and small dice the flesh.
To serve, divide the rice, eggs, pickled carrots, cucumber, and avocado between bowls. Top with ginger-green onion sauce and enjoy!
Preheat oven to 450°F. Coat two baking sheet pans with a thin layer of oil.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on another baking sheet. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (12 oz) pkg extra firm tofu

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 pints grape tomatoes
1 ½ English cucumbers
3 (5 oz) pkgs spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Medium dice tofu and place in a large bowl. Sprinkle with salt, drizzle with pesto, and gently stir to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ tsp salt
¾ cup basil pesto

instructions.primary_message: Sprinkle bread crumbs over the tofu and stir once more to coat. Divide tofu between the baking sheets and spread out in a single layer. (Wipe the bowl clean with paper towels and set aside for the salad.)
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ cup gluten-free bread crumbs

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, tossing halfway through, until tofu is golden brown, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, peel, halve, and thinly slice onions. Place in the reserved bowl, along with vinaigrette, and toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium red onions
½ cup French vinaigrette

instructions.primary_message: Halve tomatoes and add to the bowl with the onion.
Trim and medium dice cucumbers; add to the bowl.
Drain and thinly slice artichokes; add to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (6 oz) jars artichoke hearts, marinated

instructions.primary_message: Just before serving, add mixed greens and feta to the bowl with the other veggies; toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (4 oz) pkgs crumbled feta cheese

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls; top with tofu and enjoy!
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 medium parsnips
3 medium carrots
3 Granny Smith apples
3 sticks celery

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and small dice parsnips and carrots; place both in a large bowl.
Quarter, core, and small dice apples; trim and small dice celery. Add both to the bowl with the parsnip and carrot.
Peel, halve, and small dice onions; peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
Once the pot is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom; add veggies and spices. Cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are fork-tender, 6-7 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp butter, unsalted
1 ½ tsp thyme, dried
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the veggies are done, add broth and bring the soup to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium and simmer, stirring occasionally, until veggies are very soft, 10-12 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 72 fl oz (9 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place the bread slices on a flat surface. Layer blue cheese and prosciutto over half of the slices, then cover the sandwiches with the remaining bread slices.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 slices gluten-free bread
3 (4 oz) pkgs crumbled blue cheese
12 slices prosciutto

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches, place sandwiches in the skillet and cook until the bottoms are golden brown, 2-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp butter, unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Remove the sandwiches to a plate and add more butter to the skillet; return sandwiches to the skillet, browned-side up, and cook until golden brown on the other side and the cheese is melted, 2-4 minutes more. Once done, transfer to a cutting board and slice in half.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp butter, unsalted

instructions.primary_message: When the soup is done, use a hand blender to purée the soup until smooth. Alternatively, use a potato masher to crush the veggies (the soup will be chunkier).
Divide soup between bowls and serve with sandwiches on the side. Enjoy!
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 sticks celery
1 ½ orange bell peppers
3 jalapeño peppers
1 ½ bunches radish
1 small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and small dice onions; peel and mince garlic. Place both in a medium bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Trim and small dice celery; trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers. Add both to the bowl with the onion and garlic.

Quarter jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Small dice and add to the bowl with the veggies. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 4-5 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Add flour and spices to the pot; continue to cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 1 minute.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp gluten-free flour
2 tbsp chili powder
1 tbsp cumin, ground
1 tbsp coriander, ground
1 ½ tsp oregano, dried
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add chicken, broth, and tomato sauce to the pot. Stir to combine, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat; once boiling, reduce heat to medium-low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until chicken is cooked through, 10-12 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 lb chicken thighs, boneless skinless
48 fl oz (6 cups) chicken or vegetable broth
3 (8 oz) cans tomato sauce

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, trim, halve, and thinly slice radishes crosswise; place in the reserved bowl. Drizzle with vinegar, sprinkle with salt, and stir to combine; set aside to marinate.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp apple cider vinegar
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.

When the chicken is done, remove thighs to a plate using tongs (continue to simmer soup over low heat). Shred the chicken using two forks; use one fork to hold the chicken and the other fork to pull and shred the meat.
Return shredded chicken to the pot, along with cilantro, corn, and additional vinegar; stir to combine the soup and continue to simmer until warmed through, 3-4 minutes more.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups frozen corn
2 tbsp apple cider vinegar

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide soup between bowls; top with pickled radish and feta. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (4 oz) pkgs crumbled feta cheese

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain pasta and rinse under cold water to cool; set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
15 oz gluten-free rotini pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lemons
1 ½ pints grape tomatoes
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 ½ avocados

instructions.primary_message: Juice lemons into a large bowl.
Peel and mince shallots; add to the bowl with the lemon juice.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 shallots

instructions.primary_message: Add mayo and spices to the bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup mayonnaise
1 ½ tsp basil, dried
1 ½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Quarter tomatoes and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and small dice cucumbers; add to the bowl.
Halve and pit avocados; scoop out with a spoon and medium dice the flesh. Add to the bowl.
Drain and rinse beans, then add to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (15 oz) cans cannellini (white kidney) beans

instructions.primary_message: Add cooked pasta and pine nuts to the bowl, then stir to combine the pasta salad.
instructions.secondary_message: ⅓ cup pine nuts

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide pasta salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
3 medium carrots
3 (5 oz) pkgs baby spinach
1 small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince ginger and garlic; place both in a large bowl. Add beef, eggs, bread crumbs, chili-garlic sauce, salt, and pepper; using your hands, mix well to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
2 ¼ lb lean ground beef
3 eggs
¾ cup gluten-free bread crumbs
2 tbsp chili-garlic sauce
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Using a scant ¼-cup measure, form the beef mixture into rounded meatballs and place on a plate.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.

Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add meatballs and cook, turning often, until just browned on all sides, 4-5 minutes (the meatballs will not be cooked all the way through). Once done, transfer to a clean plate. (Reserve pot for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp toasted sesame oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel, halve, and slice onions into thin half-moons; peel and mince additional garlic. Place both in a clean large bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and slice carrots crosswise into thin rounds; add to the bowl with the onion and garlic.
Return pot to medium heat. Add onion, garlic, and carrot; cook, stirring occasionally, until fragrant, about 3 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)

Add meatballs (and any accumulated juices), broth, soy sauce, and vinegar to the pot; stir to combine the soup and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until meatballs are cooked through, about 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
96 fl oz (12 cups) chicken or vegetable broth
3 tbsp tamari soy sauce
3 tbsp rice vinegar

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, roughly chop spinach; place in the reserved bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the spinach.
When the meatballs are done, add spinach and cilantro to the soup in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Stir to combine and remove from heat.
To serve, divide soup between bowls; drizzle with additional oil and chili-garlic sauce. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp toasted sesame oil
1 tbsp chili-garlic sauce

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Fill a large pot halfway with water and bring to a boil.
Wash green beans and trim ends. Add to boiling water. Cook until bright green and tender-crisp, 2-3 minutes. Drain in a colander and rinse under cold water.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 lb green beans

instructions.primary_message: Peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic. Wash and slice mushrooms. Transfer everything to a plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onion
3 cloves garlic
¾ lb white mushrooms

instructions.primary_message: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces. Season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 lb chicken thighs, boneless skinless
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Melt butter in skillet. Add chicken and cook until no longer pink, 2-3 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tbsp butter, unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Melt more butter in skillet. Add onion, garlic, and mushrooms. Stirring occasionally, cook until vegetables are tender, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tbsp butter, unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Grate ¾ cup of Parmesan. In a small bowl, mix together bread crumbs and Parmesan. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 oz Parmesan cheese
¾ cup gluten-free bread crumbs

instructions.primary_message: Wash thyme and slide leaves off the stems.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ small pkg fresh thyme

instructions.primary_message: Sprinkle flour over top vegetables; stir and cook for about 1 minute. Add thyme, chicken, yogurt, salt, and pepper to skillet. Stir to combine and remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp gluten-free flour
1 ½ cup plain Greek yogurt
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Transfer mixture to a large baking dish, add green beans, and stir to combine. Sprinkle with parmesan mixture over top.
Place in the oven and cook for 10 minutes. Then broil for 1-2 minutes until topping is slightly browned.
Serve in a bowl and enjoy!
Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 ¼ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.primary_message: Place chicken, salt, and pepper in a large pot and cover with water by 1-inch; bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce heat to low and simmer until chicken is cooked through, 8-10 minutes; transfer chicken to a plate to cool.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
1 ½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, fill another large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
3 red bell peppers
3 medium carrots
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Once the water in the pot is boiling, add noodles and edamame; cook noodles according to package directions, about 5 minutes. Once done, drain and rinse thoroughly under cold water; set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
15 oz soba (buckwheat) noodles
1 ½ cups edamame

instructions.primary_message: While the noodles and edamame cook, using a clean cutting board, peel and mince ginger and garlic. Place both in a large bowl along with soy sauce, vinegar, oil, peanut butter, and honey; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
⅓ cup tamari soy sauce
3 tbsp rice vinegar
3 tbsp toasted sesame oil
1 tbsp natural peanut butter
1 tbsp honey

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and thinly slice bell peppers; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots; add to the bowl.
Trim and halve cucumbers lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons; add to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Once the chicken is cool, shred using two forks; use one fork to hold the chicken and the other fork to pull and shred the meat. Add to the bowl along with noodles and edamame.
Roughly chop peanuts and add to the bowl; toss to combine the noodle salad.
instructions.secondary_message: ⅓ cup peanuts, roasted unsalted

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide noodle salad between plates or bowls and enjoy!
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 medium yellow potatoes
6 medium carrots
6 sticks celery

instructions.primary_message: Peel and medium dice potatoes; place in a large pot and cover with hot water (from the tap). Cover and bring to a boil over high heat; once boiling, reduce to a simmer and cook until soft, 10-12 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel, trim, and small dice carrots; trim and small dice celery. Place both in a large bowl.
Preheat another large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add beef and cook, breaking it apart with a spoon, until just browned, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 ¼ lb lean ground beef

instructions.primary_message: While the beef cooks, peel, halve, and small dice onions; peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the carrot and celery.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: When the beef is done, add veggies and spices to the pot; continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies soften, 5-6 minutes more.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp rosemary, dried
1 ½ tsp thyme, dried
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack about 6-inches from the top.
When the potatoes are done, drain in a colander and return to the pot. Add milk, salt, and pepper; using a potato masher, mash until smooth. Cover to keep warm and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) whole milk
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the veggies are soft, add flour and cook, stirring frequently, 1-2 minutes more.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp gluten-free flour

instructions.primary_message: Add tomato sauce, broth, peas, and Worcestershire to the pot with the beef; stir to combine the beef filling and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, remove from heat and transfer filling to a large baking dish.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (8 oz) cans tomato sauce
12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth
1 ½ cups frozen peas
2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce

instructions.primary_message: Spoon mashed potatoes over the beef filling; using a fork, evenly spread mashed potatoes over the top, creating ridges.
Place baking dish in the oven and broil until the top is set and lightly golden, 2-3 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide the bake between plates or bowls and enjoy!
Heat a large pot over medium heat.
Peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic and ginger.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onion
6 cloves garlic
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger

instructions.primary_message: Coat bottom of pot with oil. Add onion and, stirring frequently, cook until softened, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: about 3 tbsp virgin coconut oil

instructions.primary_message: Rinse lentils under cold water.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 ¼ cups brown lentils

instructions.primary_message: Wash potatoes and tomatoes. Peel and large dice the potatoes. Medium dice the tomatoes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb sweet potatoes
3 tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Add garlic, ginger, cumin, turmeric, curry, coriander, and salt to pot. Stir for about 1 minute.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp cumin
1 ½ tsp turmeric
1 ½ tsp curry powder
1 ½ tsp coriander
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Add potatoes, tomatoes, lentils, and broth. Bring to a simmer and cook until potatoes and lentils are tender, 15-20 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Toast bread.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 slices gluten-free bread

instructions.primary_message: To serve, add stew to a bowl and have with bread on the side. Enjoy!
Preheat oven to 475°F. Line two baking sheet pans with aluminum foil to make clean up easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ English cucumbers
3 orange bell peppers
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)

instructions.primary_message: Pat chicken wings dry with paper towels and divide between the baking sheets. Sprinkle with baking powder and salt; toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 lb chicken wings, split with tips removed
1 tbsp baking powder
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Place wings in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, turning once, until cooked through, 25-30 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic; place in a small bowl along with sesame seeds, soy sauce, chili-garlic sauce, honey, vinegar, and pepper. Whisk to combine the wing sauce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
3 tbsp sesame seeds
3 tbsp tamari soy sauce
3 tbsp chili-garlic sauce
3 tbsp honey
2 tbsp rice vinegar
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place yogurt, mayo, additional vinegar, oil, salt, and pepper in a large bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup plain Greek yogurt
3 tbsp mayonnaise
2 tbsp rice vinegar
1 tbsp toasted sesame oil
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim and slice cucumbers into thin rounds; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers; add to the bowl.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into ¼-inch pieces; add to the bowl.
Add broccoli slaw, blue cheese, and additional sesame seeds to the bowl with the dressing and veggies; toss to combine the slaw and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (12 oz) pkg broccoli slaw
1 ½ (4 oz) pkgs crumbled blue cheese
2 tbsp sesame seeds

instructions.primary_message: When the wings are done, drizzle with sauce and toss to coat.
To serve, divide wings and slaw between plates; drizzle any remaining sauce over wings and enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: chicken wings, split with tips removed

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 450°F and position racks in the upper and middle thirds of the oven.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 medium carrots
1 ½ lb sweet potatoes
3 sticks celery
3 Gala apples

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and medium dice carrots and sweet potatoes. Divide both between two baking sheet pans.

Trim and medium dice celery; peel, halve, and medium dice onions. Add both to the baking sheets with the other veggies, drizzle with oil, and season with spices; toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium red onions
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp sage, dried
1 ½ tsp thyme, dried
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
¾ tsp cinnamon, ground

instructions.primary_message: Place veggies in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, tossing halfway through, until fork-tender, 18-20 minutes.
Meanwhile, quarter, core, and medium dice apples.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add apple, sausage, and spices. Cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-6 minutes; remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ lb ground pork sausage
¾ tsp sage, dried
½ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the sausage and apple are cooking, place yogurt, water, honey, Dijon, and spices in a small bowl; whisk to combine the sauce. Add additional water, 1 tablespoon at a time, if needed, to reach a drizzling consistency. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup plain Greek yogurt
3 tbsp water
1 tbsp honey
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 tbsp curry powder
¾ tsp garlic powder
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Cut bread into 1-inch cubes.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 slices gluten-free bread

instructions.primary_message: When the veggies are done, remove from oven and set oven to broil on high.
Sprinkle bread cubes over the veggies; working in batches if necessary, return the baking sheets to the top rack of the oven, and broil until golden and toasted, 2-3 minutes.
When the bread cubes are done, remove from the oven; add sausage mixture to the baking sheets and toss to combine the "stuffing."
To serve, divide stuffing between bowls, drizzle with sauce, and enjoy!
Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
15 oz gluten-free rotini pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 mangoes
1 ½ avocados
1 ½ small pkgs fresh basil
1 ½ limes
3 medium carrots

Trim and small dice zucchini; add to the bowl with the leek.
Slide thyme leaves off the stems; discard the stems. Add leaves to the bowl.
Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
While the pot heats up, place rice in a strainer or colander and rinse under cold, running water.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ cups jasmine rice

instructions.primary_message: Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add veggies and rice. Cook, stirring constantly, until the veggies start to soften, 3-4 minutes. Stir in broth and salt, then bring to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid in the pot comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the pot, and reduce heat to low. Cook until the liquid is mostly absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat salmon dry with paper towels and place skin-side down on a plate; season the top side with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb salmon fillet
½ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add salmon, skin-side down, and cook, flipping once, until skin is crispy and flesh is opaque, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and loosely cover with foil. (Reserve skillet for later use).
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, thinly slice mushrooms. Peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Wipe the skillet clean with paper towels and return to medium-high heat; add more oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add mushrooms and garlic; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Add soy sauce to the skillet and continue to cook until the liquid has evaporated, 2-3 minutes more; remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp tamari soy sauce

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide rice between plates or bowls; top with salmon and mushrooms. Enjoy!

Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes; drain and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
15 oz gluten-free fettuccine pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 red bell peppers
3 crowns broccoli
1 small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and slice bell peppers into thin strips; place in a large bowl.
Preheat another large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom; add turkey and cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup butter, unsalted
2 ¼ lb ground turkey

instructions.primary_message: While the turkey is cooking, separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Add to the bowl with the bell pepper.
When the turkey is done, add veggies to the pot; cook, stirring occasionally, until tender-crisp, 5-6 minutes.
Meanwhile, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
When the veggies are done, sprinkle with flour and continue to cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
instructions.secondary_message: ¼ cup gluten-free flour

instructions.primary_message: Add milk, salt, and pepper to the pot with the turkey; cook, stirring occasionally, until the sauce thickens, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) whole milk
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add drained pasta and basil to the pot; toss to combine and remove from heat.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. (Reserve 1 cup of cooking water before draining; set aside.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
15 oz gluten-free rotini pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 medium zucchini squash
3 pints grape tomatoes
1 small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Trim and halve zucchini lengthwise, then cut crosswise into ¼-inch thick half-moons; place in a large bowl.
Peel, halve, and small dice onions; peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the zucchini.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Preheat another large pot over medium heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add veggies and cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 4-5 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, halve tomatoes and place in the reserved bowl.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons; add half of the basil to the bowl with the tomatoes. (Set remaining basil aside for garnish.)
Add tomato paste to the pot with the veggies; cook, stirring often, for 1 minute.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp tomato paste

instructions.primary_message: Drain tuna and flake with a fork; add to the pot along with cream, salt, and pepper; stir to combine the sauce. Reduce heat to low and continue to cook, stirring often, until sauce thickens slightly, 4-5 minutes more.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (6 oz) cans chunk light tuna in water
12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) heavy whipping cream
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the sauce is cooking, finely grate Parmesan.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 oz Parmesan cheese

instructions.primary_message: Add drained pasta to the pot along with tomatoes and basil; stir to combine. Add reserved pasta water, a few tablespoons at a time, if necessary, to reach a saucy consistency. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls; top with Parmesan and reserved basil. Enjoy!
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ limes
3 mangoes
3 Gala apples
1 small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Zest and juice limes into a medium bowl.
Peel mangoes and slice flesh away from the pits, starting with the flat sides. Medium dice and add to the bowl with the lime.
Quarter, core, and medium dice apples; add to the bowl and stir to combine the fruit medley. Set aside.
Place mayo, curry paste, vinegar, honey, and salt in a large bowl. Stir to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup mayonnaise
2 tbsp Thai curry paste, red
1 ½ tbsp rice vinegar
1 ½ tsp honey
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Roughly chop eggs and add to the bowl with the dressing. Using a potato masher, mash and combine the egg salad.
instructions.secondary_message: 18 hard-cooked eggs, peeled

instructions.primary_message: Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add to the bowl with the egg salad and stir to combine.
Place half of the bread slices on a flat surface and divide egg salad between them; cover with remaining slices and press gently to adhere. Cut sandwiches in half.
instructions.secondary_message: 12 slices gluten-free bread

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide sandwiches and fruit medley between plates. Enjoy!
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium heads cauliflower
6 medium carrots
1 small bunch cilantro
1 small pkg fresh mint
3 sticks celery
6 tomatoes
1 ½ lemons

instructions.primary_message: Cut each cauliflower head into quarters, then trim off and discard the leaves and thick stem. Using a box grater or food processor, coarsely grate the cauliflower; place in a large bowl.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots; add to the bowl with the cauliflower and set aside.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; pick mint leaves off the stems. Discard stems and mince the leaves. Place half of the herbs in another large bowl and set remainder aside for serving.

Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl with the herbs along with turkey and spices. Using your hands, mix well to combine. Using a tablespoon measure, form the turkey mixture into rounded meatballs and place on a plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 cloves garlic
2 ¼ lb ground turkey
1 tbsp cumin, ground
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.

Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add meatballs and cook, turning often, until just browned on all sides, 4-5 minutes (the meatballs will not be cooked all the way through). Once done, transfer to a clean plate. (Reserve pot for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel, halve, and small dice onions; trim and small dice celery.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ medium yellow onions

instructions.primary_message: Return the pot to medium heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and celery; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies start to soften, about 4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: While the veggies are cooking, medium dice tomatoes; add to the pot along with the tomato sauce, water, and spices. Stir to combine and bring the stew to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (8 oz) cans tomato sauce
1 ½ cup water
1 ½ tsp cumin, ground
¾ tsp salt
¼ tsp cayenne pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the stew is boiling, reduce heat to medium, then return meatballs (and any accumulated juices) to the pot; continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until meatballs are cooked through, 6-7 minutes more.
Meanwhile, preheat another large pot over medium-high heat.

Once the second pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add cauliflower, carrot, salt, and pepper. Cook, stirring often, until cauliflower is lightly golden and cooked through, 7-8 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the meatballs are done, juice lemons into the pot, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
To serve, divide cauliflower-carrot sauté and meatball stew between plates or bowls; sprinkle with reserved herbs and enjoy!
Fill a large pot halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook according to package directions.
instructions.secondary_message:
about 21 cups water
3 tbsp salt
18 oz (1 quarter coin = 2 oz) gluten-free fettuccine pasta

instructions.primary_message: Heat a sauté pan over medium-high heat.
Slice chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season with Italian seasoning.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
3 tsp Italian seasoning

instructions.primary_message: Add butter to skillet and swirl to coat. Add chicken and cook until golden brown and no longer pink inside, 3-5 minutes per side.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tbsp butter, unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Transfer chicken to a plate. Wash and dry pan; return to stove over medium heat.
Add butter to pan and swirl to coat. Add garlic and cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp butter, unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Sprinkle flour into pan and whisk until combined with the butter.
instructions.secondary_message: 4 ½ tbsp gluten-free flour

instructions.primary_message: Add broth and whisk until smooth. Then add milk and stir until sauce is thickened, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 fl oz (1 ½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth
12 fl oz (1 ½ cup) whole milk

instructions.primary_message: Finely grate ¾ cup of Parmesan.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 oz Parmesan cheese

instructions.primary_message: Add Parmesan, salt, and pepper to sauce. Stir until smooth, then reduce heat to low until pasta is ready.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Measure out peas.
instructions.secondary_message: 4 ½ cups frozen peas

instructions.primary_message: Slice chicken diagonally into thin strips.
Drain pasta in a colander, reserving about 1 ½ cup of the pasta water.
Add pasta, chicken, peas, and ½ of the reserved pasta water to sauce. Toss to combine. Add more pasta water to thin out the sauce is desired.
Place on a plate, garnish with freshly ground pepper, and enjoy!
Fill a large pot halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook according to package directions.
instructions.secondary_message:
about 21 cups water
3 tbsp salt
18 oz gluten-free spaghetti pasta

instructions.primary_message: Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Peel and mince garlic. Halves olives. Measure out capers.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 cloves garlic
1 ½ cups Kalamata olives, pitted
6 tbsp capers

instructions.primary_message: Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add garlic, olives, capers, oregano, and crushed red pepper. Stir and cook for 1-2 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tbsp oregano
⅜ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add tomatoes and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer the sauce while the pasta cooks.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (14.5 oz) cans diced tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Wash basil. Pick leaves off the stems; discard the stems and thinly slice the leaves into ribbons.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Drain pasta in a colander.
Add pasta to sauce and drizzle with olive oil. Stir in the basil and season with salt and pepper. Toss to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, add pasta to a shallow bowl or plate and enjoy!
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 small bunches cilantro
1 small pkg fresh mint
3 limes
3 bunches kale
3 red chili peppers
3 yellow bell peppers
1 ½ avocados

instructions.primary_message: Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; pick mint leaves off the stems. Discard stems and mince the leaves. Divide herbs between two large bowls.

Add beef and spices to one of the bowls with the herbs (set the other bowl aside for the dressing); use your hands to combine the beef mixture. Using a scant tablespoon, form the mixture into mini meatballs and place on a large plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb lean ground beef
1 ½ tsp coriander, ground
1 ½ tsp turmeric, ground
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; working in batches if necessary, add meatballs and cook, turning occasionally, until cooked through, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp toasted sesame oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic; add to the second bowl with the herbs.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Juice limes into the bowl, then add oil, fish sauce, sugar, soy sauce, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp toasted sesame oil
2 tbsp fish sauce
2 tbsp brown sugar
1 tbsp tamari soy sauce
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces and add to the bowl with the dressing. Using your hands, massage kale with the dressing until wilted, about 2 minutes.

Halve chili peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Thinly slice and add to the bowl. (Be careful with chilis; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Trim, seed, and halve bell peppers crosswise, then slice into thin strips; add to the bowl.
Peel, halve, and slice shallots into thin half-moons; add to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 shallots

instructions.primary_message: Halve and pit avocados; scoop out with a spoon and medium dice the flesh. Add to the bowl and gently toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls; top with meatballs and enjoy!

Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes; drain and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
15 oz gluten-free spaghetti pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 eggplants
1 small pkg fresh basil
3 pints grape tomatoes
1 ½ (5 oz) pkgs baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: If using frozen shrimp, place them in the colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 ¼ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Trim and medium dice eggplants.
Preheat another large pot over medium-high heat.

Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add eggplant and cook, stirring occasionally, until golden brown, about 10 minutes. Transfer eggplant to a plate. (Reserve pot for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic; place in a medium bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons; add half to the bowl with the garlic. (Reserve remaining basil for garnish.)
Halve tomatoes and add to the bowl.

Return pot to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom; add shrimp, garlic, basil, tomatoes, vinegar, salt, and crushed red pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until shrimp are opaque, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp balsamic vinegar
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add spinach to the pot in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
Add drained pasta and eggplant to the pot; toss to combine. Continue to cook until pasta and eggplant are warmed through, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls; top with feta and reserved basil. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (4 oz) pkgs crumbled feta cheese

line_items.ingredient_name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add broth and turmeric, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups basmati rice
24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth
¾ tsp turmeric, ground

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
1 ½ lemons
1 small pkg fresh mint
1 ½ English cucumbers
3 tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, peel, halve, and mince onions. Place half in a large bowl and half in a medium bowl (set medium bowl aside for the raita).
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ medium red onions

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince ginger and garlic; add both to the large bowl along with the chicken, bread crumbs, and spices. Using your hands, mix until well combined.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
1 ½ lb ground chicken
⅓ cup gluten-free bread crumbs
1 tbsp garam masala
1 tbsp curry powder
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Using a ¼-cup measure, form the chicken mixture into 18 short, sausage-like shapes, approximately 4-inches long; place kofta on a large plate.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add kofta and pan-fry, rotating every 2-3 minutes, until browned and cooked through, 10-12 minutes. Transfer to a clean plate.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, juice lemons into the medium bowl that was set aside for the raita.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Trim and small dice cucumbers; add to the bowl.
Small dice tomatoes; add to the bowl.
Add yogurt, salt, and pepper to the bowl; stir to combine the raita.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 cups plain Greek yogurt
¾ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide rice, kofta, and raita between plates. Enjoy!
Preheat oven to 425°F. Line two large baking sheet pans with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional), then coat with oil.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Coarsely grate cheese into a medium bowl; add bread crumbs and spices. Stir to combine the coating.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ (8 oz) block cheddar cheese
1 ½ cup gluten-free bread crumbs
¾ tsp paprika
¾ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp onion powder
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pat chicken dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin cutlets.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 ¼ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.primary_message: Spread mayo over both sides of the cutlets, then dredge in the bread crumb coating, pressing firmly to adhere. Transfer cutlets to one of the baking sheets and drizzle with oil; set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp mayonnaise
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry broccoli; using a clean cutting board, separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Transfer to the second baking sheet.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 crowns broccoli

instructions.primary_message: Drizzle broccoli with oil, season with salt and pepper, then toss to coat; spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, flipping chicken and tossing broccoli halfway through, until chicken is cooked through, 18-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, peel, and medium dice sweet potatoes; place in a large pot. Cover with hot water (from the tap) and bring to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 ¼ lb sweet potatoes

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid in the pot is boiling, reduce heat to medium, cover, and simmer until sweet potatoes are tender, about 10 minutes.
When the sweet potatoes are done, drain in a colander, and return to the pot. Add oil, salt, and pepper, then mash until smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide mashed sweet potatoes, chicken, and broccoli between plates. Enjoy!
Place eggs in a medium saucepan, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 4 minutes. Drain hot water and add ice or run under cold water to cool.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 eggs

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
While the water heats up, wash and dry kale. Fold leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Stack leaves on top of one another, then cut crosswise into thin (shred-like) ribbons.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 bunches kale

instructions.primary_message: Once the water in the pot is boiling, working in batches, uncover, add kale, and stir. Cook until bright green and wilted, about 15 seconds. Transfer kale to a colander using a slotted spoon. (Reserve pot of water for the next step.)
Return water to a boil. Once the water is boiling, add noodles and cook according to package directions, about 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 15 oz soba (buckwheat) noodles

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash, dry, and trim green onions; cut crosswise into thin pieces and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 small bunch green onions (scallions)

instructions.primary_message: Place tahini, water, soy sauce, chili-garlic sauce, and oil in a large bowl. Whisk to combine the sauce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup tahini
¾ cup water
⅓ cup tamari soy sauce
3 tbsp chili-garlic sauce
1 tbsp toasted sesame oil

instructions.primary_message: When the noodles are done, drain in the colander over the kale. Rinse thoroughly under cold water and set aside to drain further.
Peel and quarter the eggs.
Add noodles, kale, and half of the green onions to the bowl with the sauce; toss to combine. (Reserve remaining green onions for serving.)
To serve, divide the noodles and kale between plates or bowls. Top with remaining green onions, sesame seeds, and eggs. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: ⅓ cup sesame seeds

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 peaches
3 tomatoes
3 hearts romaine hearts

instructions.primary_message: Divide prosciutto between two large baking sheet pans and arrange in an single layer. Working in batches, place in the oven and broil until crispy, 2-3 minutes. Remove from oven.
instructions.secondary_message: 24 slices prosciutto

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, quarter peaches lengthwise (around the pit); twist quarters to separate, then remove and discard pit. Cut each quarter into thin wedges and place on a large plate.
Thinly slice tomatoes, then season with salt and pepper; add to the plate with the peach.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 pinch salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Thinly slice mozzarella into rounds; add to the plate.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.primary_message: Add one lettuce leaf per sandwich to the plate and set aside. Chop or tear remaining lettuce into bite-sized pieces and place in a large bowl.
Drain and thinly slice artichokes; add to the bowl with the lettuce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (6 oz) jars artichoke hearts, marinated

instructions.primary_message: Toast bread if desired.
instructions.secondary_message: 12 slices gluten-free bread

instructions.primary_message: Spread mayo over each bread slice. Layer half of the slices with lettuce, tomato, mozzarella, peach, and crispy prosciutto. Close with remaining bread slices.
instructions.secondary_message: ⅓ cup mayonnaise

instructions.primary_message: Add dressing to the bowl with the lettuce and artichokes; toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message: ⅓ cup Italian salad dressing

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide salad and sandwiches between plates. Enjoy!
Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Slice chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add chicken and bacon. Cook chicken until it is golden brown and cooked through and bacon until it is crispy, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate lined with paper towels and pat dry the bacon.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Toast buns or rolls.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 gluten-free buns or rolls

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry spinach. Wash and slice tomatoes into rounds. Halve and pit avocados; cut into slices while still in skin and scoop out.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (5 oz) pkg baby spinach
3 tomatoes
3 avocados

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic. In a small bowl, mix together mayo with ½ of the garlic (save the rest for the salad dressing).
instructions.secondary_message:
6 cloves garlic
6 tbsp mayonnaise

instructions.primary_message: In a small bowl, prepare salad dressing by whisking together remaining garlic, lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
juice of 1 ½ lemon
4 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 pinches salt
3 pinches black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Thinly slice chicken into strips.
Spread garlic mayo over the bottom halves of bread in each pair. Layer with spinach leaves, chicken, avocado, tomato, and bacon. Top with remaining slices of bread.
Place sandwich on a plate and serve with remaining spinach on the side. Drizzle with dressing and enjoy!
Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Wash, dry, trim, and seed bell peppers; medium dice.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 yellow bell peppers

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic. Place half in a small bowl and set aside for the garlic toast.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Preheat two large skillets over medium heat.

line_items.ingredient_name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Coarsely grate tofu and divide between two large baking sheet pans. Drizzle with oil and season with spices; stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (12 oz) pkg extra firm tofu
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp chili powder
2 tbsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, stirring halfway through, until tofu is golden and just starting to dry out, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ limes
1 small pkg chives
1 ½ medium heads napa cabbage
1 ½ bunches radish
6 sticks celery

instructions.primary_message: Juice limes into a large bowl.
Chop chives into small pieces. Add to the bowl with the lime juice along with yogurt, mayo, and spices. Stir to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup plain Greek yogurt
¼ cup mayonnaise
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
1 ½ tsp dill, dried
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim off and discard root end of each cabbage; halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and halve radishes lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl.
Trim and thinly slice celery crosswise. Add to the bowl, stir to combine the slaw, and set aside.
Place ketchup, vinegar, sugar, soy sauce, Dijon, salt, and pepper in a large pot; stir to combine the BBQ sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup ketchup
¾ cup balsamic vinegar
3 tbsp brown sugar
1 ½ tbsp tamari soy sauce
1 ½ tbsp Dijon mustard
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Bring sauce to a boil over medium-high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to low and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened, 3-4 minutes. Remove from heat.
When the tofu is done, add to the pot with the BBQ sauce and stir to combine.
Toast the buns if desired.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 gluten-free buns or rolls

instructions.primary_message: Place bottom half of each bun on a plate; top with BBQ tofu and a small portion of the slaw. Close with the top half of each bun and serve with remaining slaw on the side. Enjoy!
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add riced cauliflower and cook, stirring often, until lightly golden and cooked through, 6-8 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 (12 oz) bags frozen, riced cauliflower

instructions.primary_message: Transfer cooked cauliflower rice to a large bowl. Add eggs, flour, and spices, then stir to combine the fritter mixture.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 eggs
1 ½ cup gluten-free flour
¾ tsp dill, dried
¾ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
instructions.secondary_message: ¼ cup extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Working in batches, using a ¼-cup measure, scoop the cauliflower mixture into the skillet, spacing each scoop a few inches apart; press down to form round fritters. Cook, flipping once, until fritters are golden brown and cooked through, 3-5 minutes. Transfer to a large paper towel-lined plate.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the mixed greens (skip if they came pre-washed). Place in a large bowl along with pine nuts and vinaigrette. Toss to combine the salad and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (5 oz) pkgs spring mix (mixed greens)
⅓ cup pine nuts
½ cup balsamic vinaigrette

instructions.primary_message: Chop or tear salmon into bite-sized pieces.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (4 oz) pkgs smoked salmon

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide salad and fritters between plates; top fritters with tzatziki and salmon. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ cups tzatziki sauce

instructions.primary_message: Wash the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 avocados
6 medium carrots
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
1 ½ small bunch green onions (scallions)
3 (8 oz) pkg sugar snap peas
6 medium zucchini squash

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince or grate the ginger. In a shallow dish, whisk together the ginger, soy sauce, vinegar, and sesame oil.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 tbsp gluten-free soy sauce
3 tbsp rice vinegar
3 tsp toasted sesame oil

instructions.primary_message: Place the salmon flesh-side down in the marinade and turn a few times to coat.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 ¼ lb salmon fillet

instructions.primary_message: Heat a skillet over medium heat.

Add oil to the skillet and swirl to coat bottom. Add salmon skin-side down, reserving the marinade in the dish, and cook until skin is crispy and flesh is opaque, 3-4 minutes per side depending on thickness. Transfer to a plate and allow it to cool.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp virgin coconut oil

instructions.primary_message: While the salmon cooks, trim ends and, using a julienne peeler (or regular peeler), peel the carrots and zucchini into noodle-like sticks; transfer to a large bowl. Halve the peas on an angle and add to the bowl.
Once the salmon has been removed, add carrots, zucchini, peas, and reserved marinade to the skillet. Toss and cook until the noodles have softened slightly, 2-3 minutes.
Halve and pit the avocados; slice crosswise while still in the skin and scoop out with a spoon. Trim ends and chop the green onions on an angle.
To serve, combine noodles, peas, and avocado on a plate or in a bowl. Flake salmon over top and sprinkle with green onions and sesame seeds. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tsp sesame seeds

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
3 small bunches asparagus
6 medium carrots
1 ½ avocados

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Place both in a large bowl along with soy sauce, oil, chili-garlic sauce, and maple syrup. Whisk to combine the sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 cloves garlic
⅓ cup tamari soy sauce
2 tbsp toasted sesame oil
2 tbsp chili-garlic sauce
1 tbsp pure maple syrup

instructions.primary_message: Add chicken to the bowl with the sauce and turn to coat. Divide between two baking dishes and arrange in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 lb chicken thighs, boneless skinless

instructions.primary_message: Place baking dishes in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, flipping halfway though, until chicken is cooked through, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place mayo, vinegar, sesame seeds, oil, soy sauce, and chili-garlic sauce in a clean large bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup mayonnaise
3 tbsp rice vinegar
3 tbsp sesame seeds
2 tbsp toasted sesame oil
2 tbsp tamari soy sauce
1 ½ tbsp chili-garlic sauce

instructions.primary_message: Snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus; cut spears crosswise into thin coins. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Peel, trim, and slice carrots crosswise into thin rounds. Add to the bowl.
Halve and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and medium dice. Add to the bowl and gently stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide chicken and salad between plates. Enjoy!
Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 lemons
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
1 ½ bunches kale
1 ½ heads romaine lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Zest half of the lemons into a large bowl. (Reserve remaining lemons for later use.)

Cut butter into small pieces. Add to the bowl with the lemon zest along with bread crumbs, salt, and pepper; stir to combine. Transfer bread crumb mixture to a baking sheet pan and spread out in an even layer. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp butter, unsalted
1 cup gluten-free bread crumbs
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't need to be fully heated) and bake, stirring halfway through, until bread crumbs are golden and toasted, about 5 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool.

Meanwhile, if using frozen shrimp, place them in the colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 ¼ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Peel and thinly slice garlic.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add additional butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until garlic is golden and fragrant, 2-3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup butter, unsalted
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp crushed red pepper
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.

When the garlic is golden, juice half of the lemons into the skillet, then add parsley and shrimp. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the shrimp are opaque and cooked through, about 4 minutes. Remove from heat. (Reserve remaining lemons for the next step.)
While the shrimp are cooking, juice remaining lemons into the reserved bowl.
Finely grate Parmesan. Add to the bowl with the lemon juice.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 oz Parmesan cheese

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince additional garlic; mince anchovy fillets. Add both to the bowl along with mayo, Dijon, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
6 anchovy fillets, packed in oil
¾ cup mayonnaise
1 ½ tsp Dijon mustard
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Chop or tear kale and lettuce leaves into bite-sized pieces. Add both to the bowl with the dressing and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls; top with shrimp scampi and bread crumbs. Enjoy!
