instructions.primary_message: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Line a baking sheet pan with parchment paper.
Place pumpkin seeds, soy sauce, and maple syrup in a large bowl; stir to combine. Transfer seeds to the baking sheet and spread out in an even layer. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup pumpkin seeds
1 ½ tbsp tamari soy sauce
1 ½ tsp pure maple syrup

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring seeds halfway through, until golden and toasted, 10-12 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool (the seeds will harden as they cool).
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ limes
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
1 ½ pints grape tomatoes
1 small bunch cilantro
1 ½ heads butter (Boston) lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Zest and juice limes into the reserved bowl. Add oil, vinegar, salt, and crushed red pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp rice vinegar
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve or quarter tomatoes. Add to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Drain and rinse chickpeas in a colander. Add to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (15 oz) cans garbanzo beans (chickpeas)

instructions.primary_message: Place corn in the colander and rinse under hot water (from the tap) to defrost. Add to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cups frozen corn

instructions.primary_message: Break apart the cooled pumpkin seeds. Add to the bowl, along with feta, and stir to combine the chickpea salad.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (4 oz) pkgs crumbled feta cheese

instructions.primary_message: Separate the lettuce into leaves. Pile leaves, in stacks of two per wrap, onto plates; fill with chickpea salad. Enjoy!
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
3 jalapeño peppers
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
3 small bunches cilantro
9 sticks celery
1 ½ English cucumbers

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince ginger. Place in a small bowl along with soy sauce, oil, chili-garlic sauce, and sugar. Whisk to combine the sauce and set aside for serving.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp tamari soy sauce
3 tbsp toasted sesame oil
1 ½ tbsp chili-garlic sauce
1 ½ tbsp brown sugar

instructions.primary_message: Place vinegar, oil, sugar, and salt in a large bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup rice vinegar
2 tbsp toasted sesame oil
2 tbsp brown sugar
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate. Season with salt on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb striploin (New York strip) steak
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and set aside to rest, about 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp toasted sesame oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, thinly slice jalapeño peppers crosswise into rings; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level (optional). Add to the bowl with the dressing. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Trim and slice green onions on the diagonal into thin pieces. Add to the bowl.
Trim and slice celery on the diagonal into thin pieces. Add to the bowl.
Trim and halve cucumbers lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and add the leaves to the bowl. Stir to combine the salad.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide steak and salad between plates. Drizzle sauce over the steak and enjoy!
Preheat oven to 425°F. Coat a large baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 lemons
1 small bunch fresh dill
3 bunches kale
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)

instructions.primary_message: Mince walnuts. Place in a small bowl along with bread crumbs, oil, and salt; stir to combine the coating.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup walnuts
½ cup gluten-free bread crumbs
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Pat salmon dry with paper towels and place, skin-side down, on the baking sheet; season the top side with salt and pepper. Spread the fish with mayo, then sprinkle evenly with the coating, pressing gently to adhere. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb salmon fillet
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper
¼ cup mayonnaise

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until salmon is cooked through, 10-12 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, juice half of the lemons into the reserved bowl. Cut remaining lemons into wedges and set aside for serving.
Shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the lemon juice and set aside.
Fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces and place in a large bowl.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, trim and thinly slice green onions crosswise. Add to the bowl with the kale.

Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add kale and green onions to the pot in handfuls, waiting for kale to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Cook, stirring frequently, until the kale is tender, 2-3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Add lemon juice, dill, feta, crushed red pepper, and salt to the pot with the kale. Stir to combine and remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (4 oz) pkgs crumbled feta cheese
¾ tsp crushed red pepper
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide salmon and kale between plates, then squeeze lemon over top. Enjoy!
Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until almost done, 6-8 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
15 oz gluten-free rotini pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lemons
3 pints grape tomatoes
1 small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Zest and juice lemons into a large bowl.
Halve tomatoes lengthwise. Add to the bowl with the lemon.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add to the bowl.
Place chickens on the cutting board and, using your hands, remove meat from the skin and bones. Separate the meat into shred-like pieces. Add to the bowl and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (30 oz) whole chicken rotisserie chicken, white and dark meat

instructions.primary_message: When the pasta is almost done, add kale to the pot and stir for a few seconds. Continue to cook until kale is tender and pasta reaches desired doneness, 2-3 minutes more.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (10 oz) bags kale, cut and ready to use

instructions.primary_message: Drain pasta and kale. Return to the pot along with the lemon, tomato, basil, chicken, dressing, salt, and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup Italian salad dressing
¾ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Set pot over medium heat and cook, stirring often, until tomatoes and chicken are warmed through, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: kale, cut and ready to use
rotisserie chicken, white and dark meat

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and slice onions crosswise into thin half-moons.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 medium yellow onions

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until soft and starting to brown, about 10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, fill another large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. (Reserve 1 cup of pasta cooking water before draining.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
15 oz gluten-free linguine pasta

instructions.primary_message: While the pasta is cooking, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lb cremini mushrooms
3 bunches kale
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Thinly slice mushrooms.
When the onions are browned, add more oil, mushrooms, and salt to the pot. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until mushrooms are soft and onions are caramelized, 8-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; cut leaves crosswise into thin (shred-like) pieces. Place in a large bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add half of the parsley to the bowl with the kale. (Set remaining parsley aside for serving.)
Peel and thinly slice garlic. Add to the bowl.

instructions.primary_message: When the onions are caramelized, add kale, parsley, and garlic to the pot in handfuls, waiting for kale to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the kale is tender, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 oz Parmesan cheese

instructions.primary_message: When the kale is tender, add drained pasta, reserved pasta water, half of the Parmesan, vinegar, and crushed red pepper to the pot. Continue to cook, tossing frequently, until heated through, 3-4 minutes. Remove from heat. (Reserve remaining Parmesan for serving.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp balsamic vinegar
¾ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls; top with reserved Parmesan and parsley. Enjoy!

instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root

instructions.primary_message: In a shallow bowl, whisk together the minced garlic and ginger, soy sauce, vinegar, and sesame oil.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 tbsp gluten-free soy sauce
3 tbsp rice vinegar
1 ½ tsp toasted sesame oil

instructions.primary_message: Place the salmon flesh side down in the marinade and coat both sides; let it sit while you prepare the salad dressing.

instructions.primary_message: In a large bowl, prepare the salad dressing by whisking together the mayo, vinegar, soy sauce, sesame oil, and salt.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp mayonnaise
6 tbsp rice vinegar
1 ½ tsp gluten-free soy sauce
1 ½ tsp toasted sesame oil
⅜ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Add the sesame seeds to the skillet and cook, stirring frequently, until lightly browned, 3-4 minutes. Transfer to a small bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tsp sesame seeds

instructions.primary_message: Once sesame seeds have been removed, increase heat to medium-high. Add oil to the skillet and swirl to coat bottom. Place salmon in the skillet skin-side down, reserving marinade in the bowl. Cook until skin is crisp, 3-4 minutes, then flip over and pour the reserved marinade over top. Continue cooking salmon in the marinade until opaque, 3-4 more minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tbsp toasted sesame oil

instructions.primary_message: Wash the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 English cucumbers
3 avocados
1 ½ small bunch green onions (scallions)

instructions.primary_message: Halve the cucumbers crosswise, then quarter lengthwise and slice crosswise on an angle; add to the bowl with dressing. Wash, dry, and chop chives into small pieces. Place in a large bowl.

instructions.primary_message: Drain salmon, add to the bowl with the chives, and flake with a fork.

instructions.primary_message: Add eggs, flour, and spices to the bowl; stir until well combined.

3 eggs

1 ½ tsp paprika

instructions.primary_message: Using a ¼-cup measure, form the salmon mixture into ½-inch thick patties; place on a plate.

instructions.primary_message: While the fish cakes are cooking, wash and dry arugula (skip if it came pre-washed).

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide fish cakes between plates, then top with tzatziki. Add arugula to the plate, top with carrots, and drizzle with vinaigrette. Enjoy!

1 ½ cups tzatziki sauce
1 ½ (10 oz) bags shredded carrots
⅓ cup French vinaigrette

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. (Reserve 1 cup of cooking water before draining and set aside.)

1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

9 medium zucchini squash
1 ½ lemons
1 small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Trim and quarter zucchini lengthwise, then slice crosswise into ¼-inch thick pieces. Place in a large bowl and set aside.
Peel, halve, and small dice onions. Peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Preheat another large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add onion and garlic. Cook, stirring frequently, until starting to soften, 3-4 minutes.

instructions.primary_message: Add zucchini and salt to the pot with the onion. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until zucchini is tender, 8-10 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, zest and juice lemons into the reserved bowl.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add half to the bowl with the lemon. (Reserve remaining basil for serving.)

6 oz Parmesan cheese

Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add sausages and cook, turning occasionally, until cooked through, 12-15 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
6 pork sausages

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash, dry, trim, and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Place in a large bowl along with shredded cabbage, flour, eggs, and spices; stir to combine.

1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
1 ½ (14 oz) bags shredded cabbage (coleslaw mix)

1 ½ tsp garlic powder

Meanwhile, place yogurt, dressing, salt, and pepper in a small bowl. Stir to combine the sauce.

1 cup plain Greek yogurt

instructions.primary_message: Divide fritters and sausages between plates. Serve with sauce on the side for dipping and enjoy!

instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb lean ground beef
⅓ cup gluten-free bread crumbs

instructions.primary_message: While the meatballs are cooking, medium dice polenta. Place in another large pot along with broth, salt, and pepper. Bring to a simmer over medium-high heat.

3 (18 oz) tubes polenta, pre-cooked
24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Once the broth is simmering, reduce heat to medium. Using a potato masher, mash the polenta until smooth; continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until heated through, 3-4 minutes more. Remove from heat and cover to keep warm.
Meanwhile, wash and dry spinach (skip this step if it came pre-washed).
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (5 oz) pkgs baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Return the pot to medium-high heat. Add meatballs and marinara sauce, then stir to combine and bring to a simmer.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (24 oz) jars marinara sauce

instructions.primary_message: Once the sauce is simmering, add spinach to the pot in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Stir to combine and remove from heat.
To serve, divide polenta between plates or bowls; top with meatballs and sauce. Enjoy!

Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (12 oz) pkgs extra firm tofu

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups jasmine rice
3 cup water

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 limes
1 ½ (8 oz) pkgs sugar snap peas
1 ½ bunches radish
1 small pkg fresh mint
1 ½ avocados

instructions.primary_message: Juice limes and divide between two small bowls.
Peel and mince shallots. Add one of the bowls with lime juice along with fish sauce, soy sauce, sugar, and crushed red pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 shallots
3 tbsp fish sauce
3 tbsp tamari soy sauce
1 tbsp brown sugar
¾ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, add soy sauce, additional fish sauce, water, chili-garlic sauce, sugar, and cornstarch to the other bowl with the lime juice.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp tamari soy sauce
3 tbsp fish sauce
3 tbsp water
3 tbsp chili-garlic sauce
3 tbsp brown sugar
1 tbsp cornstarch

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Crumble tofu into large pieces with your fingers and add to the skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, until tofu is golden brown, 8-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp toasted sesame oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, thinly slice snap peas crosswise. Place on a large plate.
Trim and thinly slice radishes. Add to the plate with the snap peas.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the plate.
When the tofu is golden brown, reduce heat to medium, add sauce to the skillet, and gently stir to coat. Cook until sauce thickens slightly and coats tofu, about 1 minute. Remove from heat.
Halve and pit avocados; scoop out with a spoon and large dice the flesh. Add to the plate.
Roughly chop cashews and add to the plate.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ cup cashews, roasted unsalted

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide rice between bowls; top with tofu, snap peas, radish, avocado, mint, and cashews. Drizzle with dressing as desired and enjoy!
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
1 small bunch cilantro
3 limes
3 (8 oz) pkg sugar snap peas
3 mangoes
1 ½ avocados

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Place both in a large bowl along with soy sauce, water, honey, chili-garlic sauce, cornstarch, and oil. Whisk to combine the marinade.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 cloves garlic
⅓ cup tamari soy sauce
2 tbsp water
2 tbsp honey
1 ½ tbsp chili-garlic sauce
1 tbsp cornstarch
1 tbsp toasted sesame oil

instructions.primary_message: If using frozen shrimp, place them in the colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 ¼ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Add shrimp to the bowl with the marinade, stir to coat, and set aside.
Peel, halve, and mince onion. Place in another large bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: ½ medium red onion

instructions.primary_message: Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the bowl with the onion. (Reserve remaining cilantro for serving.)
Juice limes into the bowl.
Cut snap peas crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl.
Peel mangoes and slice flesh away from the pits, starting with the flat sides; medium dice. Add to the bowl.
Halve and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and medium dice. Add to the bowl along with salt and pepper. Gently stir to combine the salad and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add shrimp and marinade. Cook, stirring occasionally, until shrimp are opaque and sauce has thickened, about 4 minutes. Remove from heat.
Warm tortillas in another skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
instructions.secondary_message: 18 small corn tortillas

instructions.primary_message: Divide tortillas between plates; fill with a small portion of salad, shrimp, and reserved cilantro. Serve with remaining salad on the side and enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, roughly chop walnuts.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ cups walnuts

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add walnuts and cook, stirring frequently, until lightly browned, 2-3 minutes. Transfer to a small bowl. (Reserve skillet for the next step.)

Return skillet to medium heat, add oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bread crumbs and cook, stirring frequently, until golden and crispy, 3-5 minutes. Transfer to the bowl with the walnuts and set aside to cool.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ cup gluten-free bread crumbs
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place yogurt, Dijon, oil, water, honey, vinegar, salt, and pepper in a large bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup plain Greek yogurt
3 tbsp Dijon mustard
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp water
1 ½ tbsp honey
1 tbsp rice vinegar
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; cut leaves crosswise into thin (shred-like) pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing. Using your hands, massage kale with the dressing until wilted, 2-3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 bunches kale

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and quarter peaches lengthwise (around the pit); twist quarters to separate, then remove and discard pit. Medium dice the flesh and add to the bowl with the kale.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 peaches

instructions.primary_message: Crumble goat cheese into the bowl and gently toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (4 oz) logs goat cheese

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide the salad between plates or bowls; top with walnuts and crispy bread crumbs. Enjoy!
Place corn in a colander and run under hot water (from the tap) to thaw. Place on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry, then transfer to a large bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 cups frozen corn

instructions.primary_message: Add eggs, cheese, flour, and spices to the bowl with the corn. Stir to combine the batter.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 eggs
1 cup Parmesan cheese, shredded
1 cup gluten-free flour
1 ½ tsp chili powder
1 ½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.secondary_message: ¼ cup extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Working in batches, using a ¼-cup measure, drop batter into the skillet, spacing scoops a few inches apart; press down to form round fritters. Cook, flipping once, until fritters are golden brown, 3-5 minutes. Remove to a large paper towel-lined plate.
Meanwhile, wash and dry spinach (skip this step if it came pre-washed). Place in a clean large bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (5 oz) pkgs baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, halve, and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and medium dice. Add to the bowl with the spinach.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ avocados

instructions.primary_message: Drain and roughly chop roasted peppers. Add to the bowl along with vinaigrette, salt, and pepper. Toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (12 oz) jars roasted red bell peppers
⅓ cup French vinaigrette
3 pinch salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide fritters and salad between plates. Enjoy!

Meanwhile, wash and dry spinach (skip this step if it came pre-washed).
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (5 oz) pkgs baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Place water in a large skillet and bring to a simmer over medium-high heat.

instructions.primary_message: Once the water is simmering, add spinach in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding next handful. Place vinegar, honey, soy sauce, and salt in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the marinade.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp rice vinegar
1 ½ tbsp honey
1 tbsp tamari soy sauce
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, trim, and slice cucumbers crosswise into very thin rounds. Add to the bowl with the marinade; using your hands, gently massage cucumber with the marinade until wilted, 1-2 minutes. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ English cucumbers

instructions.primary_message: Return skillet to medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the salmon dry with paper towels and place, skin-side down, on a plate. Season with salt on the top-side.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb salmon fillet
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add salmon, skin-side down, and cook until skin is crispy and flesh is opaque, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp toasted sesame oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place tahini, sesame seeds, soy sauce, water, and honey in a small bowl. Whisk to combine the sesame dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup tahini
⅓ cup sesame seeds
3 tbsp tamari soy sauce
3 tbsp water
2 tbsp honey

instructions.primary_message: Using your hands, squeeze as much water from the spinach as you can. Place in another medium bowl, add half of the sesame dressing, and toss to coat. (Reserve remaining dressing for serving.)
Divide rice between bowls; top with salmon, spinach, and cucumbers. Serve with remaining dressing for drizzling over the salmon. Enjoy!

1 ½ cups jasmine rice

⅓ cup tamari soy sauce

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, stirring halfway through, until golden brown and slightly crispy, about 25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 limes
1 ½ jalapeño peppers
3 tomatoes
1 ½ heads romaine lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince shallots. Place in the reserved bowl.

Small dice tomatoes and add to the bowl.
Place corn in the colander and rinse under hot water (from the tap) to defrost. Add to the bowl along with oil, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine the salsa and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups frozen corn
1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups plain Greek yogurt
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp cumin, ground
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Coarsely grate cheese.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ (8 oz) block cheddar cheese

instructions.primary_message: Halve lettuce lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips.
To serve, divide rice, tofu, lettuce, cheese, and salsa between plates or bowls. Drizzle with lime crema and enjoy!
Pat chicken dry with paper towels. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Sprinkle both sides with flour and salt.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
3 tbsp gluten-free flour
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add chicken and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove chicken to a plate. (Reserve skillet with cooking juices for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 oranges
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
1 ½ (5 oz) pkgs spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Using a clean cutting board, peel and separate oranges into segments; cut segments crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl with the orange and set aside.

When the chicken is done, return skillet (with cooking juices) to medium heat. Add orange, green onion, water, cranberries, coriander, and salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, until orange softens and relish has slightly thickened, 3-4 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup water
⅓ cup dried cranberries
¾ tsp coriander, ground
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place mixed greens, carrots, feta, and vinaigrette in a large bowl. Gently toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (10 oz) bags shredded carrots
1 ½ (4 oz) pkgs crumbled feta cheese

instructions.secondary_message:
3 small pkgs fresh basil
1 ½ pints grape tomatoes
1 ½ (5 oz) pkgs baby arugula

instructions.primary_message: Mince pine nuts and place in a small bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: ⅓ cup pine nuts

instructions.primary_message: Pick basil leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the pine nuts.
Add oil and spices to the bowl, then stir to combine the pesto. Add water, 1 teaspoon at a time, if needed, to make a spreadable consistency. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper
½ tsp garlic powder

instructions.primary_message: Place oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper in a large bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tbsp balsamic vinegar
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven. (Skip this step if you are using a toaster for the bread.)

instructions.secondary_message: 12 slices gluten-free bread

instructions.primary_message: Finely grate Parmesan. Set aside for the eggs.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 oz Parmesan cheese

instructions.primary_message: Crack eggs into another large bowl, then season with salt and pepper. Whisk until smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 eggs
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Pour the egg mixture into the skillet and scramble using a combination of stirring and flipping, making sure to bring in all the mixture from the edges of the pan. Cook until the eggs are no longer runny. Remove from heat, add Parmesan, and stir to combine.
Meanwhile, halve the tomatoes and add to the bowl with the dressing along with the arugula. Toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad and toast between plates. Spread toast with pesto and top with cheesy scrambled eggs. Enjoy!

6 tbsp cold water

3 small bunches asparagus
3 red bell peppers
1 ½ small bunch green onions (scallions)

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince or grate the ginger. Peel and mince the garlic. Transfer both to a small bowl.

3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Slice the steak into thin strips.

instructions.primary_message: Add oil to the skillet and swirl to coat bottom. Add the steak strips and cook until browned, 1-2 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.

instructions.primary_message: Once steak has been transferred, add more oil to the skillet. Add the asparagus, bell pepper, ginger, and garlic. Cook, stirring frequently, until vegetables are crisp-tender and lightly browned, 2-3 minutes.

instructions.primary_message: Return beef to the skillet and add green onions and sauce. Cook until sauce is slightly thickened, 1-2 minutes.

3 tbsp capers

1 ½ (12 oz) jars roasted red bell peppers

Roughly chop cashews. Add to the bowl, along with the carrots, and stir to combine the salad.

¾ cup cashews, roasted unsalted

6 pork chops, boneless
⅜ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Add oil to the skillet and swirl to coat bottom. Add the pork and stir-fry until browned, 2-3 minutes. Transfer to a plate.

instructions.primary_message: Once pork has been removed, add more oil to the skillet. Add the eggplant and stir-fry until lightly browned and softened, 4-5 minutes.

instructions.primary_message: Add the garlic and ginger to the skillet. Stir fry with the eggplant for 1-2 minutes.

instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp butter, unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Working in batches, using a ¼-cup measure, drop batter into the skillet, spacing scoops a few inches apart. Cook, flipping once, until pancakes are golden and cooked through, 2-3 minutes. Remove to a plate.
Meanwhile, peel and thinly slice bananas.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 bananas

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide pancakes between plates; top with sliced banana, then drizzle with honey. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp honey

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until almost done, 6-8 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
15 oz gluten-free rotini pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place hummus, milk, salt, and pepper in a medium saucepan. Stir to combine and bring to a simmer over medium heat. Once simmering, remove sauce from heat, cover with a lid to keep warm, and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups hummus
12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) whole milk
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the sauce is heating, drain and roughly chop roasted peppers and olives. Place both in a medium bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (12 oz) jars roasted red bell peppers
¾ cup Kalamata olives, pitted

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and pick basil leaves off the stems; roll up crosswise and thinly slice into ribbons. Add to the bowl with the peppers and olives, then set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: When the pasta is almost done, add kale to the pot and stir to combine. Continue to cook until pasta and kale are tender, 2-3 minutes more.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (10 oz) bags kale, cut and ready to use

instructions.primary_message: Drain pasta and kale in a colander. Return to the pot along with the sauce, peppers, olives, and basil; gently stir to combine.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls, then top with feta. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (4 oz) pkgs crumbled feta cheese

line_items.ingredient_name: kale, cut and ready to use

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch cilantro
1 ½ yellow bell peppers
1 ½ (5 oz) pkgs spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Divide between two large bowls; set one bowl aside for later use.
Drain salmon and flake with a fork. Add to the bowl with the cilantro along with eggs, bread crumbs, Parmesan, chili powder, and salt. Stir to combine the salmon mixture.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 (7.5 oz) cans wild pink salmon, traditional style
6 eggs
¾ cup gluten-free bread crumbs
¾ cup Parmesan cheese, shredded
1 tbsp chili powder
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
instructions.secondary_message: ¼ cup extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Working in batches, using a ⅓-cup measure, drop salmon mixture into the skillet, spacing scoops a few inches apart; press down to form round fritters. Cook, flipping once, until fritters are golden brown, about 3 minutes. Remove to a paper towel-lined plate.
Meanwhile, trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers. Add to the remaining bowl with the cilantro along with the mixed greens. Stir to combine the salad.
Divide fritters and salad between plates; drizzle salad with dressing. Serve with salsa on the side and enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup ranch dressing
1 ½ cup salsa

instructions.primary_message: Divide dressing between two large bowls. (Set one bowl aside for the romaine salad.)
instructions.secondary_message: 1 cup Caesar dressing

instructions.primary_message: Drain and rinse chickpeas. Add to the first bowl with the dressing along with salt and pepper. Using a fork or potato masher, roughly mash chickpeas until semi-smooth. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (15 oz) cans garbanzo beans (chickpeas)
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven. (Skip this step if you are using a toaster for the bread.)
Wash, dry, and halve grapes. Add to the second bowl with the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ lb red grapes

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and chop (or tear) lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 hearts romaine hearts

instructions.primary_message: Roughly chop pecans and add to the bowl. Toss to combine the salad and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: ⅓ cup pecan halves

instructions.primary_message: Divide bread between two baking sheet pans. Working in batches, place in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through, until toasted, about 2 minutes; remove from oven. (Alternatively, you can use a toaster.)
instructions.secondary_message: 12 slices gluten-free bread

instructions.primary_message: Divide toast between plates and top with chickpea salad. Serve with romaine salad on the side and enjoy!
Preheat oven to 450°F. Coat a large baking dish with butter.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tsp butter, unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and quarter peaches lengthwise (around the pit); twist quarters to separate, then remove and discard pits. Slice each quarter into ½-inch thick wedges. Transfer to the baking dish and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 peaches

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, zest, and juice lemons over peaches in the baking dish; set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ lemons

instructions.primary_message: Place flour, milk, sugar, baking powder, and salt in a medium bowl. Stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cup gluten-free flour
9 fl oz (1 ⅛ cups) whole milk
½ cup brown sugar
2 ½ tsp baking powder
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Place butter in a small saucepan set over medium-low and heat. Once the butter is melted, add to the bowl with the flour and stir to combine the topping (being careful not to over-mix).
instructions.secondary_message: ½ cup butter, unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Spoon topping over the peaches, then spread out evenly. Sprinkle additional sugar on top.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 tbsp brown sugar

instructions.primary_message: Place cobbler in the oven and bake until topping is golden brown and peaches are tender, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide peach cobbler and ice cream between bowls. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 36 fl oz (4 ½ cups) vanilla ice cream

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic. Place in a large bowl along with chicken, bread crumbs, mayo, Worcestershire, and spices. Mix with your hands until well combined; set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
1 ½ lb ground chicken
¾ cup gluten-free bread crumbs
2 tbsp mayonnaise
1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
1 tbsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp rosemary, dried
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry portobello mushrooms. Remove stems and carefully scrape out the gills. Rub with oil, then season with salt and pepper; place cap-side down on a large plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 caps portobello mushrooms
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Using your hands, divide chicken mixture between the insides of mushrooms, spreading evenly to the edges. Gently press to adhere.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, thinly slice cheese.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ (8 oz) block mozzarella cheese

instructions.primary_message: Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Working in batches if necessary, add burger patties, chicken-side down and cook, undisturbed, until the chicken is golden brown and cooked through, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Flip patties, top with cheese, and cook until mushrooms are golden brown and fork-tender, 6-8 minutes more. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, peel, halve, and mince onion. Place in a clean large bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: ½ medium red onion

instructions.primary_message: Roughly chop sun-dried tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the onion along with oil, vinegar, honey, Dijon, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
24 sun-dried tomatoes, oil-packed
¼ cup extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp red wine vinegar
2 tbsp honey
2 tbsp Dijon mustard
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the mixed greens (skip this step if they came pre-washed). Add to the bowl with the dressing, along with pumpkin seeds, and toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (5 oz) pkgs spring mix (mixed greens)
¾ cup pumpkin seeds

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls; top with cheesy burger patties. Enjoy!
Drain and roughly chop roasted peppers. Divide between two large bowls. (Set one bowl aside for the salad.)
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (12 oz) jars roasted red bell peppers

instructions.primary_message: Add pork, bread crumbs, eggs, salt, and pepper to the first bowl with the peppers. Use your hands to combine the pork mixture. Using a ¼-cup measure, form the mixture into ½-inch thick patties and place on a plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb lean ground pork
¾ cup gluten-free bread crumbs
3 eggs
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add patties and cook, flipping once, until golden and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash, dry, and shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the second bowl with the peppers.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 small bunch fresh dill

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, trim, and halve cucumbers lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ English cucumbers

instructions.primary_message: Add carrots, almonds, and vinaigrette to the bowl, then stir to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (10 oz) bags shredded carrots
⅓ cup almonds, sliced
⅓ cup French vinaigrette

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide patties and salad between plates. Enjoy!
Preheat the oven to 500°F, position rack in the centre, and place a baking sheet inside to warm up.
Peel and mince the garlic. Peel and mince or grate the ginger.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 cloves garlic
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root

instructions.primary_message: In a large bowl, whisk together water and cornstarch. Add the minced garlic and ginger, honey, rice vinegar, and soy sauce; whisk again.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 tbsp cold water
1 ½ tsp cornstarch
3 tbsp honey
3 tbsp rice vinegar
6 tbsp gluten-free soy sauce

instructions.primary_message: Add the chicken to the sauce and toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 ¾ lb chicken drumsticks

instructions.primary_message: Remove baking sheet from the oven and line with foil. Add the chicken, reserving the sauce in the bowl.
Place in the oven and bake until chicken is golden brown and cooked through, about 30 minutes. Spoon teriyaki sauce over the chicken a couple times during cooking until there is no more sauce left.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Wash the snap peas.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 (8 oz) pkg sugar snap peas

instructions.primary_message: Add oil to the skillet and swirl to coat bottom. Add the peas and season with salt and pepper. Cook, tossing occasionally, until bright green and tender-crisp, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp virgin coconut oil
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Serve chicken drumsticks with sugar snap peas on the side. Sprinkle with sesame seeds and enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tsp sesame seeds

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 375°F. Position rack in the upper third of the oven.

Divide prosciutto between two baking sheet pans. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and cook until prosciutto is crisp, 3-5 minutes. Remove from oven and transfer crispy prosciutto to a plate; set aside to cool. (Reserve baking sheets for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message: 12 slices prosciutto

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lb cremini mushrooms
1 small pkg chives
1 ½ heads butter (Boston) lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Thinly slice mushrooms.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add mushrooms and cook, stirring occasionally, until deep brown and tender, 14-16 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: While the mushrooms are cooking, change the oven to broil on high.

Divide bread between the reserved baking sheets. Working in batches, place in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through, until toasted, about 2 minutes; remove from oven. (Alternatively, you can use a toaster.)
instructions.secondary_message: 12 slices gluten-free bread

instructions.primary_message: Crack eggs into a large bowl, then season with salt and pepper. Whisk until smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
18 eggs
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the mushrooms are done, add vinegar and salt to the skillet, then stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp white wine vinegar
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Pour egg mixture into the skillet with the mushrooms and scramble using a combination of stirring and flipping, making sure to bring in all the mixture from the edges of the pan. Cook until the eggs are no longer runny. Remove from heat, crumble goat cheese into the skillet, and stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (4 oz) logs goat cheese

instructions.primary_message: Place oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper in a clean large bowl, then whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp white wine vinegar
3 pinch salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Chop chives into small pieces. Place half in the bowl with the dressing (reserving the rest for serving).
Chop (or tear) lettuce leaves into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad and toast between plates. Top toast with cheesy mushroom scramble, reserved chives, and crispy prosciutto. Enjoy!
Preheat the oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb new potatoes
3 medium zucchini squash
3 red bell peppers
1 ½ lemons
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Quarter potatoes and divide between two large baking sheet pans.
Peel, halve, and large dice onions. Add to the baking sheets with the potatoes, then drizzle with oil and season with spices. Stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium red onions
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp Italian seasoning
1 ½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until the potatoes start to soften, 10-12 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim and large dice zucchini. Place in a large bowl.
Trim, seed, and large dice bell peppers. Add to the bowl with the zucchini and set aside.
Zest lemons into a small bowl. Juice lemons into another small bowl.

Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the bowl with the lemon zest and half to the bowl with the lemon juice. (Set the bowl with the lemon juice aside for later use.)
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the lemon zest along with bread crumbs, oil, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine the gremolata topping.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
¾ cup gluten-free bread crumbs
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pat cod dry with paper towels and cut into portions (if necessary). Sprinkle cod with gremolata topping, pressing gently to adhere.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 ¼ lb cod fillet

instructions.primary_message: Once the potatoes have softened, remove from oven. Add zucchini and bell pepper to the baking sheets, stir to combine, and spread out in an even layer. Add cod to the baking sheets, nestling it into the veggies.
Continue to bake until veggies are fork-tender, gremolata topping is golden brown, and cod is cooked through, 10-12 minutes more.
Meanwhile, add yogurt, mayo, and salt to the bowl with the lemon juice. Stir to combine the sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup plain Greek yogurt
¼ cup mayonnaise
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: When the cod is done, remove baking sheet from the oven. Add olives to the veggies and stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 cup Kalamata olives, pitted

instructions.primary_message: Divide cod and veggies between plates or bowls. Serve with sauce on the side and enjoy!
Place oil, vinegar, and spices in a large bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp white wine vinegar
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper
½ tsp garlic powder

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Gently crack eggs into the skillet and cook until the tops of the whites are set but the yolks are still runny, about 4 minutes. Remove from heat and season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
6 eggs
3 pinch salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash, dry, trim, and thinly slice radishes. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ bunches radish

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry arugula (skip if it came pre-washed). Add to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (5 oz) pkgs baby arugula

instructions.primary_message: Small dice cheese and add to the bowl. Toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ (8 oz) block cheddar cheese

instructions.primary_message: Chop or tear prosciutto into bite-sized pieces.
instructions.secondary_message: 12 slices prosciutto

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls; top with prosciutto and eggs. Enjoy!
Preheat oven to 400°F.
Melt butter in a large pot set over medium heat.
instructions.secondary_message: ⅓ cup butter, unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, roughly chop walnuts. Place in a medium bowl along with flour, sugar, and salt.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup walnuts
1 cup gluten-free flour
⅓ cup granulated sugar
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Once the butter is melted, drizzle into the bowl with the flour. Use a fork to stir and combine the streusel topping into rough, sandy clumps (it should be combined but not even). (Reserve pot for later use.)

Transfer streusel mixture to a baking sheet pan and spread out in an even layer. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, stirring halfway through, until streusel is golden brown and crisp, 6-8 minutes. Remove from oven and let cool for 5 minutes.
While the streusel is baking, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ limes
3 (6 oz) pkgs raspberries
3 (6 oz) pkgs blackberries

instructions.primary_message: Return pot to medium heat. Juice limes into the pot, then add raspberries, blackberries, and additional sugar. Cook, stirring occasionally, until berries are juicy and starting to break down, 6-8 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message: ¼ cup granulated sugar

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide berries and ice cream between bowls; top with walnut streusel. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 36 fl oz (4 ½ cups) vanilla ice cream

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ limes
1 ½ jalapeño peppers
1 ½ small bunches cilantro
3 tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Juice limes into a medium bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the lime juice along with oil, sugar, cumin, and salt. Whisk to combine the lime mixture.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp brown sugar
1 ½ tsp cumin, ground
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Quarter jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Mince and add to the bowl with the lime mixture. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the jalapeño-cilantro sauce; set aside.
Slice mozzarella and tomatoes into thin rounds.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (8 oz) pkgs fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide mozzarella and tomato slices between plates; top with jalapeño-cilantro sauce. Enjoy!
Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 crowns broccoli
1 ½ lemons
1 small pkg fresh mint

instructions.primary_message: Separate broccoli into bite-sized florets; cut stems into smaller pieces. Divide between two large baking sheet pans, drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until the broccoli is starting to soften, 7-8 minutes.

While the broccoli is roasting, fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
15 oz gluten-free rotini pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, roughly chop pistachios.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 cup pistachios, unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Once the broccoli has started to soften, remove from the oven. Sprinkle with pistachios, stir to combine, and spread out in an even layer.
Return baking sheets to the oven. Continue to roast until broccoli is tender and lightly charred and pistachios are toasted, 12-15 minutes more. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan and place in a medium bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 oz Parmesan cheese

instructions.primary_message: Zest and juice lemons into the bowl with the Parmesan.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the bowl along with the spices. (Reserve remaining mint for serving.)
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
½ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the pasta is done, reserve 1 cup of cooking water, then drain. Return pasta and reserved cooking water to the pot.

Add roasted broccoli, pistachios, and Parmesan mixture to the pot. Set the pot over medium-high heat and cook, stirring often, until liquid has evaporated and Parmesan is melted, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls and sprinkle with reserved mint. Enjoy!
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups jasmine rice
3 cup water

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
1 ½ medium heads napa cabbage
1 ½ lb cremini mushrooms

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.

While the rice is cooking, peel and mince ginger and garlic. Place both in a small bowl along with soy sauce, oil, sesame seeds, water, cornstarch, vinegar, sugar, chili-garlic sauce, and pepper. Stir to combine the stir-fry sauce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 cloves garlic
½ cup tamari soy sauce
3 tbsp toasted sesame oil
3 tbsp sesame seeds
3 tbsp water
2 tbsp cornstarch
1 ½ tbsp rice vinegar
1 ½ tbsp brown sugar
1 tbsp chili-garlic sauce
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Place half in a large bowl. (Reserve remaining green onions for serving.)
Trim off and discard root end of each cabbage; quarter lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the green onions.
Thinly slice mushrooms. Add to the bowl and set aside.
Pat the chicken dry with paper towels and cut into bite-sized pieces.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 ¼ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to brown, about 4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp toasted sesame oil

instructions.primary_message: Add veggies to the pot and stir-fry until veggies are tender and chicken is cooked through, 6-7 minutes.
Add stir-fry sauce to the pot and continue to cook until sauce thickens, about 1 minute. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide rice and stir-fry between plates or bowls. Top with reserved green onions and enjoy!
Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 medium turnips
1 ½ lemons
1 ½ (5 oz) pkgs baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil.
While the water is heating, peel, trim, and medium dice turnips.
Once the water in the pot is boiling, uncover, then add salt, turnip, and pasta; stir for a few seconds. Cook until turnip is just tender and pasta reaches desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ tsp salt
15 oz gluten-free macaroni (elbow) pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, cut cream cheese into small pieces. Coarsely grate cheddar. Place both in another large pot.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (8 oz) block cream cheese
¾ (8 oz) block cheddar cheese

instructions.primary_message: Add milk, Dijon, and spices to the pot with the cheese. Set over medium-high heat and bring to a simmer, stirring often. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium and cook, stirring frequently, until sauce is combined and thickened, 5-6 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) whole milk
2 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper
¼ tsp nutmeg, ground

instructions.primary_message: When the pasta and turnip are done, drain in a colander, and transfer to the pot with the sauce. Stir to combine, then transfer to a large baking dish and spread out in an even layer.
Sprinkle bread crumbs over the cheesy macaroni. Place baking dish in the oven and bake until bread crumbs are golden, 8-10 minutes. Remove from oven.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ cup gluten-free bread crumbs

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, juice lemons into a large bowl. Add oil, honey, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp honey
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add spinach to the bowl with the dressing, then toss to coat.
To serve, divide cheesy macaroni and salad between plates. Enjoy!
Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium heads cauliflower
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
6 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
1 ½ lb green beans

instructions.primary_message: Cut each cauliflower head into quarters; using a box grater, hold the stem end of the cauliflower and coarsely grate. (Alternatively, transfer cauliflower to the bowl of a food processor; pulse until rice-like in consistency.) Divide between two baking sheet pans.
Trim and thinly slice green onions crosswise. Add half to the baking sheets with the cauliflower and place half in a small bowl.
Peel and mince ginger. Sprinkle half over the cauliflower and add half to the bowl with the green onion.
Drizzle oil over the cauliflower and season with salt. Stir to combine, then spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp toasted sesame oil
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring cauliflower halfway through, until rice is tender and golden, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.
While the cauliflower is roasting, trim and halve green beans crosswise.
Preheat a large pot over high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add green beans and cook, stirring frequently, until starting to brown and soften, 6-8 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp toasted sesame oil

instructions.primary_message: Add pork and salt to the pot. Cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until the pork is browned and crumbly and green beans are tender, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
