instructions.primary_message: Medium dice tofu and add to the bowl with the marinade. (Wipe baking sheet dry with paper towels and reserve for the next step.)

Quarter mushrooms, add to the bowl with the tofu, and gently stir to combine. Divide tofu and mushrooms between the reserved baking sheet and another large baking sheet; spread out in an even layer. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Place baking sheets in the oven and roast, stirring halfway through, until mushrooms are tender and tofu is golden, 18-20 minutes. Remove from oven.

Meanwhile, fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Remove from heat, uncover, and add rice noodles. Soak for 10 minutes or according to package directions. Drain in a colander and rinse under cold water.
instructions.secondary_message: 15 oz flat rice (pad thai) noodles

instructions.primary_message: While the noodles are soaking, juice limes into the reserved bowl.
Peel and mince shallot and garlic. Add both to the bowl with the lime juice along with fish sauce, sugar, and crushed red pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 shallot
3 cloves garlic
⅓ cup fish sauce
1 tbsp brown sugar
1 ½ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. When the tofu and mushrooms are done, add half of the mint to the baking sheets, then stir to combine. (Reserve remaining mint for serving.)
Roughly chop peanuts.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ cup peanuts, roasted unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Divide noodles between bowls; top with tofu, mushrooms, pickled veggies, reserved mint, and peanuts. Serve with dressing on the side and enjoy!
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium heads cauliflower
3 medium zucchini squash
2 small bunches green onions (scallions)
3 jalapeño peppers
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root

instructions.primary_message: Pat the steak dry with paper towels, place on a cutting board, and slice crosswise into thin strips. Place in a medium bowl, add coconut aminos, and stir to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb flank steaks
3 tbsp coconut aminos

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.

Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add steak strips and cook, undisturbed, until browned, about 3 minutes. Turn and continue to cook until desired doneness, 1-2 minutes more. Remove to a plate. (Reserve pot and cooking juices for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp toasted sesame oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, cut each cauliflower head into quarters; using a box grater, hold the stem end of the cauliflower and coarsely grate. (Alternatively, transfer cauliflower to the bowl of a food processor; pulse until rice-like in consistency.) Place in a large bowl.
Trim and coarsely grate zucchini. Using your hands, gently squeeze to remove excess water, then add to the bowl with the cauliflower.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into 1-inch pieces. Add to the bowl.

Return the pot (with cooking juices) to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add cauliflower, zucchini, green onion, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until cauliflower is soft and starting to brown, 6-7 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp toasted sesame oil
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, quarter jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level, then mince. Place in a clean medium bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Add both to the bowl with the jalapeño, along with coconut aminos, and stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
3 tbsp coconut aminos

instructions.primary_message: When the cauliflower is done, return steak strips (with any accumulated juices) to the pot. Add the jalapeño mixture and continue to cook, stirring frequently, until warmed through and fragrant, about 1 minute. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide fried cauliflower rice between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
1 ½ lb cremini mushrooms
1 ½ bunches Swiss chard
1 small bunch cilantro
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
1 ½ limes

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Place both in a medium bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Thinly slice mushrooms. Add to the bowl with the ginger and garlic.

Fold chard leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Cut leaves into bite-sized pieces and thinly slice the stems, keeping them separate. Place leaves in a large bowl, reserving stems for later use.
Preheat a large pot over medium heat.

Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add ginger, garlic, mushrooms, chard stems, pork, and spices. Cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until the pork is cooked through and chard stems are tender, 6-7 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp neutral vegetable oil
2 ¼ lb lean ground pork
¾ tsp crushed red pepper
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add broth, water, soy sauce, and fish sauce to the pot. Stir to combine, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
48 fl oz (6 cups) chicken or vegetable broth
6 cup water
¼ cup tamari soy sauce
¼ cup fish sauce

instructions.primary_message: Once the broth is boiling, uncover, add rice noodles, and stir to combine the soup. Reduce heat to medium and simmer, stirring occasionally, until noodles are almost soft, 6-8 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 9 oz flat rice (pad thai) noodles

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the bowl with the chard leaves. (Reserve remaining cilantro for serving.)
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add half to the bowl. (Reserve remaining green onions for serving.)
When the noodles are almost soft, add chard leaves, cilantro, and green onions to the pot in handfuls, waiting for the leaves to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
Continue to cook until noodles and chard leaves are tender, 2-3 minutes more.
Juice limes into the pot, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
To serve, divide soup between bowls, then top with reserved cilantro and green onions. Enjoy!

Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain, return to the pot, and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
15 oz gluten-free spaghetti pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, fill another large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); add vinegar, cover with a lid, and bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Once the water in the pot is boiling, reduce heat to medium-low.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 tbsp white wine vinegar

instructions.primary_message: While the water is heating, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
1 ½ small bunches asparagus
1 ½ (5 oz) pkgs baby spinach
1 ½ lemons

instructions.primary_message: Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Place in a medium bowl.
Snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus; cut into 1-inch pieces. Add to the bowl with the green onions.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince garlic. Add garlic and peas to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
1 ½ cups frozen peas

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until fork-tender, 5-6 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup butter, unsalted
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan. Place in the reserved bowl and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 oz Parmesan cheese

instructions.primary_message: Gently crack eggs into additional small bowls (two eggs per bowl).
instructions.secondary_message: 12 eggs

instructions.primary_message: Adjust the heat of the pot as necessary so that the vinegar water is simmering. Working in batches, gently tip bowls into the pot, sliding the eggs carefully into the water. Cook until whites are set but yolks are still soft, 2½-3 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer eggs to a plate.

When the veggies are done, add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Zest and juice lemons into the skillet, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
Add veggies to the pot with the drained spaghetti and set pot over medium-high heat. Cook, tossing occasionally, until warmed through, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide pasta and eggs between bowls. Top with Parmesan and enjoy!
Preheat oven to 400°F. Coat a baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 medium zucchini squash
3 lemons
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)

instructions.primary_message: Trim and coarsely grate zucchini. Transfer to a colander and sprinkle with salt. Place the colander in a bowl to catch the excess moisture and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, zest and juice half of the lemons into a small bowl. Cut remaining lemons into wedges and set aside for serving.
Add yogurt to the bowl with the lemon, along with spices, and stir to combine the sauce. Add water, a few teaspoons at a time, if needed, to reach a drizzling consistency. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups plain Greek yogurt
¾ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Mince pistachios. Place in another small bowl along with bread crumbs, oil, and salt; stir to combine the coating.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup pistachios, unsalted
½ cup gluten-free bread crumbs
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 pinch salt

instructions.primary_message: Pat halibut dry with paper towels and place, skin-side down, on the baking sheet; season the top side with salt and pepper. Spread the fish with mayo, then sprinkle evenly with the coating, pressing gently to adhere.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb halibut fillet
¾ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper
¼ cup mayonnaise

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven and roast until halibut is cooked through, 10-15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, use paper towels or a clean cloth to squeeze excess moisture out of the grated zucchini, then transfer to a large bowl.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl with the zucchini along with eggs, flour, baking powder, pepper, and salt. Stir to combine the batter.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 eggs
1 cup gluten-free flour
1 ½ tsp baking powder
¾ tsp black pepper
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
instructions.secondary_message: ¼ cup extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Working in batches, using a ¼-cup measure, drop batter into the skillet, spacing scoops a few inches apart; press down to form round fritters. Cook, flipping once, until fritters are golden brown, 3-5 minutes. Remove to a paper towel-lined plate.
Divide fish and fritters between plates; drizzle yogurt sauce over fritters. Serve with lemon wedges for squeezing and enjoy!
Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 medium zucchini squash
1 ½ lb cremini mushrooms
3 tomatoes
1 ½ limes

instructions.primary_message: Trim and quarter zucchini lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Divide between two large baking sheet pans.
Thinly slice mushrooms. Add to the baking sheets with the zucchini.
Drain and rinse beans. Add to the baking sheets, drizzle with oil, and season with spices. Stir to combine and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (15 oz) cans pinto beans
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp cumin, ground
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until veggies and beans are tender, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, small dice tomatoes and set aside for serving.
Juice limes into a medium bowl. Add feta, mayo, chili powder, and salt, then stir to combine the sauce. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (4 oz) pkgs crumbled feta cheese
⅓ cup mayonnaise
1 ½ tsp chili powder
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: When the veggies are almost done, warm tortillas in a skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
instructions.secondary_message: 18 small corn tortillas

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide tortillas between plates, then fill with roasted veggies and beans. Top tacos with tomatoes and sauce. Enjoy!
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 fennel bulbs
1 ½ bunches kale
1 ½ lemons

instructions.primary_message: Trim off root end and stalks of the fennel, leaving only the white bulbs. Cut fennel bulbs in half lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add fennel and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until soft and starting to brown, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Add sausage to the pot. Cook, breaking it apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ lb ground pork sausage

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel and thinly slice garlic.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: When the sausage is done, add garlic and crushed red pepper to the pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until fragrant, about 1 minute.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add broth, water, and pasta to the pot. Stir to combine the soup and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until pasta is almost tender, 4-5 minutes more.
instructions.secondary_message:
72 fl oz (9 cups) chicken or vegetable broth
1 ½ cup water
9 oz gluten-free rotini pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; cut leaves crosswise into thin (shred-like) pieces.

When the pasta is almost done, add kale to the pot in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until the kale and pasta are tender, about 1 minute. Remove from heat.
Juice lemons into the pot and stir to combine the soup.
To serve, divide soup between bowls and drizzle with oil. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 limes
3 jalapeño peppers
1 small bunch cilantro
3 mangoes
1 ½ English cucumbers
3 avocados

instructions.primary_message: Juice limes and divide between two large bowls.

Quarter jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Mince and divide between the two bowls. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)

Shave cilantro leaves off the stems. Mince half of the leaves, add to one of the bowls, and set aside for the guacamole. Roughly chop remaining leaves, add to the remaining bowl, and stir to combine the dressing.
Peel mangoes and slice flesh away from the pits, starting with the flat sides; medium dice. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and medium dice cucumbers. Add to the bowl, along with oil and salt, then stir to combine the salad. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven. (Skip this step if you are using a toaster for the bread.)
Peel, halve, and small dice onion. Add to the bowl for the guacamole.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 medium red onion

instructions.primary_message: Halve and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh. Add to the bowl, along with salt, and mash with a fork or potato masher until guacamole is semi-smooth.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Drain and rinse chickpeas. Add to the bowl with the guacamole and lightly mash chickpeas until semi-smooth and combined.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (15 oz) cans garbanzo beans (chickpeas)

instructions.primary_message: Divide bread between two baking sheet pans. Working in batches, place in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through, until toasted, about 2 minutes; remove from oven. (Alternatively, you can use a toaster.)
instructions.secondary_message: 12 slices gluten-free bread

instructions.primary_message: Divide toast between plates and top with chickpea guacamole. Serve with mango-cucumber salad on the side and enjoy!
Preheat oven to 450°F.

Wash, dry, and separate broccoli into bite-sized florets; cut stems into smaller pieces. Divide between two large baking sheet pans, drizzle with oil, and season with salt; toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 crowns broccoli
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until broccoli is golden brown and tender, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bread crumbs and salt; cook, stirring frequently, until golden and crispy, 3-5 minutes. Transfer to a small bowl and set aside to cool. (Reserve skillet for next step.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ cup gluten-free bread crumbs
3 pinch salt

instructions.primary_message: Wipe the skillet clean with paper towels. Return to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add sausages and cook, turning occasionally, until cooked through, 12-15 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
6 pork sausages

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan. Transfer to another small bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ oz Parmesan cheese

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic. Mince anchovy fillets. Add both to the bowl with the Parmesan.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
3 anchovy fillets, packed in oil

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and juice lemons into the bowl. Add mayo, oil, pepper, and salt; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lemons
3 tbsp mayonnaise
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp black pepper
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide sausages and broccoli between plates. Drizzle broccoli with dressing and top with crispy bread crumbs. Enjoy!
Place oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper in a large bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp neutral vegetable oil
3 tbsp rice vinegar
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
9 medium carrots
1 ½ jalapeño peppers
1 ½ small bunches cilantro
3 tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots. Add to the bowl with the dressing.

Quarter jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Mince and add to the bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl, stir to combine the salad, and set aside.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-6 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp neutral vegetable oil
1 ½ lb ground chicken
1 ½ tbsp garam masala
1 ½ tbsp chili powder
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel and mince shallot. Place in a medium bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 shallot

instructions.primary_message: Small dice tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the shallot along with yogurt, water, salt, and pepper; stir to combine the raita. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups plain Greek yogurt
3 tbsp water
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Warm tortillas in another skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
instructions.secondary_message: 18 small corn tortillas

instructions.primary_message: Divide tortillas between plates, fill with chicken, then top with raita. Serve with carrot salad on the side and enjoy!
Divide dressing between a small and large bowl. Set large bowl aside for the salad.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ cup ranch dressing

instructions.primary_message: Add ketchup, Dijon, Worcestershire, and smoked paprika to the small bowl with the ranch. Stir to combine the Russian dressing and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp ketchup
2 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
1 ½ tsp smoked paprika

instructions.primary_message: Thinly slice cheese.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ (8 oz) block mozzarella cheese

instructions.primary_message: Drain sauerkraut in a colander to remove excess liquid.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ cups sauerkraut

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

While the skillet heats up, place the bread slices on a flat surface. Evenly spread with Russian dressing; layer half of the slices with cheese, roast beef, and sauerkraut. Cover sandwiches with the remaining bread slices.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 slices gluten-free bread
24 oz deli roast beef

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, place sandwiches in the skillet and cook until the bottoms are golden brown, 2-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp butter, unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Remove the sandwiches to a plate and add more butter to the skillet. Return sandwiches to the skillet, browned-side up, and cook until golden brown on the other side and the cheese is melted, 2-4 minutes more. Transfer to a cutting board and slice in half.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp butter, unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the mixed greens (skip this step if they came pre-washed). Add to the large bowl with the ranch dressing and toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (5 oz) pkgs spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide sandwiches and salad between plates. Enjoy!
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate. Season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb ribeye steak
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Remove to a clean plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside to rest, 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 tbsp neutral vegetable oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ oranges
3 jalapeño peppers
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 ½ bunches radish
1 ½ avocados
1 small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Zest and juice oranges into a large bowl. Add oil, soy sauce, vinegar, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp neutral vegetable oil
3 tbsp tamari soy sauce
2 tbsp red wine vinegar
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and slice onions crosswise into thin half-moons. Peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the dressing and stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium red onions
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Halve jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Slice crosswise into thin half-moons and add to the bowl.  (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Trim and slice cucumbers crosswise into thin rounds. Add to the bowl.
Trim and slice radishes into thin rounds. Add to the bowl.
Halve and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and medium dice. Add to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the salad.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide salad between plates and top with steak. Enjoy!

Peel and mince or press the garlic. Peel and mince or grate the ginger. In a medium bowl, prepare the dressing by whisking together the minced garlic and ginger, peanut butter, tamari, water, lime juice, and crushed red pepper. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
6 tbsp natural peanut butter
3 tbsp tamari soy sauce
3 tbsp water
1 ½ limes
⅜ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the carrots and zucchini. Trim off and discard the ends of the carrots and zucchini. Using a julienne (or regular) peeler, peel the carrots and zucchini into thin noodle-like sticks; transfer them to a large bowl and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 medium carrots
6 medium zucchini squash

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add coconut oil to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the chicken and cook until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and set aside to cool.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tbsp virgin coconut oil

instructions.primary_message: Once the chicken has been removed, add more coconut oil to the skillet. Then add the carrot and zucchini noodles. (Keep the bowl nearby.) Cook the vegetables, stirring constantly, until just tender, 2-3 minutes. Transfer back to the original bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tbsp virgin coconut oil

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the cilantro. Shave the leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the noodles.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ small bunches cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Cut the chicken into bite-sized cubes and add to the bowl. Toss the salad until well combined.
To serve, place the salad in bowls, pour the sauce over top, and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 6 tsp sesame seeds

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Place mayo, soy sauce, salt, and pepper in a large bowl. Whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup mayonnaise
1 tbsp tamari soy sauce
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pat chicken dry with paper towels, then slice into ¾-inch strips. Add to the bowl with the mayo mixture and toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 ¼ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.primary_message: Add bread crumbs to the bowl with the chicken and gently toss once more to coat. Divide between two baking sheet pans, arrange in a single layer, and drizzle with oil.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cup gluten-free bread crumbs
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Place chicken in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, flipping halfway, until golden and cooked through, about 18 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ limes
1 ½ bunches radish
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 ½ (5 oz) pkgs spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Juice limes into a small bowl; add peanut butter, soy sauce, maple syrup, water, turmeric, and curry powder. Whisk to combine the peanut sauce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup natural peanut butter
2 tbsp tamari soy sauce
1 ½ tbsp pure maple syrup
1 tbsp water
½ tsp turmeric, ground
3 pinch curry powder

instructions.primary_message: Place mayo, soy sauce, oil, salt, and pepper in a clean large bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp mayonnaise
1 tbsp tamari soy sauce
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Using a clean cutting board, trim and halve radishes, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and quarter cucumbers lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
When the chicken is almost done, add mixed greens to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide chicken fingers, peanut sauce, and salad between plates. Enjoy!
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
1 ½ small pineapples
3 English cucumbers
1 small pkg fresh mint
