instructions.primary_message: Return skillet (with drippings) to low heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bread and cook, stirring occasionally, until croutons are golden and toasted, 5-6 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Add croutons to the bowl and stir to combine the salad.
Slice chicken into thin strips.
To serve, divide panzanella salad between plates; top with chicken, feta, and reserved mint. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (4 oz) pkgs crumbled feta cheese

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb new potatoes
1 ½ bunches Swiss chard
1 ½ lemons
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Halve new potatoes. Transfer to a large baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper; toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until potatoes are golden and fork-tender, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.

Meanwhile, place turkey, bread crumbs, eggs, and spices in a large bowl. Using your hands, mix well to combine. Using a tablespoon measure, form the turkey mixture into rounded meatballs. Place on a plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb ground turkey
1 cup gluten-free bread crumbs
3 eggs
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.

Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add meatballs and cook, turning occasionally, until golden brown and cooked through, 6-8 minutes. Transfer to a clean plate. (Reserve pot for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel and mince shallots. Roughly chop capers. Place both in a small bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 shallots
6 tbsp capers

instructions.primary_message: Fold chard leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Cut leaves crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips and thinly slice the stems, keeping them separate. Add stems to the small bowl with the shallot and capers; reserve leaves for later use.

Return pot to medium heat. Once the pot is hot, add more oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add shallot, capers, chard stems, and flour; cook, stirring frequently, until chard stems soften, 2-3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp gluten-free flour

instructions.primary_message: Zest and juice lemons into the pot, then add broth, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine the sauce and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to low and cook, stirring occasionally, until thickened, about 3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.

When the sauce has thickened, add chard leaves to the pot in handfuls, waiting for them to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Remove from heat, add meatballs and half of the parsley, then stir to combine. (Reserve remaining parsley for serving.)
To serve, divide meatballs, sauce, and potatoes between plates. Top meatballs with reserved parsley and enjoy!
Place vinegar, maple syrup, and salt in a medium bowl; stir to combine the pickling liquid.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup rice vinegar
1 tbsp pure maple syrup
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin rounds. Add to the bowl with the pickling liquid, stir to combine, and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: ½ medium red onion

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, medium dice tempeh. Place in a large bowl, drizzle with soy sauce, and stir to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (8 oz) packages tempeh
3 tbsp tamari soy sauce

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches, add tempeh and cook, stirring occasionally, until golden, 5-7 minutes. Transfer tempeh to a plate, season with salt, and cover with foil; set aside. (Reserve skillet and bowl for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp toasted sesame oil
3 pinch salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
6 medium carrots
1 ½ English cucumbers
2 ¼ lb green beans
1 small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince ginger. Place in the reserved bowl along with peanut butter, vinegar, soy sauce, water, maple syrup, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup natural peanut butter
3 tbsp rice vinegar
3 tbsp tamari soy sauce
3 tbsp water
2 tbsp pure maple syrup
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp black pepper
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and halve cucumbers lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl and set aside.
Trim and halve green beans crosswise.

Return the skillet to high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add green beans and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until blistered and tender, about 4 minutes. Remove from heat and let cool, 6-7 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp toasted sesame oil
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp crushed red pepper
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add half to the bowl with the other veggies. (Reserve remaining cilantro for serving.)
When the green beans have cooled slightly, add to the bowl along with pickled shallots. Stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls; top with crispy tempeh and reserved cilantro. Enjoy!
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 tomatoes
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 ½ orange bell peppers
1 small bunch fresh dill
1 ½ lemons

instructions.primary_message: Place oil, vinegar, and spices in a large bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp red wine vinegar
¾ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Small dice tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Small dice cucumbers. Add to the bowl.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop olives. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the salad. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ cup Kalamata olives, pitted

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince shallot. Place in a medium bowl along with chicken and spices. Mix with your hands until well combined.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 shallot
1 ½ lb ground chicken
1 ½ tsp oregano, dried
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Arrange tortillas on a flat surface, then divide the chicken mixture between them (about 2 tablespoons per tortilla). Using a knife (or your hands), spread the chicken mixture over the surface of each tortilla in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message: 18 small corn tortillas

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches, add tacos, meat-side down. Cook, pressing down once with the bottom of a spatula halfway through cooking, until the chicken is cooked through, about 3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Flip tacos, chicken-side up, and continue to cook until tortillas are golden underneath, 1 minute more. Transfer to a large plate and carefully fold in half to form tacos.
Meanwhile, shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a small bowl.
Juice lemons into the bowl with the dill. Add yogurt, sugar, and salt, then stir to combine the dill yogurt.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup plain Greek yogurt
¾ tsp brown sugar
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Divide tacos between plates. Fill each with a small portion of salad and drizzle with dill yogurt. Serve with remaining salad on the side and enjoy!
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups jasmine rice
24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 oranges
6 plums
12 baby bok choy

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, juice oranges into a medium bowl. Add vinegar, ketchup, soy sauce, sugar, and cornstarch, then whisk to combine the sauce. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup rice vinegar
⅓ cup ketchup
2 tbsp tamari soy sauce
2 tbsp brown sugar
1 ½ tbsp cornstarch

instructions.primary_message: Halve plums lengthwise (around the pit); twist halves to separate, then remove and discard pits. Cut each half into ¼-inch thick slices. Place in a large bowl.
Trim and cut bok choy crosswise into ½-inch strips. Add to the bowl with the plums and set aside.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic, chicken, salt, and pepper; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp neutral vegetable oil
1 ½ lb ground chicken
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add sauce, plums, and bok choy to the pot. Stir-fry until plums and bok choy are just tender and sauce is thickened, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat and cover to keep warm.
To serve, divide rice and stir-fry between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch cilantro
1 ½ lemons
3 mangoes
1 ½ jalapeño peppers
6 red bell peppers
1 small pkg fresh mint

instructions.primary_message: Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Divide between two large bowls. (Set one bowl aside for the salad.)
Add cottage cheese, eggs, flour, bread crumbs, and spices to the remaining bowl with the cilantro. Stir to combine the batter.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cups cottage cheese
6 eggs
1 ½ cup gluten-free flour
¾ cup gluten-free bread crumbs
1 tbsp curry powder
1 ½ tsp garam masala
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches, using a ¼-cup measure, drop batter into the skillet, spacing scoops a few inches apart; flatten slightly with the back of a spoon. Cook, flipping once, until fritters are golden brown, 3-5 minutes. Remove to a paper towel-lined plate.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp neutral vegetable oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, juice lemons into a small bowl. Pour half of the juice into the large bowl for the salad. (Set the small bowl aside for the raita.)
Add oil, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the cilantro and lemon juice. Stir to combine the salad dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp neutral vegetable oil
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel mangoes and slice flesh away from the pits, starting with the flat sides; roughly chop the flesh. Add to the bowl with the dressing.

Quarter jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level, then small dice. Add to the bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Trim, seed, and slice bell peppers lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the bowl, stir to combine the salad, and set aside.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the small bowl with the lemon juice along with yogurt and spices. Stir to combine the raita.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 cups plain Greek yogurt
¾ tsp cumin, ground
¾ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Divide fritters and salad between plates. Serve with raita and enjoy!
Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
6 red bell peppers
1 ½ lemons
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
1 ½ (5 oz) pkgs baby arugula

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and halve bell peppers lengthwise. Transfer to a large baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper; arrange cut-side down. Place baking sheet in the oven and broil, flipping once, until peppers are lightly charred and tender, 6-8 minutes. Remove from oven.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add pork and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-7 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 ¼ lb lean ground pork
1 ½ tsp onion powder
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the pork is cooking, juice lemons into a large bowl. Add oil, Dijon, honey, and salt, then whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 tbsp honey
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the bowl with the dressing and set aside. (Reserve remaining parsley for the next step.)
Finely grate Parmesan. When the pork is done, add Parmesan to the skillet, along with the reserved parsley, and stir to combine the filling. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 oz Parmesan cheese

instructions.primary_message: Stuff peppers with pork filling, then top with bread crumbs. Return baking sheet to the oven and continue to broil until bread crumbs are toasted, 1 minute more. Remove from oven.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ cup gluten-free bread crumbs

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, add arugula to the bowl with the dressing and toss to coat.
To serve, divide stuffed peppers and arugula between plates. Enjoy!
Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium heads cauliflower
1 ½ lb cremini mushrooms
1 ½ (5 oz) pkgs baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Cut each cauliflower head into quarters; using a box grater, hold the stem end of the cauliflower and coarsely grate. (Alternatively, transfer cauliflower to the bowl of a food processor; pulse until rice-like in consistency.) Place in a large bowl.
Thinly slice mushrooms. Add to the bowl with the cauliflower rice along with oil and spices, then stir to combine. Divide between two large baking sheet pans and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp neutral vegetable oil
1 tbsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until cauliflower and mushrooms are tender and golden, about 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add beef, salt, and pepper. Cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb lean ground beef
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the beef is cooking, finely grate Parmesan. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 oz Parmesan cheese

instructions.primary_message: When the beef is done, add spinach to the pot in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Stir to combine, remove from heat, and cover to keep warm.
When the cauliflower rice and mushrooms are done, remove from oven. Carefully add both to the pot with the beef mixture along with Parmesan and coconut aminos. Stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp coconut aminos

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide cauliflower rice between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
Preheat oven to 500°F. Coat two baking sheet pans with a thin layer of oil.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 tbsp neutral vegetable oil

instructions.primary_message: Pat chicken wings dry with paper towels and place in a large bowl. Sprinkle with cornstarch and salt, then toss to coat. Divide between the baking sheets and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 lb chicken wings, split with tips removed
1 tbsp cornstarch
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Place wings in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, turning once, until cooked through, 25-30 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
3 red bell peppers
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Place both in a small saucepan along with water, vinegar, soy sauce, sugar, cornstarch, and chili-garlic sauce. Whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
¾ cup water
3 tbsp rice vinegar
3 tbsp tamari soy sauce
3 tbsp brown sugar
2 tbsp cornstarch
1 tbsp chili-garlic sauce

instructions.primary_message: Place saucepan over medium heat and cook, whisking occasionally, until sauce thickens, 4-5 minutes. Transfer to a clean large bowl and set aside for the wings.
Place oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper in another large bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp neutral vegetable oil
3 tbsp rice vinegar
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and slice bell peppers lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add half to the bowl. (Reserve remaining green onions for serving.)
Roughly chop peanuts. Add half to the bowl. (Reserve remaining peanuts for serving.)
instructions.secondary_message: 1 cup peanuts, roasted unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Drain and rinse water chestnuts; roughly chop. Add to the bowl, along with broccoli slaw, and stir to combine. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
8 oz water chestnuts
1 ½ (12 oz) pkgs broccoli slaw

instructions.primary_message: When the wings are done, add to the bowl with the sauce and toss to coat.
To serve, divide wings and slaw between plates; top wings with reserved green onions and peanuts. Enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: chicken wings, split with tips removed

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
1 small bunch cilantro
12 baby bok choy
1 ½ (8 oz) pkgs sugar snap peas
1 ½ pints grape tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Peel and roughly chop ginger. Peel garlic. Place both in a blender.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Shave cilantro leaves off the stems. Add cilantro stems and half of the leaves to the blender. (Reserve remaining leaves for later use.)
Add coconut milk, chili-garlic sauce, and spices to the blender. Blend on high until mixture is smooth, scraping down the sides of the blender with a spatula as needed.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (13.5 fl oz) cans coconut milk
1 tbsp chili-garlic sauce
1 ½ tbsp curry powder
1 tbsp coriander, ground
1 ½ tsp turmeric, ground
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add coconut mixture and cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened, about 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp neutral vegetable oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, trim and roughly chop bok choy. Place in a large bowl.
Halve snap peas. Add to the bowl with the bok choy.
Halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl and set aside.
Once the coconut mixture has thickened, add broth, sugar, soy sauce, and fish sauce to the pot. Whisk to combine and bring to a boil.
instructions.secondary_message:
72 fl oz (9 cups) chicken or vegetable broth
2 tbsp brown sugar
2 tbsp tamari soy sauce
1 tbsp fish sauce

instructions.primary_message: Once the broth is boiling, add veggies to the pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until just softened, about 3 minutes.
Add soba noodles to the pot and cook until tender, about 5 minutes (or cook according to package instructions). Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message: 15 oz soba (buckwheat) noodles

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, roughly chop reserved cilantro.
To serve, divide broth, veggies, and noodles between bowls; sprinkle with reserved cilantro and sesame seeds. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 1 tbsp sesame seeds

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 450°F. Line two large baking sheet pans with aluminum foil for easier cleanup (optional).
Place beef, eggs, bread crumbs, and spices in a large bowl; mix with your hands until the meatloaf mixture is well combined.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb lean ground beef
3 eggs
¾ cup gluten-free bread crumbs
2 tbsp chili powder
1 ½ tsp cumin, ground
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Form the beef mixture into 18 short, sausage-like shapes, approximately 3-inches long. Transfer to one of the baking sheets.
Wash, dry, trim, and seed bell peppers; slice lengthwise into thin strips. Transfer to the other baking sheet.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 red bell peppers
3 green bell peppers

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and slice onions crosswise into thin half-moons; add to baking sheet with the peppers. Drizzle veggies with oil and season with spices; toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium red onions
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp chili powder
¾ tsp cumin, ground
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven and bake, stirring veggies halfway through, until meatloaves are almost cooked through and veggies are fork-tender, about 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, thinly slice cheese.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ (8 oz) block cheddar cheese

instructions.primary_message: When the meatloaves are almost cooked through, remove from the oven, and top with sliced cheese. Return to the oven and continue to bake until meatloaves are cooked through and the cheese is melted, 3-4 minutes more. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide meatloaves and veggies between plates. Enjoy!
Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 limes
1 ½ small pineapples
1 ½ avocados
3 jalapeño peppers
1 small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 ¼ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Place mayo and spices in a large bowl. Stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp mayonnaise
1 ½ tsp chili powder
¾ tsp smoked paprika
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add shrimp to the bowl with the mayo mixture and stir to coat. Add bread crumbs and coconut to the bowl, then gently toss once more to coat. Transfer shrimp to a large baking sheet pan and spread out in an even layer; drizzle with oil.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup gluten-free bread crumbs
¾ cup shredded unsweetened coconut
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Place shrimp in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, flipping halfway, until golden and cooked through, about 12 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, juice half of the limes into a clean large bowl, then add oil, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing. (Cut remaining limes into wedges and set aside for serving.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Cut off skin from each pineapple; quarter, core, and small dice the flesh. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Peel and mince shallot. Add to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 shallot

instructions.primary_message: Halve and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and small dice. Add to the bowl.

Quarter jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Roughly chop and add to the bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the salad. Set aside.
Warm tortillas in a skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
instructions.secondary_message: 18 small corn tortillas

instructions.primary_message: Divide tortillas between plates, then fill with shrimp and a small portion of salad. Serve with remaining salad and lime wedges for squeezing. Enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 medium zucchini squash
6 medium carrots
1 ½ limes
1 small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Trim zucchini and use a julienne (or regular) peeler to make noodles. Divide between two large baking sheet pans.

Peel and trim carrots; using a julienne (or regular) peeler, peel each carrot into noodle-like strips. Add to the baking sheets with the zucchini. Drizzle veggies noodles with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp toasted sesame oil
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated), and roast, tossing halfway through, until zucchini and carrot noodles are tender, about 12 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic, chicken, salt, and pepper. Cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp toasted sesame oil
1 ½ lb ground chicken
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the chicken is cooking, zest and juice limes into a small bowl. Add water, peanut butter, chili-garlic sauce, and soy sauce, then whisk to combine the stir-fry sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup water
⅓ cup natural peanut butter
2 tbsp chili-garlic sauce
2 tbsp tamari soy sauce

instructions.primary_message: When the chicken is done, add stir-fry sauce to the skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, until warmed through and thickened slightly, 1-2 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, roughly chop cashews.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 cup cashews, roasted unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
Add cashews and half of the basil to the skillet. Stir to combine and cover to keep warm. (Reserve remaining basil for serving.)
To serve, divide zucchini and carrot noodles between plates or bowls. Top with saucy chicken and reserved basil. Enjoy!
Peel, halve, and small dice onions. Place in a large bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ medium yellow onions

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the onions.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Once the pot is hot, add onion, garlic, sausage, and spices. Cook, breaking sausage apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-6 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lb ground pork sausage
1 tbsp Italian seasoning
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
¼ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 oz Parmesan cheese

instructions.primary_message: When the sausage is done, add broth, tomatoes, pumpkin, and water to the pot. Stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
48 fl oz (6 cups) chicken or vegetable broth
3 (14.5 oz) cans diced tomatoes
1 ½ (15 oz) cans pure pumpkin purée
3 cup water

instructions.primary_message: Add pasta to the pot and stir once more to combine. Cover and bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Once the soup is boiling, reduce heat to medium and simmer until pasta is desired firmness, about 8 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 9 oz gluten-free rotini pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the spinach (skip this step if it came pre-washed). Roughly chop spinach and place in the reserved bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (5 oz) pkgs baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the bowl with the spinach. (Set remaining parsley aside for serving.)
instructions.secondary_message: 1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: When the pasta is done, add spinach and parsley to the pot in handfuls, waiting for the greens to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Stir to combine the soup and remove from heat.
To serve, divide soup between bowls, then top with Parmesan and reserved parsley. Enjoy!
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups basmati rice
24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place vinegar, maple syrup, and salt in a large bowl. Whisk to combine the pickling liquid and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp rice vinegar
1 tbsp pure maple syrup
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ English cucumbers
3 red bell peppers
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
3 avocados
1 ½ limes

instructions.primary_message: Trim and slice cucumbers crosswise into thin rounds. Add to the bowl with the pickling liquid.
Trim, seed, and slice bell peppers lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the bowl and toss to combine; set aside.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Crumble tempeh into the skillet and cook, undisturbed, for 5-7 minutes. Using a spatula, carefully flip and continue to cook, undisturbed, until golden brown, 5-7 minutes more.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp toasted sesame oil
3 (8 oz) packages tempeh

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel and mince ginger. Place in a small bowl along with soy sauce, vinegar, maple syrup, and chili-garlic sauce. Whisk to combine the glaze.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp tamari soy sauce
3 tbsp rice vinegar
2 tbsp pure maple syrup
1 ½ tsp chili-garlic sauce

instructions.primary_message: When the tempeh is done, add glaze to the skillet. Cook, stirring often, until glaze thickens, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat.
Halve and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and slice crosswise into thin half-moons.
Cut limes into wedges.
To serve, divide rice, pickled veggies, and glazed tempeh between bowls. Top with avocado and lime. Enjoy!

Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap). Add salt, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, uncover, add pasta, and stir for a few seconds; cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain and rinse under cold water to cool. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
15 oz gluten-free macaroni (elbow) pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lemons
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
3 red bell peppers
3 green bell peppers

instructions.primary_message: Drain and rinse beans; set aside to drain further.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (15 oz) cans kidney beans

instructions.primary_message: Juice lemons into a large bowl. Add yogurt, mayo, sugar, and spices, then whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup plain Greek yogurt
⅓ cup mayonnaise
1 ½ tbsp brown sugar
1 tbsp Cajun seasoning
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
¾ tsp smoked paprika

instructions.primary_message: Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers. Add to the bowl along with the beans.
Rinse corn under hot water (from the tap) to thaw. Add to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ cups frozen corn

instructions.primary_message: Add cooled pasta to the bowl and stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide pasta salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
Preheat oven to 425°F. Line two baking sheet pans with aluminum foil.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 eggplants
6 tomatoes
1 small pkg fresh basil
1 ½ (5 oz) pkgs spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Place bread crumbs and spices in a small bowl. Stir to combine and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cup gluten-free bread crumbs
1 tbsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim and slice eggplants crosswise into ½-inch thick rounds. Divide eggplant between the baking sheets, spreading the slices out in a single layer.

Spread half of the mayo over the top side of the eggplant rounds, then sprinkle with half of the bread crumbs (pressing gently to adhere). Carefully flip eggplant and repeat with remaining mayo and bread crumbs.
instructions.secondary_message: ⅓ cup mayonnaise

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, flipping halfway, until eggplant is tender and golden on both sides, 10-12 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, thinly slice mozzarella. Place on a large plate.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (8 oz) pkgs fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.primary_message: Thinly slice tomatoes and add to the plate with the mozzarella. Set aside.
Peel and mince garlic. Place in a large bowl along with mayo, vinegar, Dijon, maple syrup, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
3 tbsp mayonnaise
2 tbsp white wine vinegar
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 tbsp pure maple syrup
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Drain and thinly slice artichokes; add to the bowl with the dressing and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (6 oz) jars artichoke hearts, marinated

instructions.primary_message: When the eggplant is done, top with mozzarella and tomato. Return to the oven and continue to bake until the cheese is melted, 4-5 minutes more. Remove from oven.

Meanwhile, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add half to the bowl along with mixed greens and pine nuts, then toss to combine the salad. (Reserve remaining basil for serving.)
instructions.secondary_message: ⅓ cup pine nuts

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide eggplant stacks and salad between plates. Top eggplant with reserved basil and enjoy!
Preheat oven to 425°F. Coat a large baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 tbsp neutral vegetable oil

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 crowns broccoli
3 small bunches green onions (scallions)
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
1 ½ heads butter (Boston) lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Transfer to another large baking sheet, drizzle with oil and soy sauce, then season with pepper; toss to coat and spread out in an even layer. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp neutral vegetable oil
3 tbsp tamari soy sauce
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Divide between a large bowl and a medium saucepan.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Divide both between the bowl and saucepan with the green onions. (Set pan aside for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message: 6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Add beef, bread crumbs, eggs, and spices to the bowl. Using your hands, mix well to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb lean ground beef
¾ cup gluten-free bread crumbs
3 eggs
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
¼ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Using a tablespoon measure, form the beef mixture into rounded meatballs. Arrange on the oiled baking sheet.
Place baking sheets in the oven and bake, tossing broccoli and turning meatballs halfway, until meatballs are cooked through and broccoli is fork-tender and lightly charred, 18-20 minutes.

When the meatballs are almost done, add cold water, soy sauce, cornstarch, sugar, oil, and vinegar to the pan with the green onions. Set over medium heat and cook, stirring frequently, until the sauce thickens, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup water
⅓ cup tamari soy sauce
2 tbsp cornstarch
2 tbsp brown sugar
1 tbsp neutral vegetable oil
1 tbsp rice vinegar

instructions.primary_message: When the meatballs and broccoli are done, remove from oven. Drizzle sauce over meatballs and toss to coat.
Separate the lettuce into leaves. Pile leaves, in stacks of two per wrap, onto plates; fill with meatballs and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Serve with broccoli on the side and enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 1 tbsp sesame seeds

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and salt, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups jasmine rice
3 cup water
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ English cucumbers
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
1 ½ limes
3 mangoes
1 small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, place vinegar, honey, and salt in a medium bowl; stir to combine the pickling liquid.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup rice vinegar
1 ½ tsp honey
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Trim and halve cucumbers lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the pickling liquid, stir to combine, and set aside.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Place both in a large bowl along with oil, soy sauce, honey, and spices; whisk to combine the marinade.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 cloves garlic
2 tbsp toasted sesame oil
1 ½ tbsp tamari soy sauce
1 tbsp honey
1 ½ tsp smoked paprika
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: If using salmon with skin, place the fillet, skin-side down, on a cutting board. Holding the tail end (or corner) firmly, use a knife to cut between the flesh and skin; continue to cut through the length of the fillet (take care not to cut through the skin); discard the skin.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 ¼ lb salmon fillet

instructions.primary_message: Cut the salmon into 1-inch cubes. Add to the bowl with the marinade, stir to coat, and set aside.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, juice limes into a small bowl. Add yogurt and chili-garlic sauce, then stir to combine the spicy yogurt sauce. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup plain Greek yogurt
¼ tsp chili-garlic sauce

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, working in batches if necessary, add salmon (with marinade) and cook, turning occasionally, until cooked through, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, peel mangoes and slice flesh away from the pits, starting with the flat sides; cut into bite-sized pieces. Place in another medium bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the mango (reserving a small handful for serving) and stir to combine.
Just before serving, fluff rice with a fork. Add coconut and stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message: ⅓ cup shredded unsweetened coconut

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide rice, salmon, pickled cucumber, and mango between bowls. Drizzle with yogurt sauce, top with reserved cilantro, and enjoy!
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
6 medium parsnips
1 small pkg fresh thyme
6 Gala apples
1 ½ (5 oz) pkgs baby arugula

instructions.primary_message: Peel and medium dice parsnips. Transfer to a large pot, cover with hot water (from the tap), and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium and cook until parsnips can be easily pierced with a fork, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, slide thyme leaves off the stems; discard the stems. Place leaves in a large bowl along with flour and spices; stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup gluten-free flour
¾ tsp cinnamon, ground
¾ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat another large pot over medium-high heat.

While the pot heats up, pat chicken dry with paper towels. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Add to the bowl with the flour mixture and turn to coat.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 ¼ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.primary_message: Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add chicken and pan-fry until golden and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove to a plate. (Reserve pot with drippings for later use).
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, peel, halve, and slice onions crosswise into thin half-moons. Place in a clean large bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ medium yellow onions

instructions.primary_message: Quarter, core, and slice apples into ½-inch wedges. Add to the bowl with the onion.
When the chicken is done, return the pot (with drippings) to medium-high heat. Add onion and apple; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 3-4 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the salad.)
Add broth, vinegar, Dijon, and maple syrup to the pot, then stir to combine the sauce. Return chicken (and any accumulated juices) to the pot and turn to coat. Bring sauce to a simmer.
instructions.secondary_message:
16 fl oz (2 cups) chicken or vegetable broth
2 tbsp apple cider vinegar
1 ½ tbsp Dijon mustard
1 ½ tbsp pure maple syrup

instructions.primary_message: Once the sauce is simmering, reduce heat to medium. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until apple is soft and sauce has thickened slightly, 5-6 minutes more. Remove from heat.

Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic. Place half in the reserved bowl along with oil, vinegar, Dijon, maple syrup, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing. (Reserve remaining garlic for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
6 cloves garlic
1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tbsp apple cider vinegar
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 ½ tsp pure maple syrup
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add arugula and pumpkin seeds to the bowl with the dressing. Toss to combine the salad and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ cup pumpkin seeds

instructions.primary_message: When the parsnips are done, drain and return to the pot along with remaining garlic, milk, salt, and pepper. Mash until smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) whole milk
¾ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide parsnip mash, chicken, and salad between plates. Top chicken with apples and sauce from the pot. Enjoy!
In a medium saucepan, combine water, quinoa, and salt; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cup water
1 ½ cups quinoa
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, place cashews, oil, and spices in a small bowl; stir to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup cashews, roasted unsalted
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp chili powder
¼ tsp cayenne pepper
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add the cashews and cook, stirring constantly, until golden brown, 3-4 minutes. Return cashews to the bowl and set aside to cool. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Pat chicken dry with paper towels. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Return the skillet to medium-high heat, add oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add chicken and cook, flipping once, until cooked through and golden, 8-10 minutes. Remove to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ limes
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
3 medium carrots
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
1 small bunch cilantro
1 ½ medium heads napa cabbage
1 ½ (5 oz) pkgs baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Juice limes into a large bowl.
Using a clean cutting board, peel and mince ginger. Add to the bowl with the lime juice along with oil, soy sauce, maple syrup, and chili garlic sauce; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp tamari soy sauce
1 tbsp pure maple syrup
1 ½ tsp chili-garlic sauce

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the bowl. (Reserve remaining cilantro for serving.)
Trim off and discard the root end of the each cabbage, halve lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise. Add to the bowl along with quinoa, spicy cashews, and spinach, then toss to combine the salad.
Thinly slice chicken into strips.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls; top with chicken and reserved cilantro. Enjoy!
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lb sweet potatoes
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
1 ½ bunches kale

instructions.primary_message: Peel and coarsely grate sweet potatoes. Place in a large bowl.
Peel, halve, and medium dice onions. Add to the bowl with the sweet potato and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ medium yellow onions

instructions.primary_message: Preheat two large skillets over medium-high heat.
While the skillets heat up, peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillets are hot, divide oil between them and swirl to coat the bottoms. Divide garlic between the skillets and cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, 15-30 seconds.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Divide sweet potato and onion between the skillets. Cover and cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves.

Once the veggies are tender, divide half of the parsley, tomatoes, tomato sauce, water, and spices between the skillets. Stir to combine the stew and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, cook until slightly thickened, 5-6 minutes. (Reserve remaining parsley for serving.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (14.5 oz) cans diced tomatoes
3 (8 oz) cans tomato sauce
¾ cup water
1 ½ tsp cumin, ground
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
¾ tsp smoked paprika
¾ tsp cayenne pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the stew is simmering, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven. (Skip this step if you are using a toaster for the bread.)
Fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces.
When the stew has thickened slightly, add kale to the skillets in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.

Using a stirring spoon, make a well in the stew for each egg; crack an egg into each well and season with salt and pepper. Cover and cook until the egg whites are firm but yolks are still soft, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 eggs
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, divide bread between two baking sheet pans. Working in batches, place in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through, until toasted, about 2 minutes; remove from oven. (Alternatively, you can use a toaster.)
instructions.secondary_message: 12 slices gluten-free bread

instructions.primary_message: Finely grate Parmesan.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 oz Parmesan cheese

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide eggs, stew, and toast between plates. Top with Parmesan and reserved parsley. Enjoy!

Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap). Add salt, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, uncover, add pasta, and stir for a few seconds; cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain pasta and set aside. (Reserve a ½-cup pasta water before draining.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
15 oz gluten-free rotini pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 medium carrots
1 ½ medium heads napa cabbage
1 small pkg chives

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots. Place in a large bowl and set aside.
Peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Preheat another large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add garlic and sausage. Cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ lb ground pork sausage

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, trim off and discard root end of each cabbage; halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Add to the bowl with the carrot.
Chop chives into small pieces. Add half to the bowl. (Reserve remaining chives for serving.)

When the sausage is done, add carrot, cabbage, chives, and spices to the pot. Stir to combine, then cover and cook, stirring occasionally, until cabbage is tender, 5-6 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp thyme, dried
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the cabbage is cooking, place water, Dijon, and honey in the reserved bowl. Whisk to combine the sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup water
3 tbsp Dijon mustard
2 tbsp honey

instructions.primary_message: When the cabbage is tender, add sauce to the pot, along with drained pasta, and stir to combine; add reserved pasta water, a few tablespoons at a time, if necessary, to reach a saucy consistency. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls. Top with reserved chives and enjoy!
Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lb red grapes
9 medium carrots
1 ½ lemons
1 small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Halve grapes and place in a large bowl.

Pat pork chops dry with paper towels. Large dice and add to the bowl with the grapes along with oil, vinegar, and spices. Stir to combine, divide between two large baking dishes, and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 pork chops, boneless
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp balsamic vinegar
1 ½ tsp sage, dried
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking dishes in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway, until pork is cooked through and grapes are soft, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place eggs, milk, and oil in a clean large bowl. Whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 eggs
6 fl oz (¾ cup) whole milk
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Add flour, salt, and baking powder to the bowl with the egg mixture. Whisk once more until the batter is just combined.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup gluten-free flour
1 ½ tsp salt
1 ½ tsp baking powder

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots. Add to the bowl with the batter and gently stir until incorporated.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat. Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Working in batches, using a ¼-cup measure, drop batter into the skillet, spacing scoops a few inches apart; flatten slightly with the back of a spoon. Cook, flipping once, until fritters are golden brown, 3-5 minutes. Remove to a paper towel-lined plate.
Meanwhile, juice lemons into a small bowl.

Pick basil leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the bowl with the lemon juice along with yogurt and spices. Stir to combine the yogurt sauce and set aside. (Reserve remaining basil for serving.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups plain Greek yogurt
¾ tsp garlic powder
3 pinch salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Divide pork, grapes, and carrot fritters between plates. Sprinkle pork with reserved basil and serve with yogurt sauce on the side. Enjoy!
Preheat oven to 450°F. Line two large baking sheet pans with aluminum foil for easier cleanup (optional).
Wash, dry, and halve each acorn squash lengthwise; trim ends, scrape out the seeds, and cut crosswise into ¼-inch thick half-moons. Divide between the baking sheets and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 acorn squash

instructions.primary_message: Small dice butter and sprinkle over the squash. Season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp butter, unsalted
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until squash is tender, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with spices on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 pork chops, boneless
1 ½ tsp smoked paprika
1 ½ tsp rosemary, dried
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add pork chops and cook until golden brown and cooked through, 4-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and set aside to rest, 5 minutes. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message: 1 tbsp butter, unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, roughly chop walnuts.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ cup walnuts

instructions.primary_message: Wipe the skillet clean with paper towels, then return to medium-low heat. Add more butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add walnuts and cook, stirring occasionally, until toasted, about 3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp butter, unsalted

instructions.primary_message: While the walnuts are cooking, peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: When the walnuts are done, add garlic, water, and coconut aminos to the skillet. Stir to combine the sauce and remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp water
3 tbsp coconut aminos

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide squash and pork chops between plates. Sprinkle squash with feta and drizzle with sauce. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (4 oz) pkgs crumbled feta cheese

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 500°F. Coat two baking sheet pans with a thin layer of oil.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Pat chicken wings dry with paper towels and place in a large bowl. Sprinkle with cornstarch, salt, and pepper, then toss to coat. Divide between the baking sheets and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 lb chicken wings, split with tips removed
3 tbsp cornstarch
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place wings in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, turning once, until cooked through, 25-30 minutes.
Meanwhile, place maple syrup, Dijon, salt, and pepper in a clean large bowl. Whisk to combine the maple-Dijon sauce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup pure maple syrup
3 tbsp Dijon mustard
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a skillet over medium heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bread crumbs and salt; cook, stirring frequently, until golden and crispy, 3-5 minutes. Transfer to a small bowl and set aside to cool.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ cup gluten-free bread crumbs
3 pinch salt

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lemons
1 ½ heads romaine lettuce
3 Gala apples

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic. Mince anchovy fillet. Place both in another clean large bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
3 anchovy fillets, packed in oil

instructions.primary_message: Juice lemons into the bowl with the garlic and anchovy.
Finely grate Parmesan. Add to the bowl along with mayo, oil, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 oz Parmesan cheese
3 tbsp mayonnaise
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the wings are almost done, separate lettuce into leaves, tearing larger leaves into pieces as needed. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Quarter, core, and thinly slice apples. Add to the bowl, gently toss to combine the salad, and set aside.
When the wings are done, remove from the oven. Add to the bowl with the maple-Dijon sauce and toss to coat.
To serve, divide wings and salad between plates. Top salad with crispy breadcrumbs and enjoy!
