instructions.primary_message: Divide the cauliflower rice between bowls, top with the stir fry, and sprinkle with the remaining green onions. Enjoy!
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Crumble the tofu with your fingers into the skillet, then add sesame seeds, salt, and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until tofu is golden and warmed through, 7-8 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp toasted sesame oil
3 (12 oz) pkgs extra firm tofu
2 tbsp sesame seeds
1 ½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ oranges
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
6 English cucumbers
3 medium carrots
1 ½ red bell peppers
1 small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Juice oranges into a large bowl.
Peel and mince ginger and shallots. Add both to the bowl with the orange juice along with oil, vinegar, soy sauce, peanut butter, and salt. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 shallots
⅓ cup toasted sesame oil
3 tbsp rice vinegar
3 tbsp tamari soy sauce
3 tbsp natural peanut butter
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Trim and halve cucumbers crosswise, then run a vegetable peeler along the length of each cucumber to make ribbons. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots. Add to the bowl.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers. Add to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl, along with the tofu, and toss to combine the salad.
Roughly chop peanuts.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ cups peanuts, roasted unsalted

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide the salad between plates or bowls and sprinkle with peanuts. Enjoy!

Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap). Add salt, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, uncover, add pasta, and stir for a few seconds; cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain pasta and set aside. (Reserve a ½-cup pasta water before draining.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
15 oz gluten-free penne pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small pkg fresh mint
1 ½ lemons
3 bunches Swiss chard
1 ½ pints grape tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a small bowl.
Zest and juice lemons into the bowl with the mint.
Finely grate Parmesan. Add half to the bowl, stir to combine, and set aside. (Reserve remaining Parmesan for serving.)
instructions.secondary_message: 6 oz Parmesan cheese

instructions.primary_message: Fold chard leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Cut leaves crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips and thinly slice the stems, keeping them separate. Place leaves in a large bowl and stems in a medium bowl. Set leaves aside for later use.
Halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the chard stems.
Preheat another large pot over medium heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chard stems, tomatoes, salt, and pepper to the pot; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, if using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 ¼ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: When the tomatoes have softened, add shrimp to the pot; cook, stirring occasionally, until shrimp are cooked through, 3-4 minutes.
While the shrimp are cooking, roughly chop pistachios.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ cup pistachios, unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Add chard leaves to the pot in handfuls, waiting for them to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Add drained pasta, reserved pasta water, pistachios, and the Parmesan mixture. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until pasta is combined and coated in sauce, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls and sprinkle with reserved Parmesan. Enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Drain the beans (but don't rinse them) and transfer to a large bowl. Use a potato masher or fork to mash them until they are mostly broken up, but there are still some whole beans left.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (15 oz) cans black beans

instructions.primary_message: Coarsely grate the onion and add to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ medium yellow onion

instructions.primary_message: Add the bread crumbs, chili powder, salt, and pepper to the beans and onion; stir until the mixture is combined.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup gluten-free bread crumbs
1 ½ tsp chili powder
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Form the bean mixture into six patties.
Add olive oil to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Place the patties in the skillet and cook until they are browned and heated through, 4 to 5 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate.
Toast the buns if desired.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 gluten-free buns or rolls

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the greens if they came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 avocados
3 limes
1 ½ pint grape tomatoes
1 ½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Halve and pit the avocados; medium dice the flesh while it's still in the skin, then scoop out into a small bowl.
Add juice of 1 ½ limes to the avocados and season with salt and pepper; mash with a fork until smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Halve the grape tomatoes.

Place the bun halves on plates, top with the black bean patties, and add dollops of the avocado spread. Arrange the greens on the side, top with the grape tomatoes, and drizzle with olive oil and the remaining lime. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven. (Skip this step if you are using a toaster for the bread.)
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and roughly chop blackberries. Place in a medium bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 (6 oz) pkgs blackberries

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add to the bowl with the blackberries, along with vinegar, and stir to combine the berry mix. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small pkg fresh basil
3 tbsp balsamic vinegar

instructions.primary_message: Divide bread between two large baking sheet pans. Working in batches, place in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through, until toasted, about 2 minutes; remove from oven. (Alternatively, you can use a toaster.)
instructions.secondary_message: 12 slices gluten-free bread

instructions.primary_message: While the bread is toasting, place ricotta, honey, salt, and pepper in another medium bowl. Stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (15 oz) pkgs ricotta cheese
2 tbsp honey
¾ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide toast between plates and spread with ricotta. Top with berry mix and drizzle with additional honey. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp honey

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 500°F.

Pat chicken wings dry with paper towels and place in a large bowl. Sprinkle with cornstarch and salt, then toss to coat. Drizzle with oil and toss once more to coat. Divide between two baking sheets pans and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 lb chicken wings, split with tips removed
3 tbsp cornstarch
1 ½ tsp salt
3 tbsp neutral vegetable oil

instructions.primary_message: Place wings in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, turning once, until cooked through, 25-30 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
3 limes
3 red chili peppers
1 ½ small pineapples
1 ½ medium heads napa cabbage
1 small pkg fresh mint

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince ginger. Peel, halve, and mince onion. Place both in a clean large bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: ½ medium red onion

instructions.primary_message: Juice half of the limes into the bowl with the ginger and onion (reserve remaining limes for later use).
Add soy sauce, sugar, fish sauce, vinegar, and salt to the bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup tamari soy sauce
3 tbsp brown sugar
1 ½ tbsp fish sauce
1 ½ tbsp rice vinegar
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Thinly slice chili peppers into rings; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. (Be careful with chilis; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.) Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Cut off skin from each pineapple; quarter, core, and small dice the flesh. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim off and discard root end of each cabbage; halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Add to the bowl.
Shave mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop leaves. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop cashews. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the slaw. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ cup cashews, roasted unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Juice reserved limes into a small saucepan. Add soy sauce, water, chili-garlic sauce, sugar, fish sauce, and cornstarch to the pan. Cook over medium heat, whisking frequently, until sauce is slightly thickened, 2-3 minutes. Transfer sauce to another large bowl and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup tamari soy sauce
3 tbsp water
3 tbsp chili-garlic sauce
3 tbsp brown sugar
1 ½ tbsp fish sauce
1 tbsp cornstarch

instructions.primary_message: When the wings are done, remove from the oven. Add to the bowl with the sauce and toss to coat.
To serve, divide wings and slaw between plates. Enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: chicken wings, split with tips removed

instructions.primary_message: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (12 oz) pkgs extra firm tofu

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 medium carrots
6 sticks celery
1 small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and small dice carrots. Place in a large bowl.
Trim and small dice celery. Add to the bowl with the carrot.
Peel, halve, and small dice onions; peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, garlic, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, 7-8 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp toasted sesame oil
¾ tsp smoked paprika
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
½ tsp cumin, ground

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place cornstarch, soy sauce, maple syrup, smoked paprika, and salt in the reserved bowl. Whisk to combine the marinade.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp cornstarch
2 tbsp tamari soy sauce
1 tbsp pure maple syrup
1 tbsp smoked paprika
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Large dice tofu. Add to bowl with marinade and toss to coat.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add tofu (leaving any excess marinade in the bowl) and pan-fry, turning occasionally, until browned and crispy, 7-8 minutes. Wipe bowl clean with paper towels, then return cooked tofu to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp toasted sesame oil

instructions.primary_message: While the tofu is cooking, add broth and peas to the pot with the veggies; stir to combine the soup and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are very tender, 6-7 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 ½ cups frozen peas
72 fl oz (9 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.

When the soup is done, use a potato masher to crush the veggies. Alternatively, use a blender if you prefer a smoother soup. Add cilantro (reserving a small handful for serving), cream, and soy sauce, then stir to combine. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) heavy whipping cream
3 tbsp tamari soy sauce

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide soup between bowls; top with the smoky tofu and reserved cilantro. Enjoy!
Preheat oven to 500°F and place rack in the center position. Line two baking sheet pans with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 medium spaghetti squash
1 ½ bunches kale
1 ½ lemons

instructions.primary_message: Trim each spaghetti squash, then halve lengthwise, and scrape out the seeds. Rub the inside of the squash with oil and season with salt. Arrange halves, cut-side down, on the baking sheet.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Place squash in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until tender, so a knife can easily pierce through the flesh, 25-30 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a large pot over medium heat.

Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bread crumbs and salt; cook, stirring frequently, until golden and crispy, 3-5 minutes. Transfer to a small bowl and set aside to cool. (Reserve pot for the next step.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ cup gluten-free bread crumbs
3 pinch salt

instructions.primary_message: Wipe the pot clean with paper towels, then return to medium-high heat. Once hot, add sausage and cook, breaking it apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ lb ground pork sausage

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel and thinly slice garlic.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: When the sausage is done, add garlic and crushed red pepper to the pot. Cook, stirring often, until fragrant, about 1 minute. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Finely grate Parmesan. Add to the bowl with the bread crumbs and stir to combine. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 oz Parmesan cheese

instructions.primary_message: Remove squash from the oven and allow to cool slightly, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; cut leaves crosswise into thin (shred-like) pieces.

Return pot with sausage to medium-high heat. Add kale to the pot in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until the kale is tender and the sausage is warmed through, about 1 minute.
Juice lemons into the pot and stir to combine. Remove from heat.
Scrape the inside of the squash with a fork to separate into spaghetti-like strands (use an oven mitt or towel to hold it with your other hand). Season with salt.
instructions.secondary_message: ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide spaghetti squash between plates or bowls. Top with sausage-kale sauté and cheesy bread crumbs. Enjoy!

Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (12 oz) pkgs extra firm tofu

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups jasmine rice
3 cup water

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lb cremini mushrooms
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
3 small bunches green onions (scallions)
1 ½ small butternut squash

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, quarter mushrooms and place in a medium bowl.
Peel and mince ginger. Add to the bowl with the mushrooms.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl. (Reserve a small handful of green onions for serving.)
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While pot heats up, medium dice tofu. Place in a large bowl and set aside.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add mushrooms, ginger, green onion, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally until tender, 8-10 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup neutral vegetable oil
3 tbsp curry powder
1 tbsp garam masala
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, trim and peel each squash; halve lengthwise, scrape out the seeds, and medium dice. Add to the bowl with the tofu.

Once the mushrooms are tender, add tofu, squash, broth, soy sauce, honey, and vinegar to the pot; stir to combine the curry and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and continue to cook, until squash is tender, about 20 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth
⅓ cup tamari soy sauce
3 tbsp honey
1 tbsp rice vinegar

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place water and cornstarch in the reserved bowl. Whisk until slurry is smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup water
2 tbsp cornstarch

instructions.primary_message: When the squash is tender, add slurry to the pot. Continue to cook, stirring frequently, until the sauce is thickened, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide rice and curry between plates or bowls. Top with reserved green onions and enjoy!
Rinse the rice in a colander and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and salt; bring to a boil.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups basmati rice
3 cups water
⅜ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, in a medium bowl, combine and whisk together the soy sauce, rice vinegar, honey, sesame oil, and cornstarch.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 tbsp tamari soy sauce
3 tbsp rice vinegar
3 tsp honey
3 tsp toasted sesame oil
3 tsp cornstarch

instructions.primary_message: Once the water is boiling, reduce the heat to low, stir, and cover. Cook until the liquid is absorbed, 15 to 18 minutes. Remove from the heat and let the rice stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
Thinly slice the pork chops crosswise into strips; transfer to a medium bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 pork chops, boneless

instructions.primary_message: Pour about ½ of the sauce over the pork strips (save the rest for later). Toss the pork until coated with the sauce.
Add water to the remaining sauce in the medium bowl and mix.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ cup water

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the cutting board and the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 small bunches asparagus
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root

instructions.primary_message: Snap or cut off and discard the woody ends of the asparagus; cut the spears on an angle into 2-inch pieces. Transfer to a medium bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Peel and mince or grate the ginger; transfer to a small bowl.
Peel and mince the garlic; add to the ginger.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Add coconut oil to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp virgin coconut oil

instructions.primary_message: Add the pork strips to the skillet and cook until browned, 2 to 3 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate.
Once the pork has been transferred, add more oil to the skillet.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp virgin coconut oil

instructions.primary_message: Add the garlic and ginger; cook until fragrant, 15 to 30 seconds.
Add the asparagus and cook, stirring occasionally, until bright green and tender-crisp, 3 to 4 minutes.
Return the pork to the skillet and pour in the remaining sauce; stir to combine. Cook, stirring frequently, until the sauce is thickened, 1 to 2 minutes.
To serve, divide the rice between bowls and top with the stir fry. Enjoy!
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb striploin (New York strip) steak
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and set aside to rest, about 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lemons
1 ½ small heads red cabbage
3 fennel bulbs

instructions.primary_message: Zest and juice lemons into a large bowl. Add yogurt, mayo, poppy seeds, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup plain Greek yogurt
3 tbsp mayonnaise
1 ½ tsp poppy seeds
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Quarter each cabbage lengthwise, then cut out and discard the core; slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Add to the bowl with the dressing.

Trim off root end and stalks of the fennel, leaving only the white bulbs. Halve fennel bulbs lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl, toss to combine the slaw, and set aside.
Toast bread if desired.
instructions.secondary_message: 12 slices gluten-free bread

instructions.primary_message: Thinly slice steak against the grain.

To assemble the sandwiches, layer half of the bread slices with steak and a small portion of the slaw; close with remaining bread slices and cut in half. Serve with remaining slaw on the side and enjoy!
Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 crowns broccoli
1 ½ lb sweet potatoes
1 ½ small bunches asparagus
1 ½ heads butter (Boston) lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Place mayo and spices in a large bowl, then stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup mayonnaise
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Add to the bowl with the mayo mixture.
Peel and halve sweet potatoes lengthwise, then cut crosswise into ¼-inch thick half-moons. Add to the bowl.

Snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus; cut crosswise into 3-inch pieces. Add to the bowl and toss to combine. Add bread crumbs to the bowl, then gently toss once more to coat. Divide veggies between two large baking sheet pans and spread out in an even layer; drizzle with oil.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cup gluten-free bread crumbs
3 tbsp neutral vegetable oil

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, stirring halfway through, until veggies are golden and fork-tender, 18-20 minutes. Remove from oven.

Meanwhile, if using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 ¼ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, place shrimp in a clean large bowl, along with cornstarch, and toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp cornstarch

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add shrimp and cook, stirring occasionally, until just opaque and starting to color, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp neutral vegetable oil

instructions.primary_message: Add chili-garlic sauce to the skillet and stir to combine. Remove from heat and cover to keep warm.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp chili-garlic sauce

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place soy sauce, additional chili-garlic sauce, and sugar in a small bowl. Whisk to combine the sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup tamari soy sauce
1 tbsp chili-garlic sauce
1 tbsp brown sugar

instructions.primary_message: Separate the lettuce into leaves. Pile leaves, in stacks of two per wrap, onto plates; fill with veggies and shrimp. Drizzle with sauce and enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium heads napa cabbage
1 ½ lb cremini mushrooms
1 ½ limes

instructions.primary_message: Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add turkey and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-6 minutes. Transfer to a plate. (Reserve pot with cooking juices for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp neutral vegetable oil
2 ¼ lb ground turkey
¾ tsp coriander, ground
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, fill another large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil over high heat.
While the water comes to a boil, trim off and discard root end of each cabbage; halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Place in a large bowl and set aside.
Once the water is boiling, add soba noodles and cook until tender, about 5 minutes (or cook according to package instructions). Drain and rinse in a colander; set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 15 oz soba (buckwheat) noodles

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, thinly slice mushrooms. Add to the bowl with the cabbage.
Return pot (with cooking juices) to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add cabbage and mushrooms; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are tender, 7-8 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp neutral vegetable oil

instructions.primary_message: While the veggies are cooking, juice limes into a small bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the lime juice along with soy sauce, honey, pepper, and salt. Whisk to combine the sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 cloves garlic
3 tbsp tamari soy sauce
3 tbsp honey
¾ tsp black pepper
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: When the veggies are tender, return turkey to the pot along with drained noodles and sauce. Continue to cook, tossing occasionally, until noodles are warmed through, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide stir-fry between plates or bowls. Sprinkle with sesame seeds and enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp sesame seeds

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 lemons
6 medium parsnips
1 small bunch fresh dill
1 ½ bunches radish
1 ½ heads butter (Boston) lettuce
3 avocados

instructions.primary_message: Zest and juice half of the lemons into a small bowl. Juice remaining lemons into a large bowl and set aside.
Add yogurt, salt, and pepper to the small bowl with the lemon, then stir to combine the sauce. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups plain Greek yogurt
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add oil, salt, and pepper to the large bowl with the lemon juice. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 pinch salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place eggs, baking powder, salt, and pepper in another large bowl. Whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 eggs
1 ½ tsp baking powder
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and coarsely grate parsnips. Add to the bowl with the egg mixture.
Peel, halve, and coarsely grate onions. Add to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ medium yellow onions

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.

While the skillet heats up, shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add half to the bowl, along with flour, and stir to combine the latke mixture. (Reserve remaining dill for serving.)
instructions.secondary_message: 1 cup gluten-free flour

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches, using a ¼-cup measure, drop batter into the skillet, spacing scoops a few inches apart; press down to form ½-inch thick fritters. Cook, flipping once, until latkes are golden brown, 3-5 minutes. Remove to a paper towel-lined plate.
instructions.secondary_message: ⅓ cup extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, trim and thinly slice radishes. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Chop (or tear) lettuce leaves into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl, toss to combine the salad, and set aside.
Halve and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and thinly slice. Season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 pinch salt
3 pinch black pepper

⅓ cup mayonnaise
¼ cup extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp capers
¾ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers. Add to the bowl with the dressing, along with the mixed greens, and toss to combine the salad. Set aside.
Trim and cut cucumbers crosswise into thin rounds. Place on a plate.
Slice mozzarella into rounds. Add to the plate with the cucumber.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (8 oz) pkgs fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.primary_message: Toast bread if desired.
instructions.secondary_message: 12 slices gluten-free bread

instructions.primary_message: To assemble the sandwiches, spread each bread slice with the reserved dressing. Layer half of the slices with cucumber and mozzarella. Season with salt, close with remaining bread slices, and cut in half.
instructions.secondary_message: ¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide sandwiches and salad between plates. Enjoy!
Preheat oven to 450°F. Line a large baking sheet pan with aluminum foil for easier cleanup (optional).
Place ketchup, water, Worcestershire, and sugar in a small bowl, then whisk to combine the sauce. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup ketchup
2 tbsp water
1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
1 tbsp brown sugar

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic. Place in a large bowl along with beef, eggs, bread crumbs, additional ketchup, and spices; mix with your hands until the meatloaf mixture is well combined.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
2 ¼ lb lean ground beef
3 eggs
¾ cup gluten-free bread crumbs
2 tbsp ketchup
1 ½ tsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp onion powder
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Form the meatloaf mixture into 18 short, sausage-like shapes, approximately 3-inches long. Transfer to the baking sheet.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until meatloaves are cooked through, about 25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
12 medium parsnips
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 ½ pints grape tomatoes
1 ½ (5 oz) pkgs spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Peel and medium dice parsnips; peel garlic. Place both in a large pot and cover with hot water (from the tap). Cover and bring to a boil over high heat; once boiling, reduce to a simmer and cook until soft, 12-15 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: While the parsnips are cooking, place oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper in a clean large bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp red wine vinegar
1 ½ tsp Dijon mustard
¾ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim and quarter cucumbers lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl, along with mixed greens, and toss to combine the salad. Set aside.
When the parsnips are done, drain in a colander and return to the pot. Add milk, salt, and pepper, then using a potato masher, mash until smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 fl oz (¾ cup) whole milk
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide mashed parsnips, meatloaves, and salad between plates. Top meatloaves with sauce and enjoy!
Preheat oven to 425°F. Coat two large baking sheet pans with a thin layer of oil.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Place beef, bread crumbs, eggs, and spices in a large bowl. Using your hands, mix well to combine. Using a rounded tablespoon measure, form the mixture into meatballs and divide between the baking sheets.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb lean ground beef
¾ cup gluten-free bread crumbs
3 eggs
1 ½ tsp coriander, ground
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place meatballs in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until golden and cooked through, 18-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lemons
3 (6 oz) pkgs blueberries
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 ½ (5 oz) pkgs baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Zest and juice lemons into a medium saucepan.

Add blueberries and sugar to the pan with the lemon, then stir to combine the sauce. Set over medium heat and cook, stirring often, until blueberries burst and sauce is thickened, 8-10 minutes. Remove from heat and let cool, 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp brown sugar

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, sugar, salt, and pepper in a clean large bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp white wine vinegar
1 tbsp brown sugar
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim and quarter cucumbers, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing, along with spinach, and toss to combine the salad. Set aside.
When the blueberry sauce has cooled, add yogurt to the pan and stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ cups plain Greek yogurt

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide salad and blueberry yogurt sauce between plates. Top sauce with meatballs and enjoy!

Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (12 oz) pkgs extra firm tofu

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ limes
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
1 small bunch cilantro
1 ½ small heads red cabbage
1 ½ heads butter (Boston) lettuce
3 mangoes
3 avocados

instructions.primary_message: Juice limes into a small bowl.
Peel and mince ginger. Add to the bowl with the lime juice along with soy sauce, maple syrup, and chili-garlic sauce, then whisk to combine. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp tamari soy sauce
3 tbsp pure maple syrup
1 ½ tbsp chili-garlic sauce

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, cut the tofu planks in half, then cut each half into 2 triangles. Place in a large bowl, then sprinkle with cornstarch, salt, and pepper. Gently turn to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp cornstarch
¾ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add tofu and cook, flipping halfway through, until golden and crispy, 6-8 minutes. Transfer to a plate. (Wipe the bowl clean with paper towels and reserve for next step.)
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Place in the reserved bowl. (Set aside a small handful of cilantro for serving.)
Add half of the sauce to the bowl with the cilantro, along with oil and vinegar, then whisk to combine the dressing. (Set remaining sauce aside for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp rice vinegar

instructions.primary_message: Halve each cabbage lengthwise, cut out the core, and slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Chop or tear lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
Peel mangoes and slice flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides; cut into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
Halve and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and medium dice. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop peanuts. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad; set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ cup peanuts, roasted unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Return tofu to the skillet, add remaining sauce, and gently toss to coat.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls, then top with tofu and reserved cilantro. Enjoy!
Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap). Add salt, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, preheat another large pot over medium heat.

Once the second pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bread crumbs and salt; cook, stirring frequently, until golden and crispy, 3-5 minutes. Transfer to a small bowl and set aside to cool. (Reserve pot for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ cup gluten-free bread crumbs
3 pinch salt

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 crowns broccoli

instructions.primary_message: Once the water is boiling, add broccoli to the pot and cook, stirring occasionally, until very tender, 6-7 minutes. Use a slotted spoon to transfer broccoli to a large bowl and set aside. (Reserve boiling water in pot for later use.)
Meanwhile, peel, halve, and small dice onions.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 medium yellow onions

instructions.primary_message: Wipe the reserved pot clean with paper towels, then return to medium-high heat; add more oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until soft and starting to brown, 8-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: While the onion is cooking, peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: When the onion is starting to brown, add cooked broccoli, garlic, water, anchovy fillets, crushed red pepper, and salt to the pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until broccoli is soft enough to break apart with a spoon, 10-15 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cup water
3 anchovy fillets, packed in oil
1 ½ tsp crushed red pepper
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, return pot with hot water to high heat and bring back to a boil. Once boiling, add pasta, and stir for a few seconds; cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain pasta and set aside. (Reserve a ½-cup pasta water before draining.)
instructions.secondary_message: 15 oz gluten-free rotini pasta

instructions.primary_message: While the pasta is cooking, finely grate Parmesan. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 oz Parmesan cheese

instructions.primary_message: When the broccoli is very soft, remove 3-cups, then using a potato masher, mash remaining broccoli until a semi-smooth sauce forms.

Wash, dry, and juice lemons into the pot with the sauce. Add drained pasta, reserved pasta water, Parmesan, reserved broccoli, and raisins; continue to cook, stirring frequently, until heated through, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 lemons
¾ cup raisins

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls. Drizzle with oil, top with crispy bread crumbs, and enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ small butternut squash
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
1 ½ (5 oz) pkgs baby spinach
1 small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Trim and peel each squash; halve lengthwise, scrape out the seeds, and medium dice the flesh. Place in a large bowl.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add the white and pale green parts to the bowl with the squash. (Reserve dark green parts for later use.)
Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
While the pot heats up, peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the squash.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add squash, onion, garlic, and spices to the pot; cook, stirring frequently, until onion starts to brown and squash is just tender, 6-7 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp turmeric, ground
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
¾ tsp cumin, ground
¾ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, roughly chop spinach. Place in the reserved bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl with the spinach and set aside.
Rinse lentils in a colander or strainer.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ cups green lentils, dried

instructions.primary_message: When the squash is just tender, add lentils and broth to the pot; stir to combine the curry and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce to a simmer, cover, and cook until the lentils are just tender, about 20 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 72 fl oz (9 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel and mince additional garlic. Place in a medium bowl along with eggs, cottage cheese, flour, milk, baking powder, and salt. Whisk to combine the batter.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
3 eggs
1 ½ cups cottage cheese
1 ½ cup gluten-free flour
3 fl oz (⅜ cup) whole milk
1 ½ tsp baking powder
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, add reserved green onions to the bowl with the batter and whisk once more to combine.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches, using a ½-cup measure, drop batter into skillet, spacing scoops a few inches apart; spread into oval shapes with the back of a spoon. Cook until "flatbreads" are golden brown, 3-5 minutes per side. Remove to a plate.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: When the lentils are tender, add spinach and cilantro to the pot in handfuls, waiting for the greens to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Remove from heat, add yogurt, and stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ cup plain Greek yogurt

instructions.primary_message: Divide curry and flatbread between bowls. Serve with additional yogurt and enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ cup plain Greek yogurt

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 425°F. Line a large baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make clean up easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 caps portobello mushrooms
3 crowns broccoli
3 pints grape tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Remove stems from portobello mushrooms and carefully scrape out the gills. Rub with oil, then season with salt and pepper; transfer to the baking sheet, cap-side down, and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Finely grate Parmesan. Divide between a large and a medium bowl. (Set medium bowl aside for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message: 6 oz Parmesan cheese

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic. Add to the large bowl with the Parmesan along with sausage, bread crumbs, vinegar, and spices. Mix with your hands until well combined.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
1 ½ lb ground pork sausage
¾ cup gluten-free bread crumbs
2 tbsp white wine vinegar
1 tbsp Italian seasoning
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Divide the sausage mixture between mushrooms (about 2 tablespoons each). Using your hands, spread the mixture over the inside of each mushroom in an even layer, gently pressing to adhere.
Place mushrooms in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until they begin to soften, 10-12 minutes.

Meanwhile, separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Place in a clean large bowl, along with the tomatoes. Drizzle with oil, season with salt and pepper, then toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Transfer broccoli and tomatoes to another large baking sheet, spreading them out in an even layer.
When the mushrooms are starting to soften, remove baking sheet from the oven. Sprinkle remaining Parmesan over the mushrooms.
Place both baking sheets in the oven and continue to roast until veggies are fork-tender and sausage is cooked through, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide stuffed mushrooms and veggies between plates. Enjoy!
Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven. (Skip this step if you are using a toaster for the bread.)
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lemons
½ small pkg fresh mint
6 plums

instructions.primary_message: Zest and juice lemons into a medium bowl.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the lemon, along with honey, and stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp honey

instructions.primary_message: Halve plums lengthwise (around the pit); twist halves to separate, then remove and discard pits. Cut each half into thin slices, add to the bowl, and stir to combine. Set aside.

Divide bread between two baking sheet pans. Working in batches, place in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through, until toasted, 2-3 minutes; remove from oven. (Alternatively, you can use a toaster.)
instructions.secondary_message: 12 slices gluten-free bread

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, roughly chop almonds.
instructions.secondary_message: ⅓ cup almonds

instructions.primary_message: Spread cream cheese over the toast, then top with plums and almonds.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 (8 oz) block cream cheese

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide toasts between plates and enjoy!
Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap). Add salt, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 pints grape tomatoes
1 ½ (5 oz) pkgs baby spinach
1 ½ lemons
1 small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Once the water is boiling, uncover, add pasta, and stir for a few seconds; cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain pasta and set aside. (Reserve ¾-cup pasta water before draining and reserve pot for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message: 15 oz gluten-free penne pasta

instructions.primary_message: While the pasta is cooking, halve grape tomatoes. Place in a large bowl.
Roughly chop spinach. Add to the bowl with the tomatoes and set aside.
Juice lemons into a blender.
Pick basil leaves off the stems; discard stems and add leaves to the blender.
Finely grate Parmesan. Add to the blender (reserving a small handful for serving).
instructions.secondary_message: 3 oz Parmesan cheese

instructions.primary_message: Peel garlic and add to the blender.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: When the pasta is done, add reserved pasta cooking water, cottage cheese, pine nuts, oil, and spices to the blender. Blend until sauce is smooth and creamy.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ cups cottage cheese
¾ cup pine nuts
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp Italian seasoning
1 ½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Return pot to medium heat. Add drained pasta, tomatoes, spinach, and sauce to the pot, then stir to combine. Cook, stirring frequently, until pasta is heated through and spinach is wilted, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls. Top with reserved Parmesan and enjoy!
Preheat oven to 350°F.
Place a large bowl (preferably metal) in the freezer to chill. (If space is limited, place in the refrigerator.)
Place flour, oats, sugar, and salt in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cup gluten-free flour
¾ cup oats, quick cooking
¾ cup brown sugar
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Cut butter into small pieces. Place in a large pot and melt over medium heat, stirring occasionally. Add melted butter to the bowl with flour mixture and stir to combine; transfer to a large baking sheet pan and spread out in an even layer. (Wipe pot clean and reserve for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message: ½ cup butter, unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, stirring halfway through, until the streusel is golden brown and crisp, 10-12 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lemons
1 ½ (16 oz) pkgs strawberries
1 small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Juice lemons into the reserved pot. Trim and roughly chop strawberries, then add to the pot along with sugar. Stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp brown sugar

instructions.primary_message: Set pot over medium heat and cook, stirring frequently, until strawberries are very soft and release their juices, 8-10 minutes.
While the strawberries are cooking, place cornstarch and water in a small bowl. Whisk to combine the slurry.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp cornstarch
6 fl oz (¾ cup) water

instructions.primary_message: When the strawberries are very soft, add slurry to the pot. Continue to cook, stirring constantly, until the compote thickens, 2-3 minutes more. Transfer to a clean medium bowl and set aside to cool, 5 minutes.
Pick basil leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
When the compote is cool, add basil to the bowl and stir to combine. Set aside.

Remove bowl from freezer. Pour cream and vanilla into the bowl; use a whisk (or hand blender) to beat the cream vigorously, until medium-soft peaks form, about 4 minutes if whisking. (When you pull the whisk out of the bowl, the cream should hold its shape, with a peak that curls over slightly.)
instructions.secondary_message:
12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) heavy whipping cream
1 ½ tsp vanilla extract

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide streusel, compote, and whipped cream between small bowls, cups, or jars, alternating ingredients to create layers. Enjoy!
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 fennel bulbs
3 medium carrots
3 sticks celery

instructions.primary_message: Trim off root ends and stalks of the fennel, leaving only the white bulbs. Halve fennel bulbs lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Place in a medium bowl.
Peel, trim, and small dice carrots. Add to the bowl with the fennel.
Trim and small dice celery. Add to the bowl.
Peel, halve, and small dice onions. Peel and thinly slice garlic. Add both to the bowl with the other veggies.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, garlic, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are starting to soften 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp Italian seasoning
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, drain and rinse chickpeas in a colander.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (15 oz) cans garbanzo beans (chickpeas)

instructions.primary_message: When the veggies have started to soften, add chickpeas, broth, and tomatoes to the pot, then stir to combine the stew. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat and simmer until veggies and chickpeas are tender, about 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
48 fl oz (6 cups) chicken or vegetable broth
3 (14.5 oz) cans diced tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: While the stew is cooking, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven. (Skip this step if you are using a toaster for the bread.)
Pat cod dry with paper towels and cut into bite-sized pieces. Season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb cod fillet
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the veggies are tender, add cod to the stew. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until the cod is opaque and cooked through, 4-5 minutes more. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, arrange bread on a large baking sheet pan. Place in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through, until toasted, about 2 minutes; remove from oven. (Alternatively, you can use a toaster.)
instructions.secondary_message: 6 slices gluten-free bread

instructions.primary_message: Divide stew between bowls and serve with toast on the side. Enjoy!
Preheat oven to 500°F.
Peel and mince garlic and ginger. In a large bowl, prepare marinade by whisking together ½ of the garlic and ginger (save the rest for the carrots), vinegar, honey, coconut aminos, and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 cloves garlic
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger
9 tbsp balsamic vinegar
9 tbsp honey
4 ½ tbsp coconut aminos
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Make a couple cuts in each of the drumsticks. Add to bowl with marinade and toss to coat. Transfer to a large baking dish, reserving marinade in bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 ¾ lb chicken drumsticks

instructions.primary_message: Place in the oven and bake for 10 minutes. Spoon reserved marinade on top of chicken and continue baking until cooked through, about 25 minutes.
Wash and peel carrots. Slice diagonally into ¼ in pieces.
instructions.secondary_message: 18 medium carrots

instructions.primary_message: Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.

Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add remaining garlic and ginger and cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds. Add carrots and season with salt and pepper. Stirring frequently, cook until carrots are tender-crisp and slightly browned, 8-10 minutes. If skillet gets too dry, add a little water.
instructions.secondary_message:
about 3 tbsp virgin coconut oil
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry parsley. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Stir ½ (save the rest for garnishing) into the carrots.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: To serve, place carrots on a plate, add drumsticks on top, and garnish with remaining parsley. Enjoy!
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 leeks
1 small pkg fresh mint
3 (5 oz) pkgs baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bread crumbs and pumpkin seeds; toast, stirring frequently, until bread crumbs are golden brown, 3-4 minutes. Transfer to a small bowl and set aside. (Reserve pot for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ cup gluten-free bread crumbs
⅓ cup pumpkin seeds

instructions.primary_message: Medium dice bacon.
instructions.secondary_message: 12 slices bacon

instructions.primary_message: Return pot to medium-high heat. Add bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until crispy, 5-6 minutes.

Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, trim off root end and dark green top of the leeks, leaving only the white and pale green parts. Cut leeks in half lengthwise and rinse under running water, separating the layers to remove any dirt and grit. Slice crosswise into ¼-inch thick pieces.
When the bacon is done, add leek, salt, and pepper to the pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add broth, milk, and peas to the pot; stir to combine the soup and bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce to a simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, until peas are tender, 6-8 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
48 fl oz (6 cups) chicken or vegetable broth
12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) whole milk
6 cups frozen peas

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves.

When the peas are tender, add mint and spinach to the pot in handfuls, waiting for the greens to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Continue to cook, stirring frequently, until spinach is very tender, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat, add vinegar, and stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 tbsp apple cider vinegar

instructions.primary_message: Using a hand blender, purée the soup until smooth. (If using a regular blender, work in batches as needed, then return soup to the pot.)
To serve, divide soup between bowls. Sprinkle with bread crumbs and pumpkin seeds. Enjoy!

Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap). Add salt, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, uncover, add pasta, and stir for a few seconds; cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain pasta and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ tsp salt
15 oz gluten-free linguine pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, chop or tear smoked salmon into bite-sized pieces. Place in a small bowl and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (4 oz) pkgs smoked salmon

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 leeks
3 (5 oz) pkgs baby spinach
1 ½ lemons

instructions.primary_message: Trim off root end and dark green top of the leeks, leaving only the white and pale green parts. Cut leeks in half lengthwise and rinse under running water, separating the layers to remove any dirt and grit. Slice crosswise into ¼-inch thick pieces.
Preheat another large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add leek, garlic, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper
¼ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, drain and thinly slice artichoke hearts and sun-dried tomatoes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (6 oz) jars artichoke hearts, marinated
12 sun-dried tomatoes, oil-packed

instructions.primary_message: When the leek is done, add artichokes and sun-dried tomatoes to the pot, then stir to combine.
Add spinach to the pot in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
