instructions.primary_message: Slowly pour milk into the pot, whisking constantly. Continue to cook, whisking constantly, until sauce has thickened, about 2 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 24 fl oz (3 cups) whole milk

instructions.primary_message: Add cheese and spices to the pot. Continue whisking until cheese is melted and sauce is smooth, 1-2 minutes. Add cooked pasta, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper
½ tsp garlic powder

instructions.primary_message: Divide zucchini boats between plates, then fill with macaroni and cheese. Serve with fruit salad on the side and enjoy!
Preheat oven to 450°F. Using a paper towel, lightly coat a large baking dish with oil.
instructions.secondary_message: about 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Grate 3/4 cup of Parmesan. In a medium bowl, mix together Parmesan, bread crumbs, salt, pepper, and paprika.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 oz Parmesan cheese
1 ½ cup gluten-free bread crumbs
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper
⅜ tsp paprika

instructions.primary_message: In a medium bowl, mix together Dijon, honey, and oil.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 tbsp Dijon mustard
4 ½ tbsp honey
1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Slice chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Cut each fillet into strips.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 lb boneless skinless chicken breasts

instructions.primary_message: One by one, dip chicken strips in mustard mixture, then coat in bread crumb mixture, and place in baking dish.
Place in the oven and bake, turning over halfway through, until tenders are golden brown, 15-20 minutes.
Peel and mince garlic. In a small bowl, prepare sauce by mixing together ½ of the garlic (save the rest for the slaw), Dijon, and honey. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 cloves garlic
6 tbsp Dijon mustard
6 tbsp honey

instructions.primary_message: In a large bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together remaining garlic, lemon juice, oil, salt, and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lemon
4 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add broccoli slaw to bowl with dressing. Wash, peel, and medium dice oranges. Add to bowl and toss salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (12 oz) pkg broccoli slaw
3 oranges

instructions.primary_message: To serve, place chicken tenders and broccoli slaw on a plate and have honey mustard sauce on the side. Enjoy!
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 small pkgs fresh basil
1 small pkg chives
1 ½ jalapeño peppers
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 ½ bunches radish
1 ½ avocados
1 ½ (5 oz) pkgs spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic. Divide between a blender and a large bowl. (Set bowl aside for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Pick basil leaves off the stems; discard stems and add leaves to the blender.
Roughly chop chives. Add to the blender.

Quarter jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Add to the blender along with mayo, oil, honey, salt, and pepper. Blend on high, adding water a few tablespoons at a time, if needed, to reach a drizzling consistency. Set dressing aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup mayonnaise
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp honey
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add turkey, bread crumbs, and spices to the reserved bowl with the garlic; using your hands, mix well to combine. Using a rounded tablespoon measure, form the turkey mixture into meatballs and place on a plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb ground turkey
⅓ cup gluten-free bread crumbs
1 ½ tsp paprika
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add meatballs and cook, turning occasionally, until golden brown and cooked through, 6-8 minutes. Transfer to a clean plate.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, trim and halve cucumbers lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Place in a clean large bowl.
Trim and slice radishes crosswise into thin rounds. Add to the bowl with the cucumber.
Halve and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl, along with mixed greens and feta, then toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (4 oz) pkgs crumbled feta cheese

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide salad and meatballs between plates or bowls. Drizzle with dressing and enjoy!
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 medium carrots
3 red bell peppers
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
1 small bunch cilantro
1 ½ limes

instructions.primary_message: Peel and trim carrots; using a julienne (or regular) peeler, peel the carrots into noodle-like strips. Place in a large bowl and set aside.
Trim, seed, and slice bell peppers lengthwise into thin strips. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl with the bell pepper.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bell pepper, green onion, garlic, pork, salt, and crushed red pepper. Cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until pork is browned and veggies are tender, 8-10 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 ¼ lb lean ground pork
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place vinegar, soy sauce, fish sauce, and sugar in the reserved bowl. Whisk to combine the sauce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp rice vinegar
3 tbsp tamari soy sauce
2 tbsp fish sauce
2 tbsp brown sugar

instructions.primary_message: Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the carrot noodles. Set aside.
When the pork is done, crack the eggs into the pot; cook, stirring constantly, until set and no longer runny.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 eggs

instructions.primary_message: Add carrot noodles, cilantro, and sauce to the pot, then stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring frequently, until carrot noodles are tender, 5-6 minutes more. Remove from heat, juice limes into the pot, and stir once more to combine the pad Thai.
Meanwhile, roughly chop peanuts.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ cup peanuts, roasted unsalted

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide pad Thai between plates or bowls, sprinkle with peanuts, and enjoy!
Preheat oven to 400°F. Coat a baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch fresh dill
2 ¼ lb green beans
1 ½ pints grape tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and place the leaves in a blender.
Place corn in the colander and rinse under hot water (from the tap) to defrost. Add to the blender along with yogurt, mayo, water, and spices. Blend on high until yogurt sauce is smooth; set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups frozen corn
1 ½ cups plain Greek yogurt
⅓ cup mayonnaise
3 tbsp water
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper
¼ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Mince almonds. Place in a small bowl along with bread crumbs, and spices, then stir to combine the coating.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup almonds
½ cup gluten-free bread crumbs
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pat cod dry with paper towels and place, skin-side down, on the baking sheet; season the top side with salt and pepper. Spread the fish with mayo, then sprinkle evenly with the coating, pressing gently to adhere.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb cod fillet
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper
⅓ cup mayonnaise

instructions.primary_message: Trim and halve green beans crosswise. Transfer to a large baking sheet.
Halve grape tomatoes. Add to the baking sheet with the green beans. Drizzle veggies with oil, then season with salt and pepper; toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven and roast until cod is cooked through and veggies are fork-tender, 12-15 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide yogurt sauce, green beans, and tomatoes between plates. Top sauce with cod and enjoy!
Preheat oven to 400°F. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
1 small bunch cilantro
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
1 ½ pints grape tomatoes
1 ½ (5 oz) pkgs spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Place in a large bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add half to the bowl with the green onion. (Reserve remaining cilantro for serving.)
Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Add both to the bowl, along with soy sauce and spices, then whisk to combine the marinade.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
½ cup tamari soy sauce
¾ tsp crushed red pepper
¾ tsp black pepper
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: If using salmon with skin, place the fillet, skin-side down, on a cutting board. Holding the tail end (or corner) firmly, use a knife to cut between the flesh and skin; continue to cut through the length of the fillet (take care not to cut through the skin); discard the skin.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 ¼ lb salmon fillet

instructions.primary_message: Pat the salmon dry with paper towels and cut into portions. Add to the bowl, turn to coat, and set aside to marinate, 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, place mayo and hot sauce in a small bowl. Stir to combine the spicy mayo and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup mayonnaise
3 tbsp hot sauce

instructions.primary_message: Place oil, vinegar, honey, salt, and pepper in another large bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp red wine vinegar
1 tbsp honey
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the dressing and set aside.
When the salmon is done marinating, transfer to the baking sheet. Sprinkle with bread crumbs on the top side, pressing gently to adhere.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ cup gluten-free bread crumbs

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven and bake until salmon is opaque and cooked through, 10-12 minutes. Remove from oven.
When the salmon is almost done, add mixed greens to the bowl with the dressing and toss to combine the salad.
Toast buns if desired.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 gluten-free buns or rolls

instructions.primary_message: Spread spicy mayo over the bottom half of each bun, then top with salmon and reserved cilantro. Close with the top half of each bun. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!
Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
1 ½ small pineapples
3 green bell peppers
1 ½ medium heads cauliflower

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince ginger. Place in a large bowl along with water, soy sauce, honey, cornstarch, oil, and spices. Whisk to combine the teriyaki marinade.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup water
⅓ cup tamari soy sauce
3 tbsp honey
3 tbsp cornstarch
2 tbsp toasted sesame oil
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Cut off skin from each pineapple; quarter, core, and medium dice the flesh. Add to the bowl with the marinade.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers. Add to the bowl.
Peel, halve, and medium dice onions. Add to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ medium red onions

instructions.primary_message: Pat chicken dry with paper towels, then medium dice. Add to the bowl and stir to combine. Divide pineapple, veggies, and chicken between two large baking sheet pans, then spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 lb chicken thighs, boneless skinless

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, stirring halfway through, until chicken is cooked through and veggies are fork-tender, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.

Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, cut each cauliflower head into quarters; using a box grater, hold the stem end of the cauliflower and coarsely grate. (Alternatively, transfer cauliflower to the bowl of a food processor; pulse until rice-like in consistency.) Place in a clean large bowl.
When the chicken and veggies have about 10 minutes left, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add cauliflower rice, water, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until cauliflower is golden and tender, 6-7 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp toasted sesame oil
⅓ cup water
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
½ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, roughly chop cashews.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ cup cashews, roasted unsalted

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide cauliflower rice and teriyaki chicken bake between plates or bowls. Top with cashews and enjoy!
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with spices on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb ribeye steak
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
¾ tsp coriander, ground

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside to rest, 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 tbsp toasted sesame oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ limes
1 ½ medium heads napa cabbage
6 medium carrots
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Zest and juice limes into a large bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the lime, along with mayo, coconut aminos, oil, chili-garlic sauce, and spices, then whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
3 tbsp avocado oil mayonnaise
2 tbsp coconut aminos
1 tbsp toasted sesame oil
1 ½ tsp chili-garlic sauce
1 ½ tsp onion powder
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim off and discard root end of each cabbage; halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots. Add to the bowl.
Trim and halve cucumbers lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Drain and roughly chop water chestnuts. Add to the bowl, toss to combine the salad, and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 oz water chestnuts

instructions.primary_message: Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide salad and steak between plates or bowls, then sprinkle with sesame seeds. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 1 tbsp sesame seeds

instructions.primary_message: Preheat the oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb sweet potatoes
6 medium zucchini squash
1 ½ small bunch green onions (scallions)
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root

instructions.primary_message: Peel and medium dice the sweet potatoes into ½-inch cubes; transfer to a large baking sheet.
Trim and discard the ends of the zucchini; medium dice the zucchini into ½-inch cubes and add to the baking sheet.
Peel and mince the garlic; sprinkle over the vegetables.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Drizzle the vegetables with olive oil and season with salt and pepper; toss to coat, then arrange in a single layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place the vegetables in the oven (even if it is not fully heated yet) and cook for 10 minutes while you prepare the salmon.
Peel and mince or grate the ginger; transfer to a medium bowl (that can hold the salmon).
Add soy sauce, olive oil, sesame oil, and honey to the ginger; whisk together.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp tamari soy sauce
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp toasted sesame oil
1 ½ tsp honey

instructions.primary_message: Place the salmon in the bowl and coat with the sauce.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 ¼ lb salmon fillet

instructions.primary_message: Take the baking sheet out of the oven and move the vegetables to the sides of the tray; place the salmon, skin-side-down, in the middle of the tray and pour any remaining marinade overtop.
Return the tray to the oven and bake until the salmon is cooked through and the vegetables are tender, another 10 to 12 minutes.
While the vegetables and salmon cook, trim and discard the ends of the green onions; chop the onions on an angle into ¼-inch pieces.
To serve, place the roasted vegetables and salmon on a plate and sprinkle with the green onions and sesame seeds.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tsp sesame seeds

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch fresh dill
1 ½ lemons
1 ½ bunches radish
1 ½ heads butter (Boston) lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a small saucepan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 1 minute.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Slowly add cream to the pan, stirring constantly. Bring to a simmer, then lower heat and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce has thickened, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) heavy whipping cream

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
When the sauce has thickened, juice lemons into the pan. Add dill, stir to combine, and remove from heat. Cover to keep warm.
Peel and mince shallots. Place in a large bowl along with oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 shallots
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp white wine vinegar
1 ½ tsp Dijon mustard
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Slice radishes crosswise into thin rounds. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Chop or tear lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl and set aside.

If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 ¼ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add shrimp, salt, and pepper; cook until opaque, about 2 minutes per side. Add sauce to the skillet, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, toast bread if desired, then cut in half.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 slices gluten-free bread

instructions.primary_message: Using a peeler, shave Parmesan into curls. Add to the bowl with the lettuce and gently toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 oz Parmesan cheese

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide salad, shrimp, and bread between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 eggplants
1 ½ small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet warms up, peel and small dice the onion into ¼-inch pieces; transfer to a small bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ medium yellow onion

instructions.primary_message: Add the ground beef to the skillet; cook, breaking apart with a spoon, until crumbly and browned, 2 to 4 minutes. Once done, transfer the beef to a bowl and leave the juices in the skillet.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 ¼ lb lean ground beef

instructions.primary_message: While the beef cooks, peel and mince the garlic; transfer to a small bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Preheat the oven to broil and position the rack about 6 inches from the top.
Once the beef has been transferred, add olive oil and the onion to the skillet; cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 3 to 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: While the onion cooks, trim and discard the ends of the eggplants; medium dice the eggplants into ½-inch cubes and transfer to a large bowl.
Add the garlic, eggplant, and diced tomatoes to the skillet; season with cinnamon, salt, and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the eggplant is tender, 8 to 10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (14.5 oz) cans diced tomatoes
3 tsp cinnamon
1 ½ tsp salt
1 ½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the eggplant cooks, in a small saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 tbsp butter, unsalted

instructions.primary_message: While the butter melts, grate ⅓ cup of Parmesan.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ oz Parmesan cheese

instructions.primary_message: Sprinkle in the flour over the melted butter and whisk until the mixture is smooth, 15 to 30 seconds.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 tbsp gluten-free flour

instructions.primary_message: Slowly pour the milk into the saucepan, whisking constantly. Cook the sauce, whisking constantly, until thickened, 1 to 2 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 24 fl oz (3 cups) whole milk

instructions.primary_message: Add the Parmesan to the sauce and season with salt and pepper; stir and remove from the heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Shave the parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and roughly chop the leaves.
Return the ground beef to the skillet and stir in ¾ of the parsley (save the rest for garnishing).
Drizzle the béchamel sauce over the top of the beef and eggplant mixture.
Place the skillet in the oven and broil until the dish is browned on top, 1 to 3 minutes.
To serve, spoon the moussaka into a bowl and sprinkle with the remaining parsley. Enjoy!

Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap). Add salt, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, uncover, add pasta, and stir for a few seconds; cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain pasta and set aside. (Reserve a ½-cup pasta water before draining.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
15 oz gluten-free rotini pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel, halve, and small dice onions; peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium red onions
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Preheat another large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add onion, garlic, sausage, and spices. Cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lb ground pork sausage
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
¾ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 medium zucchini squash
1 ½ lb white mushrooms
1 small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Trim and medium dice zucchini. Place in a medium bowl.
Thinly slice mushrooms. Add to the bowl with the zucchini.
When the sausage is done, add zucchini and mushrooms to the pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 4-5 minutes.
When the veggies are done, add tomato sauce to the pot, then stir to combine. Cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens slightly, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (8 oz) cans tomato sauce

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, pick basil leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves.
Add drained pasta, reserved pasta water, and basil to the pot. Continue to cook, stirring frequently, until heated through, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

Fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, remove from heat, uncover, and add rice noodles. Soak for 10 minutes (or prepare according to package instructions). Drain in a colander and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 15 oz flat rice (pad thai) noodles

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ jalapeño peppers
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
1 ½ limes
3 medium carrots

instructions.primary_message: Halve jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Slice crosswise into thin half-moons and place in a small bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Add both to the bowl with the jalapeño.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Juice limes into the bowl. Add water, soy sauce, honey, cornstarch, pepper, and salt, then whisk to combine the stir-fry sauce. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup water
⅓ cup tamari soy sauce
3 tbsp honey
2 tbsp cornstarch
¾ tsp black pepper
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Preheat another large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, pat pork dry with paper towels and cut into 1-inch cubes. Season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 pork chops, boneless
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add pork and cook, stirring occasionally, until browned and cooked through, 4-5 minutes. Remove to a plate. (Reserve pot with cooking juices for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message: 1 tbsp toasted sesame oil

instructions.primary_message: While the pork is cooking, using a clean cutting board, peel, trim, and slice carrots crosswise into ¼-inch thick rounds.
Return pot (with cooking juices) to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add carrot and broccoli slaw; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp toasted sesame oil
1 ½ (12 oz) pkgs broccoli slaw

instructions.primary_message: Add drained noodles, pork, and stir-fry sauce to the pot, then toss to combine. Continue to cook, tossing occasionally, until noodles are warmed through and sauce thickens, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide stir-fry between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

Fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, remove from heat and add rice noodles. Soak for 10 minutes (or prepare according to package instructions). Drain in a colander and rinse under cold water to cool; set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 15 oz flat rice (pad thai) noodles

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ small bunches green onions (scallions)
3 medium carrots
1 ½ English cucumbers
3 red bell peppers

instructions.primary_message: Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Place white and pale green parts in a small bowl. Place remaining (dark green) onion on a plate and set aside.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the green onions.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add green onions and garlic; cook, stirring frequently, until onion is golden and crisp, 3-4 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
instructions.secondary_message: ⅓ cup neutral vegetable oil

instructions.primary_message: Add crushed red pepper, sesame seeds, sugar, and salt to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 2 minutes. Transfer to the reserved bowl, along with soy sauce and vinegar, then stir to combine the chili crunch. Set aside. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp crushed red pepper
1 tbsp sesame seeds
1 ½ tsp brown sugar
¾ tsp salt
1 tbsp tamari soy sauce
1 tbsp rice vinegar

instructions.primary_message: If using frozen shrimp, place them in the colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 ¼ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Return the skillet to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add shrimp, salt, and pepper; cook until opaque, about 2 minutes per side. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp neutral vegetable oil
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel and trim carrots; using a julienne (or regular) peeler, peel the carrots into noodle-like strips. Add to the plate with the reserved green onions.
Trim and slice cucumbers crosswise into thin rounds. Add to the plate.
Trim, seed, and slice bell peppers lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the plate.
To serve, divide noodles, shrimp, and veggies between bowls. Top with reserved green onions and drizzle with chili crunch. Enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, peel, and coarsely grate sweet potatoes. Place in a large bowl along with eggs, flour, cinnamon, and salt, then stir to combine the batter.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb sweet potatoes
6 eggs
⅓ cup gluten-free flour
1 ½ tsp cinnamon, ground
3 pinch salt

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp virgin coconut oil

instructions.primary_message: Working in batches, using a ¼-cup measure, drop batter into the skillet, spacing scoops a few inches apart; flatten slightly with the back of a spoon. Cook, flipping once, until fritters are golden brown and cooked through, 6-8 minutes. Remove to a paper towel-lined plate.
Meanwhile, wash and dry raspberries. Place in a medium saucepan along with maple syrup.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (6 oz) pkgs raspberries
1 tbsp pure maple syrup

instructions.primary_message: Set pan over medium heat and cook, stirring occasionally, until raspberries are warmed through, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat and lightly crush raspberries with a potato masher or fork to create a semi-smooth sauce.
To serve, divide fritters between plates, then top with yogurt and raspberry sauce. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 1 cup plain Greek yogurt

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups jasmine rice
24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ oranges
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
1 ½ small pineapples
3 red bell peppers

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, juice oranges into a small bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the orange juice along with soy sauce, honey, oil, salt, and crushed red pepper. Stir to combine the glaze and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
3 tbsp tamari soy sauce
1 tbsp honey
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
While the pot heats up, pat steak dry with paper towels and thinly slice against the grain. Season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb striploin (New York strip) steak
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the pot is hot, add steak and half of the glaze; cook, stirring occasionally, until steak is just cooked through, 4-5 minutes. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve pot and remaining glaze for later use.)
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Place in a medium bowl.
Cut off skin from each pineapple; quarter, core, and medium dice the flesh. Add to the bowl with the green onions.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers. Add to the bowl.

Wipe the pot clean with paper towels, return to medium heat, add oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add green onions, pineapple, and bell pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until pineapple softens, 5-6 minutes. Remove from heat and cover to keep warm.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: When the rice is done, add to the pot, along with reserved glaze, and stir to combine.
To serve, divide pineapple rice and steak between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 leeks
6 medium carrots
6 sticks celery

instructions.primary_message: Drain and rinse the beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (15 oz) cans cannellini (white kidney) beans

instructions.primary_message: Trim off root end and dark green top of the leeks, leaving only the white and pale green parts. Cut leeks in half lengthwise and rinse under running water, separating the layers to remove any dirt and grit. Slice crosswise into ¼-inch thick pieces and place in a large bowl.
Peel, trim, and small dice carrots. Add to the bowl with the leek.
Trim and thinly slice celery crosswise. Add to the bowl.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the veggies.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, garlic, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 5-6 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp paprika
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
¾ tsp thyme, dried

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Coarsely grate cheese. Place in the reserved bowl and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 (8 oz) block mozzarella cheese

instructions.primary_message: When the veggies are softened, add beans, tomato sauce, water, and Worcestershire to the pot; stir to combine and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to low and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce is slightly thickened, 4-5 minutes more.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (8 oz) cans tomato sauce
¾ cup water
1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce

instructions.primary_message: While the beans are cooking, chop or tear prosciutto into bite-sized pieces.
instructions.secondary_message: 12 slices prosciutto

instructions.primary_message: When the sauce is slightly thickened, transfer bean mixture to a large baking dish, then top with prosciutto and cheese. Place in the oven and broil until cheese is melted and prosciutto is crispy, 3-4 minutes. Remove from oven.

When the bake is done, divide bread between two baking sheet pans. Working in batches, place in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through, until lightly toasted, 1-2 minutes. Remove from oven and cut in half. (Alternatively, you can use a toaster.)
instructions.secondary_message: 12 slices gluten-free bread

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide cheesy bean bake and toast between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
Preheat oven to 425°F. Line two large baking sheet pans with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
12 medium carrots
1 ½ lemons
1 ½ (5 oz) pkgs spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and quarter carrots lengthwise, then cut crosswise into 2-inch long sticks. Place in a large bowl.
Finely grate Parmesan. Add to the bowl with the carrots, along with mayo and spices, then stir to coat. Divide between the baking sheets and spread out in an even layer. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
4 ½ oz Parmesan cheese
2 tbsp mayonnaise
1 ½ tsp oregano, dried
¾ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until carrots are fork-tender and cheese is golden and crispy, 20-25 minutes.
Meanwhile, zest lemons into a small bowl. Add flour and spices, then stir to combine the coating. (Reserve lemons for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp gluten-free flour
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
¾ tsp garlic powder
¼ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; sprinkle with the coating on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 pork chops, bone-in

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches, add chops and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate, cover with aluminum foil, and set aside to rest.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, juice reserved lemons into the reserved large bowl. Add oil, maple syrup, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp pure maple syrup
¾ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Just before serving, add mixed greens to the bowl with the dressing and toss to coat.
To serve, divide carrots, chops, and dressed greens between plates. Enjoy!
Preheat oven to 400°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
12 baby bok choy
1 ½ limes

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince ginger. Place in a large bowl, along with coconut aminos, oil, chili-garlic sauce, and spices, then whisk to combine the marinade. (If coconut oil is solid, melt in a small saucepan over low heat.)
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup coconut aminos
¼ cup virgin coconut oil
2 tbsp chili-garlic sauce
1 ½ tsp cumin, ground
1 ½ tsp coriander, ground
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim and cut bok choy lengthwise into quarters. Divide between two large baking sheet pans, drizzle with half of the marinade, and turn to coat. Spread bok choy out in an even layer. (Reserve remaining marinade for later use.)
Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until bok choy is tender and starting to brown, 10-12 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat chicken dry with paper towels, add to the bowl with the reserved marinade, and turn to coat.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 lb chicken thighs, boneless skinless

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add chicken (shaking off any excess marinade) and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp virgin coconut oil

instructions.primary_message: While the chicken is cooking, zest and juice limes into a small bowl. Add peanut butter, chili-garlic sauce, and salt, then whisk to combine the sauce. If needed, add water, a few teaspoons at a time, to reach a drizzling consistency.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup natural peanut butter
1 tbsp chili-garlic sauce
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide bok choy and chicken between plates or bowls. Drizzle with peanut sauce, sprinkle with sesame seeds, and enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp sesame seeds

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, cut bread into 1-inch cubes.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 slices gluten-free bread

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bread cubes and cook, stirring occasionally, until croutons are golden and toasted, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside to cool slightly.

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)

1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
1 ½ lemons
1 ½ English cucumbers
3 tomatoes
3 avocados
3 (5 oz) pkgs spring mix (mixed greens)

Juice lemons into the bowl with the parsley. Add mayo, oil, Dijon, maple syrup, and spices, then whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup mayonnaise
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 tbsp pure maple syrup
¾ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim and quarter cucumbers lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Medium dice tomatoes. Add to the bowl.
Halve and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and medium dice. Add to the bowl.
Drain and thinly slice artichoke hearts. Add to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (6 oz) jars artichoke hearts, marinated

instructions.primary_message: Drain tuna and flake with a fork. Add to the bowl, along with mixed greens and cooled croutons, then toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 (6 oz) cans chunk light tuna in water

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls and enjoy!
Preheat oven to 350°F.
Slice tortillas in half, then crosswise into ½-inch strips. Transfer to a large baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with salt; toss to coat and spread out in a single layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 small corn tortillas
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, stirring halfway through, until tortilla strips are golden and crispy, 10-12 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 sticks celery
3 red bell peppers
3 medium zucchini squash
1 small bunch cilantro
1 ½ limes

instructions.primary_message: Trim and medium dice celery. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers. Add to the bowl with the celery.
Trim and coarsely grate zucchini. Add to the bowl and set aside.
Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
While the pot heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onions. Peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, garlic, chicken, and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 6-7 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ lb ground chicken
2 tbsp chili powder
¾ tsp cumin, ground
1 ½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, drain and rinse beans. Set aside to drain further.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (15 oz) cans cannellini (white kidney) beans

instructions.primary_message: When the chicken is done, add veggies, corn, and flour to the pot. Stir to combine and continue to cook until veggies are tender, 4-5 minutes more.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup frozen corn
2 tbsp gluten-free flour

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Set aside.

When the veggies are done, add beans and broth to the pot; stir to combine the chili and bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until beans are tender and chili thickens slightly, 10-12 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 48 fl oz (6 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: When the chili is done, juice limes into the pot. Add cilantro and yogurt, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 cup plain Greek yogurt

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide chili between bowls and top with crispy tortilla strips. Enjoy!
Preheat oven to 400°F. Coat two baking sheet pans with a thin layer of oil.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 tbsp toasted sesame oil

instructions.primary_message: Place bread crumbs, oil, salt, and pepper in a small bowl. Stir to combine the breading mixture and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup gluten-free bread crumbs
1 tbsp toasted sesame oil
¾ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pat chicken dry with paper towels, then slice lengthwise into 1-inch strips. Place in a large bowl along with mayo, salt, and pepper, then toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
¼ cup mayonnaise
¾ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add breading mixture to the bowl with the chicken and toss to coat, pressing gently to adhere. Divide chicken between the baking sheets and arrange in a single layer. (Reserve small bowl for later use.)
Place chicken in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, flipping halfway, until golden and cooked through, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium heads napa cabbage
1 ½ bunches kale
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root

instructions.primary_message: Place peanut butter, oil, vinegar, sugar, and spices in a clean large bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup natural peanut butter
2 tbsp toasted sesame oil
2 tbsp rice vinegar
2 tbsp brown sugar
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt
¼ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Using a clean cutting board, trim off and discard root end of each cabbage; halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Add to the bowl with the dressing.

Fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; cut leaves crosswise into thin (shred-like) pieces; add to the bowl. Using your hands, massage kale and cabbage with the dressing until wilted, 1-2 minutes.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop peanuts. Add to the bowl, toss to combine the slaw, and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ cup peanuts, roasted unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince ginger. Place in the reserved small bowl, along with ketchup, soy sauce, vinegar, and sugar. Whisk to combine the tonkatsu sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup ketchup
2 tbsp tamari soy sauce
1 tbsp rice vinegar
1 tbsp brown sugar

instructions.primary_message: Divide chicken tenders and slaw between plates. Serve with tonkatsu sauce for dipping and enjoy!

3 eggplants
1 ½ lb green beans
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root

1 tbsp toasted sesame oil

¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, trim and small dice eggplants. Place in a large bowl.

Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Add both to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Return pot (with drippings) to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until browned and softened, 5-6 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp toasted sesame oil
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place soy sauce, vinegar, chili-garlic sauce, and additional oil in the reserved bowl. Whisk to combine the stir-fry sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp tamari soy sauce
3 tbsp rice vinegar
1 tbsp chili-garlic sauce

instructions.primary_message: When the veggies are done, return pork to the pot, along with sauce, and stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until pork and veggies are coated in sauce, 3-4 minutes more. Remove from heat.

3 tbsp tamari soy sauce

1 tbsp cornstarch
¼ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pat the steak dry with paper towels, place on a cutting board, and slice crosswise into thin strips. Add to the bowl with the marinade, stir to coat, and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 ¼ lb flank steaks

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
6 medium carrots

3 red chili peppers
1 small pkg fresh basil
1 ½ limes

instructions.secondary_message: 3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots. Add to the bowl with the ginger and garlic.
Trim, seed, and slice bell peppers lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the bowl.

Thinly slice chili peppers into rings; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Add to the bowl and set aside. (Be careful with chilis; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp toasted sesame oil

instructions.primary_message: Working in batches if necessary, add steak (leaving excess marinade in bowl) and cook, undisturbed, until browned, about 3 minutes. Turn and continue to cook until desired doneness, 1-2 minutes more. Remove to a plate. (Reserve pot with drippings for later use.)

Meanwhile, pick basil leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Place in a small bowl along with soy sauce, water, sugar, and vinegar. Stir to combine the stir-fry sauce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup tamari soy sauce
⅓ cup water
2 tbsp brown sugar
1 tbsp rice vinegar

instructions.primary_message: Return the pot (with drippings) to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until tender-crisp, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp toasted sesame oil

instructions.secondary_message:
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide stir-fry and eggs between plates or bowls. Sprinkle with sesame seeds and enjoy!

6 mangoes

3 tbsp gluten-free flour

instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp toasted sesame oil

3 tbsp toasted sesame oil

2 ¼ lb new potatoes

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the chicken and cook until browned and cooked through, 4-5 minutes. Transfer chicken to a large bowl and cover with foil.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp virgin coconut oil

instructions.primary_message: Wash bok choy, trim ends, and chop into 1-inch pieces.
instructions.secondary_message: 24 baby bok choy

instructions.primary_message: Return the skillet to the heat and add the bok choy; cook, tossing frequently, until the bok choy is wilted and tender, 2-4 minutes. Add the teriyaki sauce. Cook, stirring often, until the sauce is slightly thickened, 2-3 minutes. Add the bok choy to the bowl with the chicken and stir until well combined.
To serve, divide the rice between bowls, top with the stir fry, and sprinkle with cashews. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: ⅜ cup cashews, roasted unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with water, season water with salt, cover and bring to a boil. Add pasta and stir for a few seconds. Cook, uncovered, until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp salt
15 oz gluten-free spaghetti pasta

instructions.primary_message: While pasta is cooking, preheat a medium skillet over medium-high heat.
Chop the bacon into 1-inch pieces; add to the skillet and cook until crispy, 4-5 minutes. Once done, transfer to a plate lined with paper towels. Reserve 3 tbsp of bacon fat.
instructions.secondary_message: 12 slices bacon

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, crack the eggs into a large bowl; add 4 ½ tbsp cream and whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 eggs
2 ¼ fl oz heavy cream

instructions.primary_message: Finely grate Parmesan and transfer to the bowl with egg mixture. Season with salt and pepper; whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 ½ oz Parmesan cheese
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When pasta is done, drain in a colander, reserving ½ cup of cooking liquid.
Trim off and discard the root ends of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Add the reserved bacon fat to empty pasta pot. Return pot to heat, reduce heat to low. Add garlic, stirring until fragrant, about 1-2 minutes.
Return pasta and bacon to pot. Remove pot from heat, add the egg mixture to pasta, stirring frequently. Stir just until the egg mixture begins to thicken, 3-4 minutes.
If the sauce seems dry, add some of the reserved pasta water 1 tbsp at a time, until rich and creamy.
Wash and dry parsley. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Reserve a small amount for garnish and add the rest to the pot with the pasta.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ small bunches Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide pasta between bowls and garnish with remaining parsley. Enjoy!
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 medium heads napa cabbage
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
1 ½ limes

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tbsp virgin coconut oil

instructions.primary_message: Add the ground beef to the skillet; cook, breaking apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4 to 6 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. Once done, transfer to a large bowl and cover with foil, leaving juices in the skillet. Cook in batches is necessary.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 lb lean ground beef
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and thinly slice onion.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ medium red onions

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince or press the garlic. Peel and mince or grate the ginger.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Return the skillet to the stove over medium heat and add oil. Once oil is melted, add onion, garlic, and ginger. Cook, stirring occasionally, until fragrant, about 2 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tbsp virgin coconut oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, trim off and discard the root end of the cabbage; halve the cabbage lengthwise then thinly slice crosswise.
Add the cabbage to the skillet. Cook, stirring frequently, until the cabbage is softened, 2 to 3 minutes. Cook in batches if necessary.
Juice the lime into a small bowl.
Season with cabbage with soy sauce, sesame oil, lime juice, and chili-garlic sauce. Add the cabbage mixture to the beef and stir until well combined.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup tamari soy sauce
3 tbsp toasted sesame oil
2 tbsp chili-garlic sauce

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide the beef mixture between bowls and enjoy!
Preheat oven to 450°F.
Fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover with a lid and bring to a boil over high heat.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 red bell peppers
6 tomatoes
1 ½ (5 oz) pkgs baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 ¼ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: When the water in the pot comes to a boil, uncover the pot and season the water with salt, then add the pasta and stir for a few seconds. Cook the pasta, uncovered, for 11-12 minutes (or according to package directions). Once done, drain the pasta in a colander.
instructions.secondary_message:
15 oz gluten-free linguine pasta
1 tbsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Peel and chop onion into 2-inch pieces; peel garlic. Spread out between two large baking sheets.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium red onions
6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Cut the bell peppers lengthwise; remove and discard the seeds and white membrane and chop into 2-inch pieces. Chop tomatoes into quarters and place on the baking sheet along with the peppers.

Drizzle veggies with oil and season with salt and pepper; place in the oven and roast for 13-14 minutes. During that last 3-4 minutes of cooking, change the setting to broil and cook until they begin to char slightly, switching the position of the pans halfway through.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 tbsp butter, unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Add shrimp to the pan, season with salt and pepper. Cook until golden brown and pink all the way through, about 2-3 minutes, cook in batches if necessary.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp salt
1 tbsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Finely grate Parmesan.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 oz Parmesan cheese

instructions.primary_message: When vegetables are done cooking let cool for 3-4 minutes. Once cooled, peel the skin off the peppers and tomatoes and discard them.
Add vegetables to the blender and blend until mostly smooth. Add half the Parmesan and season with salt and crushed red pepper. Pulse to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Return pasta to the pot, add shrimp, sauce and spinach and stir to until spinach is wilted slightly.
To serve, divide pasta between plates, top with remaining Parmesan. Enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
about 21 cups water
3 tbsp salt
15 oz (1 quarter coin = 2 oz) gluten-free spaghetti pasta

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry carrot, celery, and basil. Small dice carrot and celery. Pick basil leaves off the stems and thinly slice into ribbons. Transfer to a plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 carrots
3 sticks celery
1 ½ small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Heat a sauté pan over medium heat.
Peel and mince onion and garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onion
6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Coat bottom of pan with oil. Add onion, garlic, carrot, celery, and crushed red pepper. Stirring frequently, cook until softened, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
⅜ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Increase heat to medium-high and add beef. Breaking apart with a spoon, cook until browned and crumbly, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 ¼ lb lean ground beef

instructions.primary_message: Add tomatoes, ½ of the basil (save the rest for garnishing), Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper. Stir and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer, stirring occasionally, for 10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (14.5 oz) cans diced tomatoes
1 ½ tsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp pepper

instructions.primary_message: Grate or shave ⅓ cup of Parmesan.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ oz Parmesan cheese

instructions.primary_message: Drain pasta, return to pot, and drizzle with a little olive oil to prevent sticking.
To serve, place pasta in a shallow bowl or plate and top with bolognese sauce. Sprinkle with Parmesan and garnish with remaining basil. Enjoy!
Chop the bacon into small pieces.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 slices bacon

instructions.primary_message: Heat a large saucepan over medium heat.

Add bacon to the saucepan and cook until crispy, 3-4 minutes. Remove bacon with a slotted spoon and place on a paper towel lined plate; remove the saucepan from the heat but leave the bacon fat in the saucepan.
Peel and mince garlic. Peel and small dice the onion.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 cloves garlic
1 ½ medium yellow onions

instructions.primary_message: Wash the squash; trim off and discard the ends. Halve the squash lengthwise and scrape out the seeds from each half; peel and small dice the squash. You should have about 4 ½ cups of diced squash.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ small butternut squash

instructions.primary_message: Return the saucepan to medium heat. Add the onion, minced garlic, and butternut squash to the bacon fat. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 2 minutes.
Add broth to the pan with the squash mixture, bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, and let simmer, covered, until the squash is fork-tender, 15 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
18 oz gluten-free fettuccine pasta
1 ½ tbsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Finely grate the Parmesan cheese and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 4 ½ oz Parmesan cheese

instructions.primary_message: Once the squash is cooked through, purée with an immersion (hand) blender or regular blender. Return the puréed mixture to the saucepan on low heat to keep warm. Stir in the grated Parmesan cheese, salt, and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add pasta to the saucepan with the squash purée; toss to combine.
Add spinach to the pasta and stir, allowing the spinach to wilt into the pasta, about 3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (5 oz) pkgs baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide pasta between bowls and top with bacon. Enjoy!
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a large saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cups jasmine rice
6 cup water

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ English cucumbers
3 avocados
1 ½ red bell peppers

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Trim and discard the ends of the cucumber; halve the cucumber lengthwise, then cut in ½-inch cubes. Add to a bowl.
Cut the bell pepper into quarters lengthwise; remove and discard the seeds and white membranes. Small dice the pepper. Add to a bowl with the cucumber.
Season vegetables with soy sauce and sesame oil. Add sesame seeds and stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp tamari soy sauce
1 ½ tsp toasted sesame oil
1 tbsp sesame seeds

instructions.primary_message: Halve and pit the avocado; cube the flesh into ½-inch cubes while still in the skin. Scoop out the flesh and set aside.
Uncover the rice and fluff with a fork. Add vinegar and salt and stir to combine. Spread out rice on a large baking sheet to cool, about 5-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp rice vinegar
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Drain tuna, add to a new bowl, and flake with a fork. Add chili-garlic sauce and mayo and stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (6 oz) cans chunk light tuna in water
1 tbsp chili-garlic sauce
⅓ cup mayonnaise

instructions.primary_message: Using a 1 cup measure, fill up to the ⅓ mark with veggies and avocado, then to the ½ way mark with tuna, and finally the rest of the way with rice.

Once the stack is complete, flip the measuring cup onto a large plate. Tap on the bottom of the cup to loosen the stack. If the rice is sticking, run a knife around the edge before flipping. Serve immediately, 2-stacks per person. Enjoy!

Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the tofu in half horizontally to form two thin planks. Place the tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place a baking sheet with something heavy (like a skillet) on top to press out excess water. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (12 oz) pkg extra firm tofu

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Season the rice with salt and add water; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cups basmati rice
1 ½ tsp salt
6 cup water

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 red bell peppers
3 yellow bell peppers
1 ½ small bunches cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Remove the seeds and membrane from the peppers and cut into strips; place them in a large bowl.
Once the water for the rice is boiling, reduce the heat to low, stir, and cover. Cook until the liquid is absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Remove from the heat and let the rice stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
Peel and slice the onion into thin half moons; add to the bowl with the peppers.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ medium red onions

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Meanwhile, large dice the tofu (cut into ¾-inch cubes).
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the tofu, and cook, stirring occasionally, until it starts to brown, about 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp virgin coconut oil

instructions.primary_message: Combine soy sauce, water, maple syrup, and chili-garlic in a small bowl, whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup tamari soy sauce
3 tbsp water
2 tbsp pure maple syrup
1 tbsp chili-garlic sauce

instructions.primary_message: When tofu is brown, add the soy mixture to the skillet along with the pepper and onions. Stir occasionally, until the vegetables begin to brown, about 5 minutes. Cook in batches if necessary.
Shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Roughly chop the cashews.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ cup cashews, roasted unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Uncover the rice and fluff with a fork; add cilantro to rice, reserving some for garnish.
Divide the rice between plates and top with the tofu and pepper mixture. Garnish with cilantro and cashews and enjoy!
Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lb green beans
2 ¼ lb sweet potatoes

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat.
When pan is hot, add almond meal and bread crumbs to dry pan. Toast, stirring often, until golden brown; about 2 minutes. Transfer the breading mix to a medium bowl and set pan aside to use later.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup almond meal/flour
2 ¼ cup gluten-free bread crumbs

instructions.primary_message: Add salt and pepper to the bowl with the almonds and bread crumbs and stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
1 ½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pat the chicken dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin cutlets.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 ¼ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.primary_message: Crack the egg into another medium bowl and beat with a whisk or fork.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 eggs

instructions.primary_message: One piece at a time, dip chicken fillets in the beaten egg (letting the excess drip off), then in the almond mixture (pressing to adhere) and place on a parchment lined baking sheet. Cook in the center of the oven until golden brown and cooked through; about 18 minutes.

Peel and cut the sweet potatoes into 1-inch cubes; transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water to the saucepan, covering the potatoes, cover with a lid, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium-low and cook until they are tender when pierced with a fork, 10-12 minutes.
Trim and discard the ends of the green beans.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Peel and mince or press the garlic.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Add butter to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the beans, garlic, salt, and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the beans are tender-crisp, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp butter, unsalted
3 pinch salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the potatoes are tender, remove from heat, carefully scoop out ¾ cup of the water and set aside. Drain the potatoes in a colander and return them back to the saucepan.
Add maple syrup, butter, salt, pepper and the reserved cooking water (if needed) to the potatoes; mash with a potato masher (or fork) until smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp pure maple syrup
1 tbsp butter, unsalted
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide the almond-crusted chicken, green beans, and maple mash between plates. Enjoy!
Fill a large pot halfway with water and bring to a boil. Remove from heat and add rice noodles; stir to seperate the noodles. Soak for 10 minutes or according to package directions.
instructions.secondary_message: 15 oz flat rice (pad thai) noodles

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (8 oz) pkg sugar snap peas
3 small pkgs fresh basil
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root

instructions.primary_message: Drain shrimp in a colander and rinse under cold water until there are no more ice chunks; skip this step if you are using fresh shrimp. Spread out on a clean towel and pat dry.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 ¼ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Peel and thinly slice onions into half rings.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ medium red onions

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince or grate the ginger.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Peel and mince the garlic.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onions and sugar snap peas. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the peas are tender crisp, 2-3 minutes. Transfer the veggies to a plate and return the skillet to the heat.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 tbsp virgin coconut oil

instructions.primary_message: Add more coconut oil to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the shrimp, garlic, and ginger to the skillet. Cook until the shrimp are opaque, 1-2 minutes per side. Once done, remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 tbsp virgin coconut oil

instructions.primary_message: When the noodles are tender, scoop out ¾ cup of the cooking water, then drain in a colander. Rinse the noodles under cold running water.

Return the skillet to the heat and add noodles, veggies, soy sauce, fish sauce, maple syrup, and the reserved cooking water to the shrimp. Stir until well combined and heated through, 2-3 minutes. Cook in batches if necessary.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup tamari soy sauce
3 tbsp fish sauce
3 tbsp pure maple syrup

instructions.primary_message: Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Roughly chop the peanuts.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ cup peanuts, roasted unsalted

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide shrimp, noodles, and veggies between plates and sprinkle with basil and peanuts. Enjoy!

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Slice chicken into 1-½ inch strips; season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: In a medium bowl, combine the shredded coconut, breadcrumbs, and garlic powder.

1 ½ cups shredded unsweetened coconut
1 ½ cup gluten-free bread crumbs
¾ tsp garlic powder

instructions.primary_message: In another small bowl, whisk the eggs with the water.

3 eggs
3 tbsp water

instructions.primary_message: Dip the chicken tenders into the egg and then into the breadcrumb mixture, pressing gently to adhere. Place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 30 minutes, turning once, halfway through. (Use two baking sheets if necessary.)
In a small bowl, whisk together the Dijon, oil, honey, and vinegar; set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp Dijon mustard
¼ cup extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp honey
3 tbsp apple cider vinegar

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce (Skip spring mix if it came pre-washed).
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 ½ pints grape tomatoes
6 medium carrots
3 (5 oz) pkgs spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Medium dice the cucumbers. Halve the grape tomatoes.
Trim and peel the carrots, then julienne or coarsely grate them.

Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ cups jasmine rice
4 ½ cup water

instructions.primary_message: Drain and rinse the beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.

6 caps portobello mushrooms
1 ½ English cucumbers
3 medium carrots
¾ small bunch green onions (scallions)
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
In a medium bowl, combine vinegar, sugar, and salt. Thinly slice the cucumbers, add to the bowl, and toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup rice vinegar
3 tbsp brown sugar
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince the garlic and the ginger; place in a small bowl. Add soy sauce, brown sugar, and sesame oil to make the teriyaki sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
9 cloves garlic

Peel and thinly slice onion into half rings.

instructions.primary_message: Add beans and teriyaki sauce to the skillet and cook 3 minutes more.

Uncover the rice and fluff with a fork, and drizzle with sesame oil and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Fold the oil and seeds into the rice.

3 tbsp toasted sesame oil
3 tbsp sesame seeds

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide rice between bowls and top with mushrooms, cucumbers, carrots, and green onions. Enjoy!

Peel and mince garlic; combine with chili garlic sauce, soy sauce, honey, and sesame oil in a small bowl; whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 cloves garlic
2 tbsp chili-garlic sauce
¾ cup tamari soy sauce
3 tbsp honey
3 tbsp toasted sesame oil

3 medium carrots

Peel and thinly slice onions into half rings.

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

instructions.primary_message: Add onions to the skillet and stir-fry until tender, 2-3 minutes.
Peel and grate or julienne the carrots.
Add peas and carrots to the skillet with the onions and stir-fry, 2-3 minutes more. Cook in batches if necessary.
Trim off and discard the root end of the cabbages; halve the cabbages lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise.
Add cabbage and remaining marinade to skillet and stir-fry until cabbage is just wilted, 1-2 minutes.
To serve, divide stir-fried vegetables between plates; top with chicken and sesame seeds. Enjoy!

instructions.primary_message: Cut the tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich the tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place side by side on a baking sheet. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups jasmine rice
3 cup water

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince the garlic. In a medium bowl, combine garlic, sesame oil, tamari, and maple syrup to make a marinade for the tofu.
