3 cloves garlic
3 tbsp toasted sesame oil
⅓ cup tamari soy sauce
3 tbsp pure maple syrup

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid with the rice comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.

instructions.primary_message: Wash, trim, and peel the carrot; coarsely grate and set aside.

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, prepare the peanut sauce by whisking together ginger, peanut butter, chili-garlic sauce, tamari, maple syrup, and hot water in a small bowl.

⅓ cup natural peanut butter
1 ½ tbsp chili-garlic sauce
1 tbsp tamari soy sauce
1 tbsp pure maple syrup
¼ cup water

instructions.primary_message: Once the tofu is cooked, transfer to a plate, returning the skillet to the heat. Add kale and water to the skillet and cover with a lid. Allow to steam for 1 minute covered then uncover, stirring occasionally, for 1 minute more.

instructions.primary_message: Uncover the rice, fluff with a fork, and add sesame oil. Fold the oil into the rice.

instructions.primary_message: Coat bottom of sauté pan with oil. Add bread cubes and, stirring occasionally, toast until golden brown, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic. In a large bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together garlic, olive oil, vinegar, honey, salt, and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tbsp balsamic vinegar
1 ½ tsp honey
⅜ tsp salt
3 pinches black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry strawberries, cucumber, and basil. Trim stem ends, quarter, and add strawberries to bowl with dressing. Medium dice and add cucumber to bowl. Pick basil leaves off the stems; roll them up crosswise, thinly slice into ribbons, and add to bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (16 oz) pkg strawberries
1 ½ English cucumber
1 ½ small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Add bread cubes to bowl and toss to mix.
To serve, place salad on a plate and crumble with goat cheese over top. Serve with steak on the side. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (4 oz) log goat cheese

instructions.primary_message: In a small saucepan, combine quinoa and broth. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups quinoa
24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Wash zucchini and tomatoes. Halve zucchini lengthwise, then slice crosswise into half rounds. Medium dice tomatoes. Peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 medium zucchini squash
6 tomatoes
1 ½ medium yellow onion
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Heat a sauté pan over medium-high heat.
Coat bottom of pan with oil. Add chicken and cook until lightly browned but not cooked through, 1-2 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp virgin coconut oil
3 lb chicken thighs, boneless skinless

instructions.primary_message: Return pan to stove and add more oil. Add onion, garlic, and zucchini. Stirring frequently, cook until vegetables begin to soften, 2-3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp virgin coconut oil

instructions.primary_message: Return chicken to pan. Add tomatoes, honey, cinnamon, cumin, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover, and cook until chicken is cooked through and zucchini is tender, 8-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tsp honey
¾ tsp cinnamon
¾ tsp cumin
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry cilantro. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add ½ to pan (save the rest for garnishing) while the ingredients cook.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ small bunches cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Uncover quinoa and fluff with a fork.
To serve, place quinoa on a plate, top with chicken and sauce, and garnish with remaining cilantro. Enjoy!
If using frozen shrimp, place in a medium bowl, cover with water, and set aside to thaw. If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 ¼ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Wash potatoes and bell peppers. Peel and medium dice potatoes. Seed and medium dice peppers. Remove husks and silks from corn. Stand up in the middle of a large bowl and slice kernels off the cob. Transfer everything to a large bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 medium yellow potatoes
3 red bell peppers
6 ears corn

instructions.primary_message: Heat a large saucepan over medium heat.
Peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onion
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Coat bottom of saucepan with oil. Add onion and, stirring frequently, cook until softened, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp virgin coconut oil

instructions.primary_message: Add garlic, potatoes, bell pepper, and corn to saucepan. Stir to combine.
Add coconut milk, broth, cumin, coriander, salt, and pepper. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer until potatoes are tender, about 10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk
24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth
1 ½ tsp cumin
1 ½ tsp coriander
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Drain shrimp and rinse under cold water until there are no more ice chunks. Place on paper towels and pat dry. Add to saucepan while the chowder is cooking.
Toast bread if desired.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 slices gluten-free bread

instructions.primary_message: To serve, pour soup into a bowl and enjoy with bread on the side!

line_items.ingredient_name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat; add bacon and cook until crisp, 5-7 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 12 slices bacon

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel and mince shallots and garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 shallots
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: When the bacon is done, remove and set aside on a paper towel-lined plate. Transfer the bacon fat to a small bowl and set aside, leaving about 3 tbsp of fat in the skillet.
Return the skillet to medium-high heat; add shallots and garlic and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 2 minutes.
Add peas, water, and goat cheese to the skillet with the shallots; cook, stirring occasionally, until almost no liquid remains, about 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cups frozen peas
⅓ cup water
¾ (4 oz) log goat cheese

instructions.primary_message: Roughly chop the bacon and return to the plate.
Wash and juice lemons into a medium bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ lemons

instructions.primary_message: Add pea mixture to the bowl with the lemon juice and season with salt and pepper; mash until almost smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅜ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wipe out skillet and put back on stove over medium heat.
Add 3 tbsp of reserved bacon fat to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom; gently crack eggs into skillet and cook until whites are set but yolks are still runny, about 3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 eggs

instructions.primary_message: Toast bread if desired.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 slices gluten-free bread

instructions.primary_message: To serve, spread mashed peas over toast, top with bacon, egg, salt, and pepper. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message:
3 pinch salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Rinse lentils under cold water and transfer to a large pot. Add water and salt; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook until tender, 15-25 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ cups brown lentils
⅜ tsp salt
4 ½ cups water

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry zucchini, potatoes, bell peppers, and parsley.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 zucchini
3 medium yellow potatoes
3 red bell peppers
1 ½ small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Coarsely grate the zucchini. Peel and coarsely grate the potatoes. Place both in the middle of a clean tea towel, bring the corners together, and squeeze out excess moisture. Transfer to a medium bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 zucchini
3 medium yellow potatoes

instructions.primary_message: Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Add oil, flour, salt, and pepper to bowl and mix.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
9 tbsp gluten-free flour
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil to coat the bottom. Using a ¼ cup measure, form the zucchini mixture into patties. Working in batches if necessary, add patties to the skillet and flatten into ½-thick circles using the back of a spatula. Cook, flipping once, until golden and cooked through, 6-8 minutes. Remove to a paper towel-lined plate.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. In a small bowl, prepare sauce by mixing together ½ of the minced parsley (save the rest for the salad), yogurt, salt, and pepper. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup plain Greek yogurt
3 pinches salt
3 pinches black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic. In a large bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together garlic, oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 cloves garlic
4 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tbsp balsamic vinegar
⅜ tsp Dijon mustard
⅜ tsp salt
3 pinches black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add remaining parsley to bowl with dressing. Seed bell peppers, cut into small strips, and add to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 red bell peppers

instructions.primary_message: Drain lentils, add to bowl, and toss salad.
To serve, divide lentil salad and fritters between plates. Crumble goat cheese over the salad and top fritters with yogurt sauce. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (4 oz) log goat cheese

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry thyme. Add thyme sprigs, water, vinegar, salt, and coriander to a large pot; cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small pkg fresh thyme
12 cup water
1 ½ cup apple cider vinegar
3 tbsp salt
1 tbsp coriander

instructions.primary_message: If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.)
instructions.secondary_message: 2 ¼ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, uncover, add shrimp, and stir for a few seconds. Remove from heat, and let the shrimp pickle in the cooking liquid while you prepare the rest of the salad, about 25 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 lemons
1 ½ jalapeño peppers
1 ½ red bell peppers
1 ½ English cucumbers
3 medium carrots
3 avocados

instructions.primary_message: Grate the zest from the lemons and transfer to a large bowl, then juice the lemons into the same bowl.
Peel and mince the garlic; transfer to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Add additional vinegar, oil, salt, and pepper to the bowl and whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp apple cider vinegar
⅓ cup extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Thinly slice the jalapeños into rounds (be careful, with jalapeños, do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing).
Peel and thinly slice shallots into rings. Add shallots and jalapeños to the bowl with the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ shallots

instructions.primary_message: Seed and slice bell peppers into thin strips. Peel and medium dice cucumbers. Peel and thinly slice carrots into rounds. Add vegetables to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve and pit avocados; scoop out the flesh and medium dice. Add to the bowl.
Drain the shrimp and discard the liquid. Remove tails, then add shrimp to the bowl with the vegetables and stir to combine the salad; set aside.
Toast and butter the bread, then slice on the diagonal to make toast points.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 slices gluten-free bread
3 tbsp butter, unsalted

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide shrimp salad between bowls. Enjoy with a side of buttered toast points for dipping.

line_items.ingredient_name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover with a lid and bring to a boil over high heat.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ small pkgs fresh basil
1 ½ lb green beans
1 ½ Granny Smith apples
1 ½ (5 oz) pkgs spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Finely grate the Parmesan; transfer to a medium bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ oz Parmesan cheese

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince the garlic. Pick the basil leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add both to the bowl with the parmesan.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Trim and discard the ends of the green beans. Once the water in the pot is boiling, add the beans and cook until bright green and tender-crisp, 3-4 minutes. Drain and set aside.
Finely chop the pine nuts.
instructions.secondary_message: ⅜ cup pine nuts

instructions.primary_message: Add pine nuts, oil, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the Parmesan and stir to combine the pesto; set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Coarsely grate the cheddar.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (8 oz) blocks cheddar cheese

instructions.primary_message: Divide pesto among bread slices and top half of them with half of the cheddar. Arrange green beans on top of the cheddar so that they all face the same direction. Cover with remaining cheese and close sandwiches; press to secure ingredients.
instructions.secondary_message: 12 slices gluten-free bread

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-low heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Place sandwiches in the skillet and cook, flipping once, until bread is golden brown and cheese is melted, 3-4 minutes per side. Cook in batches if necessary. Once done, transfer to a cutting board; slice sandwiches on the diagonal.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp butter, unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, combine oil, vinegar, maple syrup, salt, and pepper in a large bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp apple cider vinegar
1 tbsp pure maple syrup
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Core and thinly slice apples; add apple and mixed greens to the bowl with the dressing; toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide the salad and sandwiches between plates. Enjoy!
Fill a large pot with water, cover, and bring to a boil.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lb green beans
1 ½ pints grape tomatoes
1 ½ small bunches Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Trim and discard the ends of the green beans, then cut into 2-inch pieces; transfer to a large bowl.

Once the water in the pot is boiling, uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until almost done, 8-10 minutes. Add green beans to the pot and cook 2-3 minutes more. Drain and rinse under cold water; set aside to cool.
instructions.secondary_message:
15 oz gluten-free penne pasta
1 tbsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, preheat a large cast iron skillet over medium-high heat.
Pat the salmon fillets dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb salmon fillet
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, place salmon, skin-side down, in the pan; cook until opaque and cooked through, 3-5 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate to cool.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Combine oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper in a salad bowl; whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
⅓ cup red wine vinegar
1 ½ tsp Dijon mustard
½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic. Roughly chop capers and olives. Transfer everything to the salad bowl; stir to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
3 tbsp capers
¾ cup Kalamata olives, pitted

instructions.primary_message: Halve the grape tomatoes crosswise. Peel and thinly slice onion into half rings; add both to the bowl with the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message: ½ medium red onion

instructions.primary_message: Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves; add to the bowl (reserving a handful for garnish).
Remove skin from the salmon, then using a fork or your hands, flake into bite-sized pieces.
Add salmon, pasta, and green beans to the bowl; toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide pasta salad between dishes and garnish with reserved parsley. Enjoy!
Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and large dice eggplant. Transfer to a sheet pan. Drizzle with oil and season with oregano, salt and pepper; toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 eggplant
6 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp oregano
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place in the oven and, stirring halfway though, bake until softened and browned, about 20 minutes.
Fill a large pot halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
about 21 cups water
3 tbsp salt
18 oz (1 quarter coin = 2 oz) gluten-free spaghetti pasta

instructions.primary_message: Heat a sauté pan over medium heat.
Peel and mince onion and garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onion
9 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Coat bottom of pan with oil. Add onion and, stirring frequently, cook until softened, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: about 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry basil. Pick leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Add garlic and pepper to pan. Stir until fragrant, 15-30 seconds.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add tomatoes, vinegar, sugar, spices, and ½ of the basil (save the rest for garnishing). Cook for 4-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (14.5 oz) cans diced tomatoes
1 ½ tsp white wine vinegar
3 pinch brown sugar
1 ½ tsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Shave or grate Parmesan.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 oz Parmesan cheese

instructions.primary_message: Drain pasta and add to pan with tomatoes. Add eggplant and toss to combine.
To serve, place pasta in a shallow bowl or on a plate. Garnish with remaining basil and sprinkle with Parmesan. Enjoy!
In a medium bowl, whisk together ricotta, almond butter, and maple syrup.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ (15 oz) pkg ricotta cheese
¾ cup natural almond butter
2 tbsp pure maple syrup

instructions.primary_message: Toast bread if desired.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 slices gluten-free bread

instructions.primary_message: Peel and slice bananas.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 bananas

instructions.primary_message: To serve, spoon ricotta almond butter over the bread. Top with banana slices and enjoy!
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups basmati rice
3 cup water

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 jalapeño peppers
3 (5 oz) pkgs baby spinach
6 small pkgs fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: In a medium bowl, combine the broth, soy sauce, fish sauce, and brown sugar. Whisk to combine the sauce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth
⅓ cup tamari soy sauce
2 tbsp fish sauce
2 tbsp brown sugar

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Roughly chop the chicken thighs into ½-inch pieces.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 ¼ lb chicken thighs, boneless skinless

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince the garlic and shallot. Quarter the jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs of the jalapeños with a spoon. Finely dice and set aside. (Be careful, with jalapeños, do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing).
instructions.secondary_message:
6 cloves garlic
3 shallots

instructions.primary_message: Heat a large skillet over high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
instructions.secondary_message: ⅓ cup extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Add chicken and stir-fry for 4-5 minutes, then add the garlic, shallot, and jalapeño. Continue cooking on high heat for 4-5 more minutes, stirring often.
Chop the baby spinach into small pieces.
Pour the sauce into the skillet. Cook on high, stirring often, until the sauce thickens and glazes the meat, 10-14 minutes. Remove from heat.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Reserve a few leaves for garnish.
Add the baby spinach (one handful at a time) and basil to the skillet and stir until wilted.
To serve, divide the rice and chicken between bowls. Garnish with reserved basil and enjoy!
Combine broth, soy sauce, vinegar, and oil in a medium saucepan. Cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth
3 tbsp tamari soy sauce
1 ½ tsp rice vinegar
1 tbsp toasted sesame oil

instructions.primary_message: Combine additional broth and corn starch in a small bowl; whisk to combine a smooth slurry. When broth in the saucepan comes to a boil, add slurry in a steady stream while whisking quickly. Let boil for 1 minute, then cover and reduce heat to low; simmer the gravy for 30 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 fl oz (¾ cup) chicken or vegetable broth
3 tbsp cornstarch

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to another medium saucepan. Add water and salt; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups jasmine rice
3 cup water
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Remove casings from sausages and roughly chop.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 pork sausages

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Preheat a large ovenproof skillet over medium heat.

When the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add sausage to the skillet and cook, stirring often, until browned and cooked through, about 5 minutes. Once done, transfer sausage to a small bowl, leaving sausage drippings in the skillet. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message: 1 tbsp toasted sesame oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ crowns broccoli
¾ lb white mushrooms
1 ½ small bunches green onions (scallions)

instructions.primary_message: Separate broccoli crowns into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces; transfer to a large bowl.
Slice mushrooms. Peel and thinly slice yellow onion into half rings; add both to the bowl with the broccoli.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ medium yellow onions

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to broil on high; position rack under the broiler.
Return skillet to stove over high heat and add more oil. Working in batches if necessary, add the vegetables and salt; cook, stirring often, until tender-crisp, 7-9 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp toasted sesame oil
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Crack eggs into a large bowl; add vinegar, salt, and pepper; whisk together.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 eggs
1 tbsp rice vinegar
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Stir sausage back into the skillet with the veggies. Reduce heat to medium-high and pour egg mixture evenly over the top. Let cook, undisturbed, until the bottom and sides are firm but the top is still runny, 5-7 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim off and discard the ends of the green onions; cut the onions crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle.
Place skillet in the oven and cook until top is set and golden brown, 5-7 minutes. Remove from the oven and slice into wedges.
To serve, divide rice and egg fu young between dishes. Pour gravy over the egg fu young and top with green onions. Enjoy!
Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp salt
15 oz gluten-free rotini pasta

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince the garlic.
instructions.secondary_message: 12 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Wash the green beans and trim ends.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 lb green beans

instructions.primary_message: Add water to a large skillet and bring to a boil, covered, over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ cup water

instructions.primary_message: Once the water is boiling, uncover and stir in the beans, oil, butter, and half the garlic. Simmer until beans are tender and water has evaporated, 4-5 minutes. Season with salt, then remove from heat and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp butter, unsalted
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Once the saucepan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Add remaining garlic to the saucepan and cook for 1 minute, then add the tomato paste and cook for an additional 30 seconds, stirring frequently.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp tomato paste

instructions.primary_message: Add the pumpkin, milk, and spices to the saucepan. Whisk to combine and let simmer for 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (15 oz) cans pure pumpkin purée
24 fl oz (3 cups) whole milk
11 ¼ ml onion powder
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
11 ¼ ml basil
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Grate the parmesan.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 oz Parmesan cheese

instructions.primary_message: Add the parmesan cheese (reserving a small amount for garnish) and red pepper flakes to the saucepan; stir to combine. Remove from the heat and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the pasta is done, drain and return to the large pot. Pour the sauce into the pot with the pasta and stir to combine.
To serve, divide the pasta and green beans between plates. Top pasta with remaining Parmesan and enjoy!
